experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4929:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5789:reassess/r_3.md:7887:./reassess/r_3.md:3294:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4930:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5790:reassess/r_3.md:7888:./reassess/r_3.md:3295:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4935:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4936:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4948:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3866:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:1:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4949:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4950:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4951:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4952:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4953:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4954:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4955:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4956:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4957:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4958:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4959:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4960:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3903:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5003:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4596:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5004:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5214:ReID 团队 LM-ReID(重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点 sampling-lattice hidden variable, 非模糊)方法稿 salvage 命门对照出了, 求下一步定夺。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5218:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5219:- **M=3 lattice-aug no-LM(每iter 3 个 sampling-lattice variants: sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel)**: **77.44**, lattice 79.90, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +2.576
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5220:- M=3 lattice+consistency(L_marg+L_cons): 75.71(consistency 训练有害已证 -1.73)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5221:(高 h: h=24 ordinary 84.00 vs lattice no-LM 84.28; h=32 ordinary 86.48 vs 86.44 — 几乎相等)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5227:① +0.54 真弱到放弃训练端 lattice 故事? 还是 severe h=16 的 +0.54(高 h 处 ordinary≈lattice)算有意义信号?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5229:③ ★"lattice 在 test-time 特殊但 training 不特殊"这个不对称本身能否成 paper 卖点(decision-level marginalization > embedding/training-level invariance for sampling-lattice nuisance)? 这是不是反而比原 LM-ReID 更干净的故事?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5230:④ 若弃, 转什么? 死区(避开): SMPL/几何, 遮挡三墙, 航拍-地面, 通用FM-import, frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量。备胎 d17 rank-leverage(top-k被局部区域劫持)未验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5231:联网查 test-time-only ReID 可发性 + sampling-lattice/aliasing-in-ReID 先例。给 verdict+信心+具体下一步实验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5239:web search: sampling lattice hidden variable image classification aliasing test time marginalization subpixel shifts deep networks
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5249:web search: site:openaccess.thecvf.com person re-identification test-time adaptation BNTA
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5263:初步查到的形势：ReID 里 test-time 不是禁区，k-reciprocal re-ranking 这种纯后处理曾进 CVPR；TTA/flip TTA 也有专门论文讨论训练-推理 gap。但“sampling lattice / aliasing”在 ReID 里没搜到直接成熟路线，更多是通用视觉里的 shift/aliasing 先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5267:总判：**砍掉“训练端 lattice 是核心创新”的故事，但不要立刻弃 LM-ReID。把稿子改救成“severe LR ReID 中 sampling lattice 是 test-time hidden nuisance，正确处理是 retrieval/decision-level marginalization，而不是训练端 embedding invariance”。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5270:ReID 里 test-time/post-processing 不是不能发：k-reciprocal re-ranking 是无监督后处理并进了 CVPR 2017；FlipReID 明确讨论 ReID TTA 和训练-推理 gap；BNTA 也是 ReID test-time adaptation。通用视觉里，shift/aliasing/sub-pixel sensitivity 有 ICML/CVPR 先例。但我快速查了 “anti-aliasing / sampling lattice / subpixel / cross-resolution + person ReID”，没看到直接把 sampling lattice 当 LR-ReID hidden variable 的成熟先例。这个空位可用，但要讲窄、讲硬。来源：k-reciprocal ReID re-ranking、FlipReID、BNTA、anti-aliased CNN、fractional shift alias-free CNN、CR-ReID resolution-adaptive prior。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5273:Verdict：**弱到不足以支撑训练端 lattice-specific story。信心 8/10。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5275:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5277:但 Verdict 不是“lattice 现象不存在”。更准确是：**h=16 的 +0.54 只能作为 diagnostic signal，不能当主贡献。信心 7/10。** 它支持“低分辨率下 lattice 有影响”，不支持“训练端 lattice augmentation 是方法命门”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5282:`(b) 纯 test-time lattice marginalization`：**最值。信心 7.5/10；论文潜力 6/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5285:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5288:`(d) 弃 LM-ReID`：**现在不弃 hidden-variable story，只弃原训练端 LM-ReID 叙事。信心 8/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5289:如果后续 test-time lattice 对 ordinary TTA 的优势在多 seed/多数据集上消失，再弃。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5296:> Sampling lattice is a nuisance variable in severe LR ReID, but forcing embedding-level invariance is not the right treatment. Because aliasing may change identity evidence, training-time consistency collapses useful but unstable cues; retrieval-time marginalization preserves alternatives and integrates them at decision level.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5300:1. lattice TTA 全配置强于 ordinary TTA；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5301:2. ordinary-aug 模型也吃 lattice marginalization；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5302:3. lattice-aug 训练只比 ordinary-aug 多 `+0.54`；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5303:4. consistency 明确有害。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5305:缺的不是想法，是证据链：要证明它不是“多裁几次就涨”，而是“sampling lattice 这个 latent variable 的 marginalization 特别有效”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5313:2. `D17-intervention`：试 robust distance，例如 part-distance trimming、max-leverage cap、rank-level entropy penalty，只做 retrieval-side 对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5317:1. **LM-S1 多 seed 复核训练端命门**：只跑 `h=16 ordinary M3` vs `lattice no-LM M3`，3 seeds。若均值差 `< +0.8` 或 CI 跨 0，训练端 lattice story 关门。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5318:2. **LM-S2 inference 主实验**：固定已训模型，测 `h=12/16/20/24/32`，比较 single、ordinary TTA、lattice marginalization，要求 equal number of views / equal compute。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5320:4. **LM-S4 lattice 因子消融**：phase / bbox / kernel 分开，找真正贡献源。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5321:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5323:当前定夺：**salvage，不是 abandon；但论文标题和贡献要从 LM training 改成 test-time decision marginalization for sampling-lattice nuisance。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5398:ReID 方法稿探索。背景: 主线 LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点 test-time decision marginalization)已做到 6.5/10 成稿(中等偏强 B 类, 冲 7.0 失败因 detector 误差下 marginalization 衰减)。现评估唯一未验备胎 **d17 rank-leverage**: 观察=ReID 检索 top-k 排名被少数局部区域(stripe/patch)劫持, false positive 由局部区域支配(对抗鲁棒性视角)。诊断=对 query-gallery top-k 做局部遮挡/stripe/patch counterfactual, 算 rank-leverage concentration。**关键教训(本 session 多次踩坑): 任何 per-query 解释变量必须控制 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk(top-k 里错几个), 否则退化成错误计数(Hubness/evidence 都这样死过)。** 问: (a)d17 能否成 > 6.5 的 B 类方法稿(机制层新意+可干预 remedy 非纯诊断)? (b)cheap kill-switch 设计(带 #false-in-topk 控制+对抗 baseline 对照, 团队 market/occluded_duke 数据零训练首验)? (c)和 LM-ReID 6.5 比哪个更值得投? 还是 6.5 收尾投更务实? 诚实评估别硬凑, 信心 1-10。务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5651:> 目标：post-PRCV 找一篇 CCF-B **方法稿**。资源：frozen Swin/SOLIDER（occluded_duke 73 / market 94.6 / CARGO 67）+ on-disk 数据（occluded_duke / market / MSMT / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / RSTPReid，**无视频**）。结论：**这条 frozen-feature + on-disk 路被穷尽地证负——6 个方法方向 cheap-kill 全死 + 视频 no-go + 唯一 analysis 发现严验证伪。零浪费训练。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5678:3. **frozen-feature 隐藏变量反复被成熟 test-time 工具碾压**：k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking/hard-negative 覆盖了 retrieval/topology-side 的明显隐藏变量。新 accuracy 隐藏变量极难逃脱。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5687:- (c) **换问题/项目**：这条 post-PRCV frozen-image 线证负到底；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5690:**不建议**：在现有 frozen-feature + on-disk 上再找 accuracy 隐藏变量（穷尽证负）；烧训练硬撞已 cheap-kill 否掉的方向。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5708:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5994:一个 ReID 团队的 **Gallery-Growth Tax** 诊断 LIVE(frozen 强 ReID 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性掉点 Market−4.4/OD−12.9, CONTROL2 shuffle 证结构性)。但 remedy 草案 Tax-Aware Distractor Training(优化 gallery-size-conditioned extreme-negative risk)的零训练预检 = **分裂**: 饱和域 Market GO(extreme-negative margin 明显超 trivial 难度分), 但难/未饱和域 OD NO-GO(margin ≈ trivial 1x-top1-margin, extreme-negative 项无独立信号)。**诊断: OD 的 gallery-growth 失败是 weak-positive driven(occluded query 自身匹配弱), 非 strong-distractor driven**, 所以 distractor-targeting remedy 在最需要的难域塌回 trivial, 且救 weak-positive 撞 occlusion 死区。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5999:③ 还是该止损转备胎(我手里还有 d8 Lattice-Marginalized 低分辨率采样不确定 / d14 Evidence-Sufficient FM审计器 / d17 Rank-Leverage 对抗, 都 7/10 待验)?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6672:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4304:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6678:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6682:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6745:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5782:./reassess/r_3.md:3108:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3322:./validate/v_3.md:15165:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6751:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2120:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4188:./reassess/r_3.md:2850:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:837:./analyses/deep_4.txt:57:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6760:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3388:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5023:reassess/r_3.md:2762:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6484:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果注意力会看错，就用 HRNet 解析出人体前景 mask，把 mask patch 投影成语义嵌入，和图像 patch、位置、相机嵌入一起送入 Transformer。若高层 patch 太平滑，就聚合第 2、4、10、12 层的 patch 表征做 HFA。若遮挡导致全局特征断裂，就用多分支空洞卷积 DFC 补全不同感受野下的全局信息。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6762:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7878:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:2463:    """Produce counterfactual feature maps for the consistency / dropout losses.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7900:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2228:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:70:"transfer_to_occluded": "CPDM's \"inverse-PCB\" consecutive patch dropout is directly relevant to occluded ReID: during training, systematically zero out each horizontal body stripe one at a time and supervise an ID/triplet loss on each resulting incomplete feature map, forcing the network to extract discriminative identity cues from every region rather than collapsing onto a single dominant (often occlusion-vulnerable) region. This is a structured, region-complete simulation of occlusion that, unlike random erasing/DropBlock, guarantees each region is dropped exactly once per sample and reuses the same drop pattern across the feature stack — a cheap training-time regularizer that adds zero test-time cost (heads discarded at inference) and should improve robustness when query/gallery has missing body parts.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7901:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2307:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:53:→ lattice 边缘化是**低分辨率现象**（h≤24 强、h=32 临界、h≥48 无），正是 d_8.txt 预测的 regime。**脚本自带 AUTO VERDICT: GO（h=16/24 过全部四关：volatility ✓ / 增益≥2 ✓ / LAT-TTA>0 ✓ / phase-var|#false>0 ✓）。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7902:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2380:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7918:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4071:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3707:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7929:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6245:一个 ReID 团队的 **Gallery-Growth Tax** 诊断已零训练 kill-switch 证实 LIVE: frozen 强 ReID 模型(表示不变), 旧 query mAP 随**同域** gallery 膨胀 1x→10x 结构性掉点(Market −4.43 / Occluded-Duke −12.86 mAP, 量级 ≈ LReID 文献报的 catastrophic forgetting); CONTROL2 决定性(real distractor 掉 vs 列洗牌不掉 = 结构性非机械 count); CONTROL1 部分是 #false-in-topk trivial 但有结构残差(OD partial +0.36, Market 弱 +0.09)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8020:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8085:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8024:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8291:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4542:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8027:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8320:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:5007:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324/design.md:15:frozen DINOv2-B dense patch tokens，按 pose 锚定成 5 个 body-part 表征（带 per-part visibility），跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 part-MaxSim，在**重遮挡子集**上**超过 holistic 基线**（DINO 全局 cosine 以及/或 exp255 holistic）——全程 training-free。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8105:experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/code/afd_model.py:499:    """Produce counterfactual feature maps for the consistency / dropout losses.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8114:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1968:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/afd_reid/design.md:49:- 模块2 **Cross-View Frequency Counterfactual**: 训练时 high-band dropout / amplitude swap / low-high consistency, 约束同 ID 在 A↔G 下身份不变 + view-adversarial/orthogonal 防视角泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8173:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:8174:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9102:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3707:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9416:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20396:| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20424:| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |

   130	def make_lattice_variants(hr_img, h, K, rng, rand_mode=False):

   132	    variant 0 = canonical deterministic bicubic LR (single-LR baseline)."""

   167	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))
   168	            cropped = canvas.crop((l + pad, u + pad, r + pad, b + pad)).resize((W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   169	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   170	        variants.append(v)
   171	        axes.append(mode + 1)           # 1=phase, 2=bbox, 3=zoom
   172	    return variants, axes
   173	
   174	
   175	def make_ordinary_variants(hr_img, h, K, rng):
   176	    """CONTROL (codex 命门对照): K ORDINARY-augmentation variants of the canonical LR — NOT
   177	    lattice. variant 0 = canonical bicubic LR; 1+ = random pad-crop / hflip / resize-jitter /
   178	    color jitter. Same #views/h/compute as the lattice path → isolates whether the M=3 gain is
   179	    lattice-SPECIFIC or just 'more augmentation'."""
   180	    from PIL import ImageEnhance
   181	    canon = make_lr(hr_img, h, 'bicubic')
   182	    W, H = canon.size
   183	    variants = [canon]; axes = [0]
   184	    for j in range(1, K):
   185	        v = canon
   186	        pad = int(rng.randint(4, 13))
   187	        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W + 2 * pad, H + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   188	        canvas.paste(v, (pad, pad))
   189	        cx = int(rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1)); cy = int(rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1))
   190	        v = canvas.crop((cx, cy, cx + W, cy + H))
   191	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   192	            v = v.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
   193	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   194	            s = rng.uniform(0.8, 1.0)
   195	            v = v.resize((max(1, int(W * s)), max(1, int(H * s))), Image.BILINEAR).resize((W, H), Image.BILINEAR)
   196	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   197	            v = ImageEnhance.Brightness(v).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   198	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   199	            v = ImageEnhance.Contrast(v).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   200	        variants.append(v); axes.append(0)
   201	    return variants, axes
   202

   204	def pil_to_tensor_np(img):
   205	    arr = np.asarray(img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
   206	    arr = (arr - PIXEL_MEAN) / PIXEL_STD
   207	    return arr.transpose(2, 0, 1)

   210	# =========================================================================== #
   211	# PK dataset: each item = ONE person image -> M lattice LR variants (random height).
   212	# A PK batch sampler draws P ids x Kins instances; collate stacks [B, M, C, H, W].
   213	# =========================================================================== #
   214	import torch
   215	from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, Sampler
   216	from datasets.bases import read_image
   217	
   218	
   219	class LatticeTrainSet(Dataset):
   220	    def __init__(self, items):
   221	        self.items = items
   222	
   223	    def __len__(self):
   224	        return len(self.items)
   225	
   226	    def set_epoch(self, ep):
   227	        self.epoch = ep
   228	
   229	    def __getitem__(self, idx):
   230	        p, lbl, cam = self.items[idx]
   231	        # rng MIXED WITH EPOCH so each image gets FRESH random lattice variants every epoch
   232	        # (Codex High-1: seed+idx alone froze the variants identically across all epochs).
   233	        seed = (cli.seed * 1000003 + getattr(self, 'epoch', 0) * 9973 + idx * 2654435761) % (2**32)
   234	        rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
   235	        h = int(rng.choice(cli.heights, p=np.array(cli.height_p) / np.sum(cli.height_p)))
   236	        hr = _to_target_aspect(read_image(p))
   237	        # rand_mode=True: random axis per non-canonical variant (Codex High-2). aug_mode=ordinary
   238	        # is the codex 命门 control: same M views/h but random crop/flip/color, NOT lattice.
   239	        if getattr(cli, 'aug_mode', 'lattice') == 'ordinary':
   240	            vs, axes = make_ordinary_variants(hr, h, cli.M, rng)
   241	        else:
   242	            vs, axes = make_lattice_variants(hr, h, cli.M, rng, rand_mode=True)
   243	        t = np.stack([pil_to_tensor_np(v) for v in vs], 0)   # [M,3,H,W]
   244	        return torch.from_numpy(t), int(lbl), torch.tensor(axes, dtype=torch.long)
   245	
   246	
   247	class PKSampler(Sampler):
   248	    """Yield flat indices in P-id x Kins-instance blocks (one 'batch' = P*Kins)."""
   249	    def __init__(self, items, P, Kins, num_iters=None):
   250	        self.P, self.Kins = P, Kins
   251	        self.by_pid = {}
   252	        for i, (_, lbl, _) in enumerate(items):
   253	            self.by_pid.setdefault(lbl, []).append(i)
   254	        self.pids = list(self.by_pid.keys())
   255	        self.length = (len(items) // (P * Kins)) if num_iters is None else num_iters
   256	        self._n_items = len(items)
   257	
   258	    def __len__(self):
   259	        return self.length * self.P * self.Kins
   260	
   261	    def __iter__(self):
   262	        flat = []
   263	        for _ in range(self.length):
   264	            chosen = random.sample(self.pids, self.P) if len(self.pids) >= self.P \
   265	                else [random.choice(self.pids) for _ in range(self.P)]
   266	            for pid in chosen:
   267	                pool = self.by_pid[pid]
   268	                if len(pool) >= self.Kins:
   269	                    flat.extend(random.sample(pool, self.Kins))
   270	                else:
   271	                    flat.extend([random.choice(pool) for _ in range(self.Kins)])
   272	        return iter(flat)
   273	
   274	
   275	def collate(batch):
   276	    ts = torch.stack([b[0] for b in batch], 0)               # [B,M,3,H,W]
   277	    ys = torch.tensor([b[1] for b in batch], dtype=torch.long)
   278	    axes = torch.stack([b[2] for b in batch], 0)             # [B,M] lattice-axis labels for L_adv
   279	    return ts, ys, axes
   280	
   281	
   282	# =========================================================================== #
   283	# losses
   284	# =========================================================================== #
   285	def euclidean_dist(x, y):
   286	    m, n = x.size(0), y.size(0)
   287	    xx = (x ** 2).sum(1, keepdim=True).expand(m, n)
   288	    yy = (y ** 2).sum(1, keepdim=True).expand(n, m).t()
   289	    d = xx + yy - 2 * x @ y.t()
   290	    return d.clamp(min=1e-12).sqrt()
   291	
   292	
   293	def batch_hard_triplet(feat, labels, margin):
   294	    """standard batch-hard triplet (hardest pos / hardest neg) on euclidean feat."""
   295	    d = euclidean_dist(feat, feat)
   296	    N = labels.size(0)
   297	    is_pos = labels[:, None].eq(labels[None, :])
   298	    is_neg = ~is_pos
   299	    # hardest positive: max same-id dist (diagonal is 0/same-id, included is fine)
   300	    d_ap = (d * is_pos.float()).max(1)[0]
   301	    # hardest negative: min diff-id dist
   302	    d_an = (d + is_pos.float() * 1e9).min(1)[0]
   303	    y = torch.ones_like(d_ap)
   304	    return torch.nn.functional.margin_ranking_loss(d_an, d_ap, y, margin=margin)
   305	
   306	
   307	class GradReverse(torch.autograd.Function):
   308	    @staticmethod
   309	    def forward(ctx, x, lamb):
   310	        ctx.lamb = lamb
   311	        return x.view_as(x)
   312	
   313	    @staticmethod
   314	    def backward(ctx, g):
   315	        return -ctx.lamb * g, None
   316	
   317	
   318	# =========================================================================== #
   319	# model (TRAINABLE; pose disabled -> plain backbone global feat + classifier)
   320	# =========================================================================== #
   321	def build_trainable_model():
   322	    from config import cfg
   323	    from model import make_model
   324	    from datasets.market1501 import Market1501
   325	    cfg.merge_from_file(os.path.join(_repo, cli.config))
   326	    cfg.merge_from_list([
   327	        'MODEL.POSE_TEST_FEAT', 'global',
   328	        'TEST.NECK_FEAT', 'after',
   329	        'TEST.FEAT_NORM', 'yes',
   330	    ])
   331	    cfg.freeze()
   332	    os.environ.setdefault('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', '0')
   333	    ds = Market1501(root=os.path.join(_repo, cli.data_root), verbose=False)
   334	    model = make_model(cfg, num_class=ds.num_train_pids, camera_num=ds.num_train_cams,
   335	                       view_num=1, semantic_weight=cfg.MODEL.SEMANTIC_WEIGHT)
   336	    model.load_param(os.path.join(_repo, cli.ckpt))
   337	    print(f"[model] loaded {cli.ckpt}; num_cls={ds.num_train_pids}; pose DISABLED (pose_dict=None)",
   338	          flush=True)
   339	    return model.cuda(), ds.num_train_pids

   341	
   342	def main():
   343	    print("#" * 88)
   344	    print("# LM-ReID TRAINING (exp359) — fine-tune exp260b for lattice-marginalized embedding")
   345	    print("#" * 88)
   346	    t_items, n_cls = list_train(os.path.join(_repo, cli.data_root, 'market1501', 'bounding_box_train'))
   347	    if cli.smoke_ids > 0:
   348	        keep = set(sorted({it[1] for it in t_items})[:cli.smoke_ids])
   349	        t_items = [it for it in t_items if it[1] in keep]
   350	        # relabel again to contiguous
   351	        remap = {l: i for i, l in enumerate(sorted({it[1] for it in t_items}))}
   352	        t_items = [[p, remap[l], c] for (p, l, c) in t_items]
   353	        n_cls = len(remap)
   354	    print(f"[data] #train_img={len(t_items)} #ids(for sampler)={len({it[1] for it in t_items})} "
   355	          f"n_cls={n_cls}  M={cli.M} P={cli.P} Kins={cli.Kins} (BS={cli.P*cli.Kins}) heights={cli.heights}")
   356	
   357	    model, _ = build_trainable_model()
   358	    in_planes = model.bottleneck.weight.shape[0]
   359	    print(f"[model] embedding dim (bottleneck) = {in_planes}")
   360	
   361	    # lattice discriminator for L_adv (predict which of M variant slots): tiny MLP
   362	    disc = torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.Linear(in_planes, 256), torch.nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
   363	                               torch.nn.Linear(256, 4)).cuda()   # 4 axes: 0=canon,1=phase,2=bbox,3=zoom
   364	
   365	    params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad] + list(disc.parameters())
   366	    opt = torch.optim.SGD(params, lr=cli.lr, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=cli.weight_decay, nesterov=True)
   367	    ce = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
   368	    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()    # AMP: B*M=128 Swin-base fwd+bwd would be tight in fp32
   369	
   370	    ds = LatticeTrainSet(t_items)
   371	    iters_per_epoch = (len(t_items) // (cli.P * cli.Kins))
   372	    if cli.smoke_iters > 0:
   373	        iters_per_epoch = min(iters_per_epoch, cli.smoke_iters)
   374	    sampler = PKSampler(t_items, cli.P, cli.Kins, num_iters=iters_per_epoch)
   375	    loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=cli.P * cli.Kins, sampler=sampler, num_workers=cli.workers,
   376	                        collate_fn=collate, pin_memory=True, drop_last=True)
   377	
   378	    os.makedirs(os.path.join(_repo, cli.out), exist_ok=True)
   379	
   380	    def lr_at(ep):
   381	        if ep < cli.warmup:
   382	            return cli.lr * (ep + 1) / max(1, cli.warmup)
   383	        prog = (ep - cli.warmup) / max(1, cli.epochs - cli.warmup)
   384	        return 0.5 * cli.lr * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * prog))
   385	
   386	    print(f"[train] iters/epoch={iters_per_epoch}  epochs={cli.epochs}  lr={cli.lr}", flush=True)
   387	    for ep in range(cli.epochs):
   388	        model.train()
   389	        ds.set_epoch(ep)                  # FRESH random lattice variants each epoch (Codex High-1)
   390	        for g in opt.param_groups:
   391	            g['lr'] = lr_at(ep)
   392	        adv_lamb = cli.lam_adv if (cli.lam_adv > 0 and ep >= cli.adv_start) else 0.0
   393	        agg = {k: 0.0 for k in ('L', 'id', 'marg', 'cons', 'adv', 'acc')}
   394	        t0 = time.time()
   395	        for it, (xb, yb, axb) in enumerate(loader):
   396	            B, M = xb.shape[0], xb.shape[1]
   397	            x = xb.view(B * M, *xb.shape[2:]).cuda(non_blocking=True)
   398	            y = yb.cuda(non_blocking=True)
   399	            y_rep = y.repeat_interleave(M)                    # [B*M]
   400	            cam0 = torch.zeros(B * M, dtype=torch.long, device=x.device)
   401	            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
   402	                out = model(x, label=y_rep, cam_label=cam0, view_label=cam0, pose_dict=None)
   403	            # pose-OFF training return is (cls_score, global_feat, featmaps, None); be robust to the
   404	            # list form ([cls_score]+heads, [global_feat]+heads) in case a pose branch ever fires.
   405	            # losses computed in fp32 (.float()) for numerical safety (log / KL underflow in fp16).
   406	            cls = (out[0][0] if isinstance(out[0], (list, tuple)) else out[0]).float()   # [B*M, n_cls]
   407	            gf = (out[1][0] if isinstance(out[1], (list, tuple)) else out[1]).float()    # [B*M, D]
   408	            D = gf.shape[1]
   409	
   410	            # ---- reshape to [B, M, .] ----
   411	            cls_bm = cls.view(B, M, -1)
   412	            gf_bm = gf.view(B, M, D)
   413	
   414	            # ---- L_id (CE on all variants + PER-SLOT batch-hard triplet) ----
   415	            # Codex Medium-4: triplet over flat B*M treats same-image variants as positives;
   416	            # do triplet WITHIN each lattice slot (clean PK structure) and average over slots.
   417	            L_ce = ce(cls, y_rep)
   418	            L_tri = torch.stack([batch_hard_triplet(gf_bm[:, m], y, cli.margin)
   419	                                 for m in range(M)]).mean()
   420	            L_id = L_ce + L_tri
   421	            # ---- LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM (codex): worst-case lattice variant emphasis ----
   422	            # add gamma*tau*logsumexp_m(CE^m/tau): optimize the HARDEST lattice variant per
   423	            # identity (robustness, NOT embedding collapse). Pair with --aug_mode ordinary for the
   424	            # Hard-ordinary control; lattice must beat Hard-ordinary by >=+0.8 mAP to live.
   425	            if cli.loss_mode == 'hard':
   426	                ce_none = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
   427	                    cls_bm.reshape(B * M, -1), y_rep, reduction='none').view(B, M)   # [B,M]
   428	                L_id = L_id + cli.gamma_hard * cli.tau_hard * torch.logsumexp(
   429	                    ce_none / cli.tau_hard, dim=1).mean()
   430	
   431	            # ---- LSRC (Lattice-Set Retrieval Contrastive): bag-to-bag set score shaped for
   432	            # decision marginalization. set-supcon aligns training to test-time logsumexp marg;
   433	            # neg-tail suppresses the false-high lattice-pair on negatives (the marg math
   434	            # bottleneck). NOT consistency (no pull-to-mean), NOT L_marg (retrieval decision, not
   435	            # classifier posterior -> explains why frozen reweight had no headroom). ----
   436	            if cli.loss_mode == 'lsrc':
   437	                zb = torch.nn.functional.normalize(gf_bm, dim=-1)               # [B,M,D]
   438	                if cli.lsrc_asym:
   439	                    # codex High-fix: asymmetric set score matches test q(LR K-variants) x g(HR/canonical single).
   440	                    # gallery side uses ONLY slot-0 -> no gallery-side oracle, no test-absent worst-pair on negs.
   441	                    zg = zb[:, 0]                                               # [B,D] canonical gallery
   442	                    sim_src = torch.einsum('ikd,jd->ijk', zb, zg)              # [B,B,M] query-set vs gallery-single
   443	                else:
   444	                    sim_src = torch.einsum('ikd,jld->ijkl', zb, zb).reshape(B, B, -1)  # [B,B,M*M] symmetric bag-to-bag
   445	                S = cli.lsrc_tau * torch.logsumexp(sim_src / cli.lsrc_tau, dim=2)  # [B,B] set score
   446	                pos = (y[:, None] == y[None, :]).float(); pos.fill_diagonal_(0)
   447	                logits = S / cli.lsrc_tau_c - 1e9 * torch.eye(B, device=x.device)
   448	                logp = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=1)
   449	                L_setsupcon = (-(pos * logp).sum(1) / pos.sum(1).clamp_min(1)).mean()
   450	                neg = (y[:, None] != y[None, :]).float()
   451	                max_neg = sim_src.max(2)[0]                                     # [B,B] max lattice-pair cos
   452	                L_negtail = (neg * torch.nn.functional.softplus(
   453	                    (max_neg - cli.lsrc_margin) / 0.1)).sum() / neg.sum().clamp_min(1)
   454	                L_cov = torch.zeros((), device=x.device)
   455	                if cli.lam_coverage > 0:    # codex step2: positives win via top-M lattice pairs, not one fixed
   456	                    topm = torch.topk(sim_src, min(cli.cov_m, sim_src.shape[2]), dim=2)[0].mean(2)  # [B,B]
   457	                    L_cov = -(pos * topm).sum() / pos.sum().clamp_min(1)
   458	                L_id = L_id + cli.lam_lsrc * (L_setsupcon + cli.lam_negtail * L_negtail
   459	                                              + cli.lam_coverage * L_cov)
   460	
   461	            # ---- L_marg (marginal likelihood + triplet on mean feat) ----
   462	            p_bm = torch.softmax(cls_bm, dim=-1)             # [B,M,C]
   463	            p_mean = p_bm.mean(1)                            # [B,C]
   464	            ll = torch.log(p_mean.gather(1, y[:, None]).clamp_min(1e-8)).squeeze(1)  # [B]
   465	            gf_mean = gf_bm.mean(1)                          # [B,D]
   466	            L_marg = -ll.mean() + batch_hard_triplet(gf_mean, y, cli.margin)
   467	
   468	            # ---- L_cons (lattice invariance: pull each variant to the mean) ----
   469	            z = torch.nn.functional.normalize(gf_bm, dim=-1)            # [B,M,D]
   470	            z_mu = torch.nn.functional.normalize(gf_bm.mean(1), dim=-1).detach()  # [B,D]
   471	            cos_term = (1.0 - (z * z_mu[:, None, :]).sum(-1)).mean()
   472	            # KL(p^l || sg(p_mu)) — forward KL (design): pull each variant's prediction to the mean.
   473	            logp_l = torch.log_softmax(cls_bm, dim=-1)                  # [B,M,C] = log p^l
   474	            log_pmu = torch.log(p_mean.detach().clamp_min(1e-8))[:, None, :]   # [B,1,C] = log sg(p_mu)
   475	            kl_term = (p_bm * (logp_l - log_pmu)).sum(-1).mean()        # p_bm = softmax(cls_bm) = p^l
   476	            L_cons = cos_term + cli.beta_kl * kl_term
   477	
   478	            # ---- L_adv (GRL: remove predictable lattice-AXIS label from z) ----
   479	            # Codex Medium-3: GRL already scales the reversed grad by adv_lamb -> do NOT also
   480	            # weight L_adv by adv_lamb in the total (was lambda^2). Predict the REAL axis (axb),
   481	            # not the slot index (now a random axis per slot), so the adversary label is meaningful.
   482	            if adv_lamb > 0:
   483	                axis_lbl = axb.to(x.device).reshape(B * M)             # [B*M] real lattice axis
   484	                zr = GradReverse.apply(torch.nn.functional.normalize(gf, dim=-1), adv_lamb)
   485	                L_adv = ce(disc(zr), axis_lbl)
   486	            else:
   487	                L_adv = torch.zeros((), device=x.device)
   488	
   489	            loss = L_id + cli.lam_marg * L_marg + cli.lam_cons * L_cons + L_adv
   490	            opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
   491	            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
   492	            scaler.step(opt)
   493	            scaler.update()
   494	
   495	            with torch.no_grad():
   496	                acc = (cls.argmax(1) == y_rep).float().mean().item()
   497	            agg['L'] += loss.item(); agg['id'] += L_id.item(); agg['marg'] += L_marg.item()
   498	            agg['cons'] += L_cons.item(); agg['adv'] += float(L_adv.item()); agg['acc'] += acc
   499	            if (it + 1) % 50 == 0 or cli.smoke_iters > 0:
   500	                n = it + 1
   501	                print(f"  ep{ep} it{n}/{iters_per_epoch} L={agg['L']/n:.3f} id={agg['id']/n:.3f} "
   502	                      f"marg={agg['marg']/n:.3f} cons={agg['cons']/n:.3f} adv={agg['adv']/n:.3f} "
   503	                      f"acc={agg['acc']/n:.3f} lr={lr_at(ep):.2e}", flush=True)
   504	        n = max(1, it + 1)
   505	        print(f"[epoch {ep}] L={agg['L']/n:.3f} id={agg['id']/n:.3f} marg={agg['marg']/n:.3f} "
   506	              f"cons={agg['cons']/n:.3f} adv={agg['adv']/n:.3f} acc={agg['acc']/n:.3f} "
   507	              f"({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)", flush=True)
   508	        if (ep + 1) % cli.save_every == 0 or (ep + 1) == cli.epochs:
   509	            sp = os.path.join(_repo, cli.out, f'transformer_{ep+1}.pth')
   510	            torch.save(model.state_dict(), sp)
   511	            print(f"[save] {sp}", flush=True)
   512	    print("[done] LM-ReID training complete. EVAL via cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py --ckpt <out>.")
   513	
   514	
   515	if __name__ == '__main__':
   516	    main()

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3776:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:48:# OVLI: Opposite-View Late-Interaction Evidence Alignment(★headline, 5-codex 收敛)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:50:## 为什么从 OVP 转 OVLI
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3778:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:51:- **OVP-Mem 的硬伤是 novelty 撞车**(claude/codex 双审都标 High): per-view EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE ≈ **CMPC(CVPR22)/MBCE(AAAI23)/PDPA(2025 同 CARGO)** 近乎逐字同构, 当 headline 过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:53:- **OVLI 保留方向、换掉撞车的机制**: 把 per-pid prototype contrast 改成 **token-set late-interaction(ColBERT/MaxSim 风格)的 sample-to-sample 跨视角检索 loss**——无 prototype/memory/EMA, 直接局部 token 集合**部分匹配**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3780:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:56:**跨视角身份证据是"部分 token-set 匹配"问题, 不是"全局原型对齐"问题。** 航拍-地面单图在两视角下**无 1-1 部位对应**(俯视看头肩/平视看全身)。全局原型(OVP/CMPC)对"缺失区域"一律惩罚, 把不可对应的部分也算进相似度; **partial MaxSim 让"能对上的 token"承担相似度, 对不上的不拖累**——这正是 late-interaction 的 retrieval 语义, 契合跨视角证据稀疏/不对齐的本质。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3781:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:59:全局 cosine 之外, 加 **opposite-view sample-to-sample 的 (global cos + 双向 MaxSim) 混合检索 loss**(supervised-contrastive), 让 encoder 学到"对侧视角下能局部匹配上的身份证据" → mAP 涨。判据 = 涨点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3782:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:61:## 技术方案(已实现, `afd_train.py --ovli`)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3783:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:63:   - ★**proj 是新可学参数**, `OVLIHead.proj`(Conv2d 2048→256), **已加进 optimizer**(`list(model.parameters())+list(ovli.parameters())`, 且有 assert 自检 proj 在 optimizer.param_groups 里)。这是与 OVP(无新参数)的关键结构差异。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:65:2. **opposite-view retrieval loss**(`OVLIHead.loss`): batch 内, anchor(view v)的 positive = 同 pid 的 **opposite-view(1-v)** 样本, negative = 其它 pid 的 opposite-view 样本; **同视角样本完全排除出候选**(纯跨视角目标)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:66:   - `score(i,j) = α·cos(g_i,g_j) + (1-α)·sym_MaxSim(tok_i,tok_j)`, sym_MaxSim = 双向 mean-max `0.5*(mean_u max_s + mean_s max_u)`(对称)。α=0.5。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3786:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:68:3. **★H1 教训(从 OVP 继承)**: `--ovli_warmup`(默认 10)对 λ 线性 warmup, 防随机 proj 早期梯度尖峰。epoch 日志 `OVLI[lam_eff loss pos neg gap]` 监控塌缩/过强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3787:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:70:   - OVLI 是训练期 loss; eval 默认 **global-only 不变**(精确 == baseline)。`--ovli_rerank` 可选额外报 `global + MaxSim` rerank(global 与 rerank 两个数都打印), 用与训练**同一套** proj token + 双向 MaxSim。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3788:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:71:   - OVLI loss 在 `autocast(enabled=False)` 内走**真 fp32**(cos/MaxSim/logsumexp 在 τ=0.05 下要 fp32; proj 也在 fp32 跑), 修了 OVP 审查里"注释说 fp32 但其实在 autocast 内"的 M1。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3789:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:72:   - `--ovli` off 精确复现 baseline(`ovli=None`, OVLIHead 不构造, optimizer 只含 model params)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3790:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:73:   - `--ovp` 与 `--ovli` 互斥(两个不同跨视角机制, 不混跑混淆消融)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3791:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:76:- **#2′ OVLI only 训练**(GPU 空出后): ep10/20/30 vs baseline 同 epoch。OVP ep30 到 39.18, OVLI 至少要进同量级才说明 late-interaction 机制不输 prototype。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3792:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:78:- 消融: α(global vs MaxSim 权重)/ τ / grid(token 数 K)/ λ / proj_dim; OVLI vs OVP 同设置对比(证 late-interaction ≥ prototype 且 novelty 更干净)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3793:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:82:- vs OVP/CMPC/MBCE/PDPA: **无 prototype/memory/EMA**, sample-to-sample late-interaction, 这正是绕开 OVP 撞车的点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3794:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:83:- vs ColBERT/MaxSim(IR/ReID rerank): 我们不是把 MaxSim 当 **test-time rerank**(那是 maxsim_probe kill-switch #1 已做的弱 +0.86), 而是把 opposite-view late-interaction 当 **训练期跨视角监督 loss**(让 encoder 内化局部可匹配证据), eval 默认仍 global-only。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3795:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:85:- 我们的: **cross-view identity evidence as opposite-view late-interaction (partial token-set) retrieval, learned as a training objective**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3796:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:88:- 已写 `OVLIHead`(token proj + 双向 MaxSim + opp-view supcon loss)+ `ovli_rerank_eval`(eval 期 global vs global+MaxSim 双报)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3797:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:89:- **本地隔离 numeric smoke test(导入仓库真实 OVLIHead, 非副本)全过**: token shape (64,32,256) 逐 token L2-norm; sym_MaxSim 对称、self 对角≈1; 正常 batch loss 有限>0 且梯度回流 **proj.weight + global feat**; all-same-view batch loss=0 不崩; 某 pid 无 opp 正样本时该 anchor 被排除、loss 仍有限、grad 有限; fp16 cached map→fp32 token; AdamW 实际推动 proj 权重。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3821:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:8:> **★ 修复确认(2026-06-22, 主 agent)**: H1 训练动力学已修——`afd_train.py` 加 `--ovp_warmup`(默认 10), 对 OVP lambda 做线性 warmup(`ovp_lambda_eff = ovp_lambda·min(1, epoch/ovp_warmup)`), 避免冷启动稀疏 + tau=0.05 的早期梯度尖峰; epoch summary 加 `OVP[lam_eff inited=X/2N]` 日志监控冷启动原型初始化进度。放行条件满足 → **审查通过, 可启动 kill-switch #2 训练**。H2/M5 novelty 撞车(PDPA/CMPC/MBCE)是进稿前 framing 问题(OVP 当组件不当 headline, 用 Local-MaxSim 集合匹配差异化), 不阻断 empirical 涨点训练。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:59:**边缘化有效且明显超普通 TTA（GO 的承重证据）**：K=9 phase-MaxSim 边缘化把 16px mAP 从 42.6→46.9（**+4.23**），而**同 K 同 MaxSim 融合的普通 TTA 只 +1.19**，**LAT-TTA=+3.04**。MaxSim 取 K 中最优本可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，但 TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪只拿 +1.19——**差值证明增益来自 lattice 结构本身，不是 TTA 换名**。双跑一致（run1 +4.25 / LAT-TTA +3.04，run2 +4.23 / LAT-TTA +3.04）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:13:| **DI-REID** (2004.04933) | degradation-invariance learning(学不变性) | ★关键区别:DI 追求**不变性**(抹掉退化);AIRL 追求**可恢复性上界**(承认退化、建模信息损失) |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:23:DI-REID/CRReID 做**对称** resolution-invariance(LR/HR 都拉到不变空间)。AIRL **只退化 ground**(高清地面图 → aerial 像素预算),因为 aerial 已经是低预算、不该再退化。这个非对称性来自 aerial-ground 的物理结构,通用 cross-resolution 没有。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:3:> 脚本: `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py`  机会来源: `litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt` 机会1（信心 7/10）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:7:低分辨率 ReID 失败**不是**"模糊缺细节"，而是**采样格点不确定性**：一个人在 h=16-32px 时 = 一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测（亚像素采样相位 / ±1 LR-pixel bbox 量化 / antialias kernel / 轻微 detector crop error）。模型只见过其中一个。身份匹配应对这族观测**边缘化**，而不是把某个确定性 LR 图当真值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:13:- **K=9 lattice 变体**（每 LR query，从同一 HR 图）：variant0 = 确定性 bicubic LR（= 单图 baseline）；其余轮转覆盖三轴：亚像素相位平移（±0.5 LR 像素的 HR 仿射）、±1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift、bbox expand/contract 1 LR 像素 + kernel 切换（bicubic/bilinear/lanczos/box/hamming）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:17:1. **vs 普通 TTA**：相同 K、相同融合（mean / MaxSim），但 K 个 view 是普通 test-time aug（pad+RandomCrop + hflip）of 单一 bicubic LR，**无 lattice 语义**。phase-lattice 必须明显超过普通 TTA（否则只是 TTA 换名）。MaxSim 对照尤其关键：MaxSim 取 K 中最优可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪 → 差值才是 lattice 特有增益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:27:- K 选 9：覆盖三轴 + variant0 = 单图 baseline（lattice 与 TTA 共享 variant0，保证 baseline 一致）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_resfix.md:19:codex Medium 是 3e-8 浮点 reduction-order 噪声(行为 byte-exact 到 `mean@mean.T`,codex 自己确认 behaviorally correct),Low 是陈旧注释。**均非阻塞**。residual netvlad 确实从 52.37 字节级起步(±3e-8 不影响 mAP),kill-switch 有效。clean netvlad 在 lab-3090 跑(cvpb_setvlad_clean,fix 代码 13 行确认)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:255:- ⚠️ **核心 kill-switch 隐忧**: AIRL 双分支论点 = f_rec(resolution-degradation consistency 训)学到**互补**的 resolvability-aware 表示, 融合后 ≥+1.0。ep10 两头**坍缩成同一表示**, 无互补证据可融。oracle 预言 +1.46, 实测 +0.06。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:274:- **机制层面已定**: f_rec(resolution-degradation consistency 训)≈ f_full 的冗余拷贝, consistency loss 没切出独立的 resolvability-aware 表示, 只是轻微正则了同一表示。两头坍缩 → 软融合无互补证据可融, 且 w=0.25 blend 主动稀释 rec 那点微弱增益。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:280:- **发现并行 rescue 实验**: 用户读到 ep10/20 弱信号后已启动 `cvpb_airl_iso`（`--airl_dualbranch_iso --airl_iso_stage 3`）—— **梯度隔离救援**: f_rec = 独立 late Swin stage(14185392 params, 28 tensors) 从 **detach 的 trunk** 分叉, consistency 梯度永不回到共享 trunk, clean trunk+f_full 保持干净, f_rec 专学 recover 极。正是针对"两头坍缩"失败模式的修复。out_dir `cvpb_airl_iso`, log `/tmp/cvpb_airl_iso.log`。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3655:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:1:# 实验 CVPB: CARGO 航拍-地面 跨视角原型桥接 + 局部证据匹配
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3656:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:3:> 战略重思后选定(5 死角后, 3 codex strat 强收敛)。★★方法论转向: **放弃"验证 confound 是真依赖"(杀光一切), 改 empirical 涨点导向**——在 CARGO baseline 上试 +module 能否 beat = 真 kill-switch。这是 167 篇库真实配方(命名 gap + 2 模块 + 多数据集 SOTA 表 + framing)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:6:- CARGO 航拍-地面 baseline(resnet50 BoT)mean A↔G mAP **32.48%**, VDT SOTA ~50% → **大 headroom**。AGPReID 活赛道(VDT CVPR24 / SeCap CVPR25 / GSAlign NeurIPS25 / ViSA CVPR26), 范式都是"命名视角/几何/语义 gap + 2 模块 + CARGO/AG-ReID 表", **不证 confound 依赖**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3658:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:17:1. **零训练 token-MaxSim probe**(最便宜, 先跑): CARGO baseline checkpoint 抽 feature map, 测 `global cosine` vs `global + 局部 MaxSim hybrid` 的 A↔G mAP。**+0.5~1.0 mAP** = 局部匹配有料 → 继续。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3659:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:34:- CARGO(lab-3090 现成)。补 AG-ReID.v2 多数据集表。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3660:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:38:- strat_3: Camera Residual TTA(source-free open-camera test-time adaptation, Market→MSMT/CARGO OOD, 贴 DART3/TEMP)——OOD 方向, 也绕开那堵墙。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3661:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:39:- strat_1: CARGO View-Conditioned Token Evidence Matching(和本方案 module2 同源)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3673:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:4:**审查对象**: `experiments/cargo_cvpb/{design.md, afd_train.py, maxsim_probe.py}` + 对照 `experiments/afd_reid/{afd_train.py, afd_model.py, cargo_dataset.py}`
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3674:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:12:OVP-Mem 的工程实现是**正确且不会崩**的：无 NaN/inf 路径、梯度隔离干净(bank 是 buffer 不回传)、dtype 一致、`--ovp` off 精确复现 baseline。kill-switch #1(maxsim probe)已 PASS(+0.86)且 pipeline 复现 32.48 准确。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3677:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:32:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` `OVPMemory.loss` L124-148；冷启动门控 L130-139；`tau` 默认 L190。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3678:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:34:- **后果**: 第 1(几)个 epoch OVP 实际不产生有效监督，但 `meters['ovp']`(L292/301)打印接近 0，**会被误读为"已收敛"**；kill-switch #2 的"ep10 ≥+1.0"判读因此失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3679:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:37:  a. 给 `ovp_lambda` 或 `tau` 加 **warmup**(例如前 N 个 epoch λ=0 只填 bank、或 tau 从 0.2 退火到 0.05)，避开随机原型尖峰；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3680:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:45:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` L272 注释 + L273-274；`ovp.loss` 内 L141 `z @ protos.t()`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3681:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:46:- **事实**: `ovp.loss(...)` 整个调用在 `with torch.amp.autocast('cuda')`(L260)**上下文内**。`torch.matmul/mm` 在 autocast fp16 op 列表上，即便 `z=F.normalize(bn.float())` 是 fp32，matmul 仍可能被 autocast 降为 fp16。`cross_entropy` 在 fp32 列表上会被升回 fp32，所以 softmax 安全。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3682:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:62:- **事实**: 我已用 `importlib.util.find_spec` 实测：以 `python3 afd_train.py` 在 `cargo_cvpb/` 运行时，主脚本是 `__main__`，`import afd_train` 命中 `afd_reid/afd_train.py`(✓ 文档命令正确)。**但**这依赖"脚本运行"这一前提：若有人 `cd` 到别处用绝对路径跑、或把本文件当模块 `import`，`sys.path` 顺序可能变，`import afd_train` 有撞回自身的风险(循环 import)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:63:- **建议**: 低成本加固——把导入改成显式包名(如建个 `__init__.py` 或用 `importlib` 按文件路径加载)，或在 README/run 命令处明确"必须 `cd cargo_cvpb && python3 afd_train.py`"。**当前文档命令安全**，故仅 Medium。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:68:  - **CMPC(CVPR22)**：per-cluster per-modality 原型 + momentum + InfoNCE 把实例拉向**对侧模态**同身份原型、推开其它——与 OVP-Mem loss 近乎逐字同构。差异仅 voice-face↔aerial-ground、无监督↔有监督。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3685:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:69:  - **MBCE(AAAI23, VI-ReID)**：modality-aware centroid proxies + momentum memory + cross-modality 对齐——同构，且已在 person ReID 发表。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:71:  - **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)**：已声称"aerial-ground 上 per-perspective prototype alignment + memory bank"，**命名与 framing 已被占**(机制不同：prompt 驱动 + 可学习原型 + 中间空间 bank，故非完全相同)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3687:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:73:- **要求**: 这是 empirical 探索，跑可以；但**进方法稿前**(design.md L19 的"≥35-36→进方法稿")必须把 OVP-Mem **降级为 auxiliary loss**，真正的 novelty 由别处承担（子代理建议看 Module-2 non-correspondence local set-matching，撞车面更小）。**否则违反 CLAUDE.md 创新门槛 + "不在旧 branch 堆小模块"**。建议在 design.md 显式记一句"OVP-Mem 已知与 CMPC/MBCE/PDPA 高度重叠，仅作 empirical 组件，不作 headline"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3688:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:85:### L3.（已确认正确）`--ovp` off 精确复现 baseline
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:86:ovp=False 时 `ovp=None`、`OVPMemory` **根本不构造**，forward 调用、`loss=ce+tri`、optimizer.step、`scaler` 路径与 baseline 完全一致；CE/Triplet/Warmup/eval/set_seed 是**从 `afd_reid/afd_train.py` import 的同一份**(byte-identical by construction)。baseline 可复现性不破坏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3690:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:92:OVP 仅 buffer、无可学习参数，`AdamW(model.parameters())`(L236)不需也不应加 ovp.parameters()。`ovp.to(device)` 让 buffer 落在 cuda，单 GPU 正确。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3691:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:100:### L8.（已确认正确）maxsim_probe 排序符号一致
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3692:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:101:`maxsim_probe.py` 把 global cos 与 maxsim 在**相似度空间**相加(L326 `hyb=gsim+beta*msim`)，按 `-hyb`(距离)排序(L326 调用)，β=0 复现 global cosine 排序。注释 L19-38 已显式说明"不把 distance 与 similarity 混加"。逻辑自洽，且实测 β=0 复现 32.48。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3693:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:110:4. **[M5]** 在 design.md 显式记录 OVP-Mem 与 CMPC/MBCE/PDPA 的重叠，限定其为 empirical 组件、非 headline。— **进方法稿前强制**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3674:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:12:OVP-Mem 的工程实现是**正确且不会崩**的：无 NaN/inf 路径、梯度隔离干净(bank 是 buffer 不回传)、dtype 一致、`--ovp` off 精确复现 baseline。kill-switch #1(maxsim probe)已 PASS(+0.86)且 pipeline 复现 32.48 准确。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4284:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4285:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4291:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3687:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:73:- **要求**: 这是 empirical 探索，跑可以；但**进方法稿前**(design.md L19 的"≥35-36→进方法稿")必须把 OVP-Mem **降级为 auxiliary loss**，真正的 novelty 由别处承担（子代理建议看 Module-2 non-correspondence local set-matching，撞车面更小）。**否则违反 CLAUDE.md 创新门槛 + "不在旧 branch 堆小模块"**。建议在 design.md 显式记一句"OVP-Mem 已知与 CMPC/MBCE/PDPA 高度重叠，仅作 empirical 组件，不作 headline"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4322:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3815:### H1. OVP loss 早期结构性零梯度 + tau=0.05 尖峰（训练动力学，必须处理）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4323:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3816:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` `OVPMemory.loss` L124-148；冷启动门控 L130-139；`tau` 默认 L190。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4324:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3818:- **后果**: 第 1(几)个 epoch OVP 实际不产生有效监督，但 `meters['ovp']`(L292/301)打印接近 0，**会被误读为"已收敛"**；kill-switch #2 的"ep10 ≥+1.0"判读因此失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4325:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3819:- **另一面**: `tau=0.05` 把 cos∈[-1,1] 拉到 logits∈[-20,20]。当 ≥2 列有效且原型(EMA of 1-4 样本，L103)还很 noisy 时，若 own 不是 argmax，CE 梯度极尖 → 训练初期对 encoder 注入大梯度。整体 OVP 行为**双峰**(退化≈0 / 尖峰)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4326:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3822:  b. **日志增强**：每 iter 额外打印"本 iter 真正贡献 OVP 的样本数 / 有效 opp 列数"，让 monitor.md 能区分"退化 0"与"收敛 0"。按本仓库铁律"日志必须够重(能观察模块塌缩/过强/过弱)"，这一条**强制**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4327:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3828:### M1. autocast 可能把 OVP matmul 下溢到 fp16，注释"fp32 for numerical safety"不成立
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4328:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3832:- **建议**: 要么把 OVP loss 包进 `with torch.amp.autocast('cuda', enabled=False):`(在 `.float()` 之后)真正走 fp32；要么把注释改成"autocast 下 matmul 可能 fp16，但无溢出"，不要给读代码的人错误保证。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4329:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3839:### M3. OVP loss 用 `total/count` 按"视角组"等权，而非按 batch 样本均值
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4330:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3842:- **评级**: 这看起来是有意的对称设计(两视角方向平权)，可接受，但与朴素"对所有 OVP 贡献样本求均值"不同。**建议在 design.md/注释中显式声明**这是 per-direction 平权，避免日后对 λ 标定产生困惑。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4331:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3852:  - **CMPC(CVPR22)**：per-cluster per-modality 原型 + momentum + InfoNCE 把实例拉向**对侧模态**同身份原型、推开其它——与 OVP-Mem loss 近乎逐字同构。差异仅 voice-face↔aerial-ground、无监督↔有监督。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4363:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — CVPB (OVP-Mem) 启动前广范围审查
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4364:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:12:OVP-Mem 的工程实现是**正确且不会崩**的：无 NaN/inf 路径、梯度隔离干净(bank 是 buffer 不回传)、dtype 一致、`--ovp` off 精确复现 baseline。kill-switch #1(maxsim probe)已 PASS(+0.86)且 pipeline 复现 32.48 准确。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4365:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4366:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4367:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:31:### H1. OVP loss 早期结构性零梯度 + tau=0.05 尖峰（训练动力学，必须处理）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4368:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:32:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` `OVPMemory.loss` L124-148；冷启动门控 L130-139；`tau` 默认 L190。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4369:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:34:- **后果**: 第 1(几)个 epoch OVP 实际不产生有效监督，但 `meters['ovp']`(L292/301)打印接近 0，**会被误读为"已收敛"**；kill-switch #2 的"ep10 ≥+1.0"判读因此失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:35:- **另一面**: `tau=0.05` 把 cos∈[-1,1] 拉到 logits∈[-20,20]。当 ≥2 列有效且原型(EMA of 1-4 样本，L103)还很 noisy 时，若 own 不是 argmax，CE 梯度极尖 → 训练初期对 encoder 注入大梯度。整体 OVP 行为**双峰**(退化≈0 / 尖峰)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4371:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:38:  b. **日志增强**：每 iter 额外打印"本 iter 真正贡献 OVP 的样本数 / 有效 opp 列数"，让 monitor.md 能区分"退化 0"与"收敛 0"。按本仓库铁律"日志必须够重(能观察模块塌缩/过强/过弱)"，这一条**强制**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4372:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:44:### M1. autocast 可能把 OVP matmul 下溢到 fp16，注释"fp32 for numerical safety"不成立
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:48:- **建议**: 要么把 OVP loss 包进 `with torch.amp.autocast('cuda', enabled=False):`(在 `.float()` 之后)真正走 fp32；要么把注释改成"autocast 下 matmul 可能 fp16，但无溢出"，不要给读代码的人错误保证。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
