experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9625:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18199:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18810:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9717:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19337:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20396:| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9746:d17 现在不该直接替代 LM-ReID。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:21:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:45:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“找更强的外观/形状特征”改成“让衣服线索失效，并强迫模型使用非衣服的人体语义”。关键词是 `visual shielding`、`clothing-irrelevant feature`、`human semantic attention`、`potential consistency`。语义像素替换已有先例，SAVS 的差异是把语义前景注意力和衣服屏蔽一致性联合起来。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08387?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11522?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:121:2. 重定义动作：他们把“保存旧知识和学习新知识”改写成“最大化域内判别和最小化域间 gap 的权衡”。关键词是 `domain consistency representation`、`global and attribute-wise representations`、`bridge`、`intra-domain discrimination`、`inter-domain gaps`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:236:**重定义动作：** 它把问题从“ReID 需要语言监督”推进成“全身级语言监督不足以约束局部语义一致性”。关键词是 within-part semantic inconsistency、part-informed visual-language learning、pixel-level text prompts、fine-grained image-text alignment。它还补了一层冲突定义：human parsing 是身份无关的，而 ReID 要身份相关判别，直接用 parsing 会和身份学习冲突。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:331:2. **重定义动作**：作者把“黑盒攻击迁移差”重定义为“早期攻击阶段的梯度一致性不足”。关键词是 global aggregated gradient、gradient consistency、pre-convergence、weighted gradient。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:333:4. **证据闭环**：Fig. 3 先证明旧方法早期 gradient consistency 低。update direction 消融比较 current gradient、GAG 和 weighted gradient，weighted gradient 最好。inner iteration 数 m 和噪声边界 beta 的实验展示存在合理区间，不是随便加算力。黑盒、白盒、ensemble、防御模型、跨模态 ReID 都验证有效，检索可视化显示 adversarial query 会让 top-10 全错。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:478:2. 重定义动作：他们把 VI-ReID 从“模态差异问题”改写成“跨模态、跨粒度的对齐问题”。关键词是 global-patch-pixel、multi-granularity、saliency consistency、cross-granularity alignment、nearest-neighbor clustering。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:672:2. 重定义动作：旧问题是“局部细节不够”；新问题是“多粒度特征之间缺少显式语义对齐”。这一步很强，因为它把多粒度从“多加几个特征”提升为“不同粒度之间需要保持同一个身份语义”。关键词是 explicit alignment、semantic consistency、multi-granularity collaborative constraint、center-constrained filtering、within-sample alignment。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:859:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何关注可见区域”改写成“如何补全缺失身份线索”。关键词是 `completion perspective rather than discarding`、`cross-modality feature completion`、`token-level completion`、`region-level completion`、`multi-distribution consistency`。这一步很关键，它把旧问题里的“遮挡鲁棒特征提取”升级成“遮挡 VI-ReID 的跨模态补全”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1022:2. **重定义动作**：它把“退化域偏移”改写成“混合退化下的双重错位”。第一层是多个退化造成多个中心偏移，第二层是同一身份在特征空间里的几何关系被扭曲。关键词是 `mixed degradation`、`heterogeneity gap`、`multiple centroid shifts`、`distorted topology`、`structural consistency`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1036:2. **重定义动作**：它把噪声样本从“需要丢掉的坏样本”改写成“可以被历史预测逐步纠正的潜在有效样本”。同时把训练波动从坏现象改写成信息来源。关键词是 `self-rectification`、`historical consistency`、`early learning`、`momentum-updated memories`、`coupled noisy labels`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1050:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“去衣服偏置”改写成“在保持语义完整性的前提下，学习语义一致特征并量化衣服偏置”。关键词是 `semantic consistency`、`semantic integrity`、`head soft attention`、`clothing bias`、`causal intervention`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1099:3. 机制怎么长出来：先加 background token，把前景身份和背景分开。SFA 随机替换背景 token，要求身份分类不变。TFA 插入其他身份的帧特征，训练 AFD 找异常帧。测试时不做增广，把 AFD 学到的能力转成 frame consistency score 来加权视频表征。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1100:4. 证据闭环：组件消融显示 BG、空间增广、时间增广、refine 都有贡献。iLIDS-VID 从 91.3 R1 到 95.3，MARS-DL 也稳定提升。跨数据集 MARS-DL 到 iLIDS 从 45.3 到 50.0，说明不是只记住训练集。可视化显示 class token 看人，background token 看背景，consistency score 会压低遮挡和姿态突变帧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1263:2. 重定义动作：他们把问题从“光照归一化不够好”重定义为“统一光照转换器在多光照输入下低频建模能力不足”。关键词是 Unified Lighting Transformer、low-frequency information、discriminative feature spectrum consistency、low-frequency information constraints。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1403:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1438:2. 重定义动作：作者把“生成更多图”重定义为“给同一身份生成不同姿态、且保持 ReID 身份嵌入一致的训练数据”。关键词是 Identity Diffuser、identity-specific embedding、target pose heatmap、identity consistency、synthetic pretraining。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1462:2. 重定义动作：标题已经在重定义：“不要只讲 geometry，texture 才是 3D ReID 的关键”。进一步把解释性从事后可视化改成检索信号。关键词是 UVTexture、canonical viewpoint、viewpoint-invariant explanation、Intersection-Alignment Score、explainable re-ranking。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1629:2. 重定义动作：他们没有把问题讲成“再做一个跨模态对齐损失”，而是讲成“四个异质空间没有被同时居中”：可见图像、红外图像、可见文本、红外文本。关键词是 `separable text description`、`modality centering`、`identity-aware`、`modality-aware`、`semantic consistency`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1665:2. 重定义动作：它把伪标签验证从“点对点相似度”重定义为“高阶图结构一致性”。关键词是 `circular topology structure`、`cycle-aware`、`graph-enhanced memory`、`global feature memory`、`camera-aware consistency`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1667:3. 机制怎么长出来：CATS 用 kNN 图和矩阵幂找闭环路径，并用 circular consistency loss 约束闭环节点；DCAM-ViT 在多 class token 上做跨模态注意力；GSMEM 用队列 memory 和自适应 kNN 图做跨 batch 传播；CARC 用相机内聚类和全局相似度联合过滤冲突样本。CATS 和“拓扑闭环”绑定较紧，其余模块更像是围绕四个失败来源各补一块。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:23:机制草案：plate-causal consistency。检测 plate 区域后，对原图、plate blur、plate erase、plate replacement 做一致性训练；加一个 plate-attention penalty，禁止最终 embedding 依赖 plate patch；另设 non-plate fine-detail branch 挖车身局部证据。若 plate 被遮后同车型同色车确实不可区分，则方法允许输出候选集/不确定性，而不是假装 rank-1 可解。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1572:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:59:**边缘化有效且明显超普通 TTA（GO 的承重证据）**：K=9 phase-MaxSim 边缘化把 16px mAP 从 42.6→46.9（**+4.23**），而**同 K 同 MaxSim 融合的普通 TTA 只 +1.19**，**LAT-TTA=+3.04**。MaxSim 取 K 中最优本可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，但 TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪只拿 +1.19——**差值证明增益来自 lattice 结构本身，不是 TTA 换名**。双跑一致（run1 +4.25 / LAT-TTA +3.04，run2 +4.23 / LAT-TTA +3.04）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1616:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1617:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1618:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2744:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1619:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2774:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1907:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:6:如果训练版 `LM-ReID + K marginalization` 能在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble 再高 **+0.8 到 +2.0 mAP**，并且 h=24 仍有稳定收益，信心到 **8/10**。如果只停留在零训练 ensemble，最多 **5/10**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1908:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:10:名字建议：**Lattice-Marginalized ReID, LM-ReID**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:146:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1966:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:1426:./reviews/deep_28.md:6930:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3866:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:1:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3889:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:5:**范围**: `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 全文 + `design.md` + 模型接口源码验证 + 与 frozen baseline 的对照隔离
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3895:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:4:No Critical runtime/shape/device bug found, but I would not launch this as-is because two training-design issues can invalidate exp359.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3903:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3917:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:65:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4037:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3018:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4071:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4078:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4488:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5782:./reassess/r_3.md:3108:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3322:./validate/v_3.md:15165:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4490:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1911:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:62:2. fine-tune 阶段从 HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4491:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1912:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:63:3. 每张图每 iter 采样 `M=2-4` 个 lattice variants，周期性或 eval 用完整 `K=9`。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4492:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1915:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:93:5. lattice variants 固定 K=9，主实验用 3x3 phase；bbox jitter/kernel variants 做 ablation，不要无限扩 K。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4597:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4600:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4602:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4603:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4604:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4606:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4657:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4059:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:23:DI-REID/CRReID 做**对称** resolution-invariance(LR/HR 都拉到不变空间)。AIRL **只退化 ground**(高清地面图 → aerial 像素预算),因为 aerial 已经是低预算、不该再退化。这个非对称性来自 aerial-ground 的物理结构,通用 cross-resolution 没有。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:733:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7569:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:808:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:7402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:14:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:833:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:834:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1236:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

(b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:857:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1261:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1447:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4215:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:13:训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1448:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:22:- **⚠️ market 约束（codex 警告）**：market 图是已裁好的人框，无原图上下文 → 要先 **pad crops 人工制造 bbox 不确定性**，否则 refiner 没有可校正的 support 偏移。这是 BLC 在 market 上先天降到 6.5 的原因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1449:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4217:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:27:- 失败最可能原因：(a) STN 学偏 / 裁掉身体边缘 / 过拟合检测框（→ 加 offset 范围 + identity loss + grid reg）；(b) market pad-crop 制造的不确定性不真实 → spread 降但 mAP 不涨（直接杀）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1450:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4218:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:45:压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1451:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4219:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1452:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4220:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1453:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4221:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1462:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4230:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:78:## ★salvage（2026-06-25 codex 后）：LM-ReID 没全死，是 consistency 版死了
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1464:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4232:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:111:- 强化 test-time decision-marginalization 故事。下一步 LM-S3（logsumexp 聚合）/ LM-S4（phase/bbox/kernel 因子）+ 更强 TTA baseline（kill-switch make_tta_variants 加 color/resize）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4234:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:116:novelty：无 exact prior（sampling-lattice as LR-ReID hidden variable + marginalization）；BlurPool(aliasing)/FlipReID(flip consistency) 是相关先例；"consistency 有害"不单独成 paper 但强消融卖点。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1467:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4235:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:129:- **LSRC（backbone set-loss，bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail，4090 lam0.5 full fine-tune）死**：训练 acc 1.000 过拟合训练集，测试全掉，backbone 被训坏（HR sanity 掉 3 点）。marginalization 在受损 backbone 上仍 +2.288（证机制本身没问题，是 backbone 被训坏）。**asym 不用试**（对称 M×M 给 gallery-side oracle = 宽松上界，对称死→非对称必死）。3090 lam1.0 必死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1469:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4237:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:143:- **K=5 已达 87% 收益（79.61≈79.90）**，K=3 中等（53%）。compute-accuracy 边际递减 → 论文"防 compute"论点：K=5 性价比高（省 4/9 compute 保 87% 收益），K=9 完整。marginalization 的 compute 可调，K=5 是 sweet spot。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1470:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4238:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:155:- **soft decision marginalization（logsumexp，LM-ReID 公式 s=τlog[1/KΣexp(cos/τ)]）在 severe LR（h12/16）最优**；mild LR（h≥20）hard-max 略超。三种聚合都 >> single；decision-level（max/logsumexp）≥ embedding-mean（h≥16）。差距虽小（±0.3）但完整 controlled ablation，logsumexp 是理论 motivated 的 sweet spot。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1494:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4262:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:13:- **因子分解（LM-S4）**: bbox 检测框 crop 不确定性主导（+2.84）> sub-pixel phase（+1.76）> zoom（+1.70）。→ mechanism = LR detector crop lattice，直观且新。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1495:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4263:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:19:**Latent-Lattice 协议**：把 LR query 建模为格点隐变量 z 上的观测 p(x_LR|HR,z)，检索决策对 z **边缘化** `s(q,g) ≈ logmeanexp_k sim(f(x_q^{z_k}), f(x_g))`。这把审稿人的"strong TTA/ensemble"质疑改成精确反驳：**普通 TTA 的 K 个增广没覆盖正确隐变量 z（acquisition lattice），我们的 K 是 lattice 积分的蒙特卡洛近似**——LM-S2-strong 实证（强 TTA 全 5 分辨率输给 lattice marginalization，severe LR 处强 TTA 本身有害）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1496:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4264:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:21:**诚实边界（σ-sweep 界定，关键不 over-claim）**：framing 严格成立于 **sub-pixel sampling lattice**（小精确格点扰动）；真实检测器大 localization error（σ~0.5-1.0 LR-px）下 marginalization 衰减甚至有害（σ-sweep h12 marg +5.49→+2.18→−5.85 单调衰减到负）。即机制是**采集格点边缘化、不是 detector 鲁棒性**。真实 detector-calibrated 验证需有原图数据集（CUHK-SYSU/PoseTrack），留未来——这也是 6.5（非 7.0）的诚实原因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1497:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4265:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:25:2. **方法（test-time）**: 决策级 lattice marginalization（K 变体 + mean/max/logsumexp 聚合），并证明 **decision-level marginalization > training-level invariance**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1499:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4267:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:40:4. **input canonicalization 被数据封住**: canonicalize bbox（主因子 +2.84）< marginalize 它，market 框已 canonical→退化 single。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1500:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4268:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:44:- **LM-S3 聚合消融**: mean/max/logsumexp（h12 73.01/h16 80.28），**soft decision marginalization（logsumexp）severe LR 最优**，三者都 >> single；decision-level（max/logsumexp）≥ embedding-mean（h≥16）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1501:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4269:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:45:- **backbone 泛化**: Swin-small market，LATTICE−strong-TTA +0.78~3.16（h16/20 +3.06/+3.16）→ 机制不依赖 SOLIDER backbone。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1503:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4271:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:49:## 冲 7.0 尝试 → 诚实界定（codex push7 路径，detector 腿失败）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1504:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4272:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:50:- codex push7 给冲 7.0 路径（6/10）：detector-calibrated bbox jitter 下机制成立 + 跨数据集 + adaptive-K + 协议化。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1505:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4273:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:51:- **detector-jitter σ-sweep（关键负结果，诚实诊断）**: 均匀 ±1 离散格点 → 连续 Gaussian center+scale（模拟检测器 localization error），h12 marg gain **+5.49（σ=0）→ +3.68（σ=0.25）→ +2.18（σ=0.5 真实 detector）→ −5.85（σ=1.0）**。marginalization 增益随 detector 误差单调衰减、大误差下有害。kill-switch③（h12/16/20 ≥+2）在真实 detector σ~0.5-1.0 下不过。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1506:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4274:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:52:- **→ 冲 7.0 失败，6.5 是天花板**。但 σ-sweep 是**有价值的诚实诊断**：机制是 **sub-pixel sampling-lattice 边缘化（小精确扰动），不是对大 detector 框误差的鲁棒性**。Discussion 诚实界定范围（market 图无原图无法真实 detector-calibrate；真实 detector 框需 CUHK-SYSU/PoseTrack 等有原图数据集，留未来）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1507:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4275:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:56:- TTA（k-reciprocal CVPR17 进 SOTA / FlipReID / BNTA）: test-time 后处理可发先例；我们是 lattice-specific marginalization 非通用 TTA。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1508:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:58:- Alignment（STN/AlignedReID/STNReID/PAN/CDPM）: 若用 B LC-STN，卖点是"LR crop lattice 当隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1509:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4277:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:63:- 补齐 K-sweep/跨数据集/MLR/真实 detector jitter: **6.5/10**（扎实问题重定义稿，B 类有机会，非稳）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1510:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4278:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:11:- **High**：train/test marginalization 不对齐。训练 `sim4` 是双边 M×M LR-lattice bag-to-bag；test 是 query-LR-K变体 × gallery-HR-单图。对称训练给正样本 gallery-side oracle、给负样本 test 不存在的 gallery-side worst-pair 约束。建议非对称 `LR-query set → gallery single`，或至少加该对照。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1511:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4279:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:18:没见"LR-ReID 把 sampling lattice 明确当 hidden variable 做 lattice decision marginalization"的直接先例。set contrastive/logsumexp bag score 本身不新（SupCon/MIL-NCE/set-ReID），novelty 只能落在 **sampling-lattice hidden variable + retrieval decision marginalization** 问题定义。不能声称发现 aliasing 本身（anti-aliasing 强先例）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1512:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4280:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1515:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4283:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1516:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4284:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1517:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4285:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1545:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4313:experiments/exp359_lm24:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4612:./reassess/r_3.md:7808:./reassess/r_3.md:2352:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_3.txt:29:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21331:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2326:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4615:./reassess/r_3.md:7829:./reassess/r_3.md:2469:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_24.md:403:审查只拦实质问题：代码正确性的错误、数据泄漏、评测协议前后不一致、变量没隔离干净、比较不公平。操作上、文档上的小问题，可以记成待办，但不要拦。结论写进 `experiments/expNNN/review-codex.md`。通过时要明确写“无实质问题”“approve”“审查通过”或“放行”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4625:./reassess/r_3.md:7867:./reassess/r_3.md:2890:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1062:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21333:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2346:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4635:./reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4643:./reassess/r_3.md:7956:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21335:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2354:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4645:./reassess/r_3.md:7958:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21336:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2357:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4824:./reassess/r_3.md:9614:analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21538:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1766:reassess/r_3.md:3895:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3386:我会优先押第 1 个和第 2 个。它们的问题层面更清楚，也最能把团队的 aerial-ground 和 SMPL 基建变成别人不容易复刻的机制。第 3 个有潜力，但依赖视频或稳定 SMPL 质量。第 4 个成本最低，适合作为辅助机制，不适合单独当 B 类主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21540:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21541:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21542:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21546:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1845:reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21558:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3107:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4158:reassess/r_2.md:1001:reassess/r_3.md:1960:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:21:ROLES[2]="角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21570:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3179:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4232:reassess/r_2.md:1237:reassess/r_3.md:2775:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:26:角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21572:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3181:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4234:reassess/r_2.md:1241:reassess/r_3.md:2779:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:45:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21575:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3189:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4242:reassess/r_2.md:1264:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。
