experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21583:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4321:reassess/r_2.md:1602:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21585:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4332:reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21586:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4339:reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21587:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4340:reassess/r_2.md:1656:reassess/r_3.md:3665:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:687:target individuals among multiple non-overlapping camera viewpoints.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21588:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3332:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4385:reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21599:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3387:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5022:reassess/r_3.md:2759:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6450:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报最终涨点，而是分别证明 DMM 和 CDCN 的角色。消融显示 DMM 提升抗遗忘但会牺牲适应性，CDCN 提升适应性并改善记忆，二者组合互相补偿。另一个关键证据是 DMM 只放在重放阶段最好，放在适应阶段会污染相机认知节点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21600:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5026:reassess/r_3.md:2775:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:26:角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21602:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3393:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5028:reassess/r_3.md:2779:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:45:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21610:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5101:reassess/r_3.md:3209:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4519:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3551:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5186:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21636:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21637:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3693:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5337:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21640:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3731:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5388:reassess/r_3.md:4324:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_5.md:9761:../design.md:40:- **#2 OVP-Mem 训练完成: 🎯 final 50.11 mAP(R1 54.93)@ep60, baseline 32.48 → +17.6, 达 VDT SOTA~50!** 轨迹 28.35→36.32→39.18→43.83→48.76→50.11。在 resnet50 BoT(弱于 VDT 的 ViT)上做到 SOTA 量级。★**方向铁证金矿**(代码双审无泄漏: 原型训练期/eval 测试 pid 不相交; +17.6 达 SOTA 待用户多 seed 复核)。但 OVP 撞 CMPC → **headline 走 OVLI**(见下), OVP 降为强 ablation。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21694:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21706:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21708:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21710:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21711:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21712:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21713:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3889:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:5:**范围**: `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 全文 + `design.md` + 模型接口源码验证 + 与 frozen baseline 的对照隔离
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21714:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21715:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21716:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21717:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21718:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21719:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3895:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:4:No Critical runtime/shape/device bug found, but I would not launch this as-is because two training-design issues can invalidate exp359.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21720:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21721:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21722:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21723:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21725:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21741:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3917:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:65:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21742:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21743:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21744:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21745:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21746:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21747:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21748:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21749:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21750:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21751:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21752:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3928:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:121:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22048:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4544:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22049:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22060:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4556:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3030:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1879:reassess/r_3.md:4279:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21900:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22098:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22107:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4603:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22109:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22110:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4606:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22112:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22161:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4657:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4059:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:973:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12947:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14191:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:1787:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_3.md:556:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15959:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3811:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:4:文献侧支持“训练值得一试”。Hubness 本来就是高维 kNN/检索空间里的结构性问题，HAL 在 text-image matching 中明确用 local/global hub 统计和 memory bank 做训练端 hubness-aware loss，并报告 R@1 大幅提升；这说明“训练时改 embedding 分布”比事后惩罚分数有现实先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097)) NeighborRetr 也把 cross-modal retrieval 的 hubness 从 post-hoc normalization 推到 training-time balancing，并强调 bad hubs / good hubs 的区分。([github.com](https://github.com/zzezze/NeighborRetr))

   194	- **marginalization 增益随 detector 误差 σ 单调衰减**。codex kill-switch③（h12/16/20 都 ≥+2）**确定不过**：σ=0.25（理想）h20 不过，σ=0.5（真实 detector localization error ~0.5-1.0 LR-px）h16/20 都不过。
   195	- **→ 冲 7.0 的 detector 腿失败，LM-ReID 诚实定位 6.5。** 但 σ-sweep 是**有价值的诚实诊断**：精确界定机制范围 = **sub-pixel sampling-lattice 边缘化（小精确扰动），不是对大 detector 框误差的鲁棒性**。论文 Discussion 用这个诚实界定（比硬吹 7.0 扎实）。
   196	- 6.5 后续（巩固泛化非冲 7.0）：跨数据集 MSMT17（kill-switch②）+ adaptive-K（compute）+ paper 6.5 定位写作。
   197	
   198	### [2026-06-26] 跨数据集 MSMT17 = 止损（config 配对深坑）
   199	
   200	参数化 cvpb 加 `--dataset msmt17`（msmt17_split 读 list 文件）+ `--semantic_weight` override。**msmt17_split 数据读取完全正确**（q 11659/g 82161 标准 count，pid 0-3059 同空间，img 存在，q⊂g）。但 **MSMT17 ckpt 的 model config 配对是深坑**：正确 config `swin_small_pose.yml` 已被删（缺失），现有 `pose_backbone_psg_small.yml`（sw=0.2）/swin_small.yml（baseline 无 pose_dict 报错）都不匹配 ckpt 训练（sw=0.6 + pose-mul-scale0.3 + llw0.7）；SANITY 持续 2.67~4.29（特征垃圾，非数据问题）。**止损留用户**（用正确 config 或重训），不无限 debug 缺失 config。
   201	
   202	**→ 跨数据集（kill-switch②第二维度）做不了；但 backbone 泛化（Swin market +3）已是一个泛化维度，且冲 7.0 已失败（detector 腿），跨数据集对 6.5 是 nice-to-have 非必需。LM-ReID 诚实定位 6.5（核心齐 + 训练端反例 + backbone 泛化 + σ-sweep 机制范围界定）。**
   203	
   204	### [2026-06-26] adaptive-K（最后 supporting，中性）
   205	
   206	per-query phase volatility（median 阈值）选 K：高 vol marginalize K=9，低 vol K=1，avg_K=5（56% compute）。

   210	| 12 | 66.79 | 70.76 | 72.01 | 76% |

   167	experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:53:- 关键：FIXED_BANDS 的 GT 是**对所有图相同的固定竖直 band 布局**（与图像内容/真实姿态无关）。于是该项在 w=0.5 + 全量 backbone 梯度下，逼 backbone 产出「CLIP 跨注意力匹配固定 canonical 分块」的空间特征——在遮挡数据上（真实部位常缺失/位移），可能逼 backbone 幻想出与实际遮挡内容矛盾的 canonical 结构，**有损判别性**。这是本变体最大的科学风险，design.md 仅泛泛写「un-detach 扰动/退化」，未点名这条「固定先验正则化 backbone」的具体路径。
   168	experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:54:- 稳定性不受影响：exp340 审查已验证 canonical GT 不触发 NaN（峰值 1.0、无全零通道、bg `clamp(min=0)`、KL `clamp(min=-30)`+`isfinite` 双守卫），这些守卫在 detach 上游，un-detach 下依旧生效——**非 crash 风险**。

  1155	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1592:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3591:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5433:reassess/r_3.md:4542:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
  1156	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3597:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5451:reassess/r_3.md:4735:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:252:**结论：FM-import 方法猎彻底关闭（MLLM/frozen/换源/LoRA-standalone/LoRA-fusion 全负，各有机制）。** large(15h dead-end) 已 kill。**夜间 useful 产出 = `fm_occluded_reid_study.md` 诊断研究（含张力洞察 + ×4 finding + 可复用 oracle 工具）**——一个诚实、证据扎实、对领域有用的 analysis 贡献（劝退+量化+解释"搬通用 FM 赢 occluded ReID"这个诱人方向）。
  1157	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1594:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3598:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5452:reassess/r_3.md:4736:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:269:- **诚实定位**：exp324d 是**有价值的 building block / 正向诊断证据**（"frozen FM 不行但 LoRA-adapted FM 能把 occluded 部位匹配做到 competitive-ish"），不是 standalone strong-venue 方法。其最大论文价值是**支撑 analysis 故事**（FM 对 occluded ReID 能/不能做什么的完整证据链：frozen oracle 无独立信息 → 换源全死 → LoRA 解冻破天花板但 plateau）。

  1171	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1608:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

  8795	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21614:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3539:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5174:reassess/r_3.md:3470:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:270:用户指令（原话要点）："不要把自己限定在遮挡这个领域，大胆创新，大胆做所有可能让我们稳发 B 类的实验，三台 GPU 全用，不依赖 codex（额度尽，06-11 13:01 恢复），别用 Workflow（会话额度也耗尽过一次），你自己做全部决定，我去睡觉。" 方向部署见决策 #42：锚点先行的双战场，主纲领"强人本主干 + 训练期新信息源/训练组织，测试单 embedding 冻结"。
  8796	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
  8797	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3551:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5186:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

   136	def make_lr(hr_img, h, kernel='bicubic'):
   137	    """Deterministic synthetic LR: HR(384x128) --down--> (h, w) --up--> 384x128.
   138	    w preserves the 3:1 canvas aspect: w = round(h/3).  Returns a 384x128 PIL image
   139	    (degrade-then-restore-size, the standard CR-ReID synthetic LR convention)."""
   140	    w = max(1, int(round(h * SIZE_TEST[1] / SIZE_TEST[0])))   # h*128/384 = h/3
   141	    k = _KERNELS[kernel]
   142	    small = hr_img.resize((w, h), k)
   143	    return small.resize((SIZE_TEST[1], SIZE_TEST[0]), Image.BICUBIC)

   146	def make_lattice_variants(hr_img, h, K, rng, fixed_axis=None, jitter_mode='lattice'):
   147	    """K plausible PHASE/CROP/KERNEL variants of the SAME hr image at height h.
   148	    LM-S4 factor ablation: fixed_axis (0=phase,1=bbox,2=zoom) restricts ALL variants to ONE
   149	    lattice axis, isolating which axis drives the test-time gain (cleanest story=phase).
   150	
   151	    Each variant perturbs the SAMPLING LATTICE relative to the scene by a SUB-LR-pixel
   152	    amount, then forms the LR image.  The depicted person is (almost) the same extent;
   153	    only WHICH hr pixels land on each LR sample point changes.  Axes:
   154	      - sub-pixel phase shift  (fractional HR translate before downsample)
   155	      - +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift / expand (integer LR-pixel = h/.. HR pixels)
   156	      - antialias kernel choice
   157	
   158	    variant 0 is ALWAYS the canonical deterministic bicubic LR (no perturbation) so the
   159	    single-LR baseline == variants[0].
   160	    Returns list of K PIL images (each 384x128)."""
   161	    W_hr, H_hr = hr_img.size                      # 128, 384
   162	    # how many HR pixels correspond to 1 LR pixel at this height
   163	    hr_per_lr_y = H_hr / float(h)                  # 384/h
   164	    hr_per_lr_x = W_hr / float(max(1, round(h / 3.0)))  # 128/(h/3) ~ 3
   165	    variants = [make_lr(hr_img, h, 'bicubic')]     # 0: canonical
   166	    kernels_cycle = ['bicubic', 'bilinear', 'lanczos', 'box', 'hamming']

   168	        # --- pick a lattice perturbation type round-robin so the K cover all axes ---
   169	        mode = fixed_axis if fixed_axis is not None else (j % 3)
   170	        kern = kernels_cycle[j % len(kernels_cycle)]
   171	        if jitter_mode == 'detector':
   172	            # detector-like localization jitter: continuous Gaussian center-shift + scale error,
   173	            # calibrated to typical detector bbox localization error (sigma ~0.5 LR-px translate,
   174	            # ~10% scale). NOT real detector boxes (Market has no source frame) -- a literature-
   175	            # informed proxy for deployment uncertainty, replacing the uniform +-1 LR-px lattice.
   176	            dx = rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma) * hr_per_lr_x
   177	            dy = rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma) * hr_per_lr_y
   178	            sc = float(np.clip(1.0 + rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma * 0.2), 0.7, 1.3))
   179	            cw, ch = W_hr / sc, H_hr / sc
   180	            cx, cy = W_hr / 2.0 + dx, H_hr / 2.0 + dy
   181	            l, u = int(round(cx - cw / 2)), int(round(cy - ch / 2))
   182	            r, b = int(round(cx + cw / 2)), int(round(cy + ch / 2))
   183	            pad = max(0, -l, -u, r - W_hr, b - H_hr) + 1
   184	            canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W_hr + 2 * pad, H_hr + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   185	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))
   186	            cropped = canvas.crop((l + pad, u + pad, r + pad, b + pad)).resize(
   187	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   188	            variants.append(make_lr(cropped, h, kern)); continue
   189	        if mode == 0:
   190	            # sub-pixel phase: fractional shift of up to +/-0.5 LR pixel (in HR px)
   191	            dx = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_x
   192	            dy = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_y
   193	            shifted = hr_img.transform(
   194	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.AFFINE, (1, 0, dx, 0, 1, dy),
   195	                resample=Image.BICUBIC)
   196	            v = make_lr(shifted, h, kern)
   197	        elif mode == 1:
   198	            # +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift: crop the HR by an integer # of LR pixels on
   199	            # each side then resize back to the HR canvas (== shifting the bbox window).
   200	            sx = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_x))
   201	            sy = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_y))
   202	            left = max(0, sx); upper = max(0, sy)
   203	            right = W_hr + min(0, sx); lower = H_hr + min(0, sy)
   204	            if right - left < 4 or lower - upper < 4:
   205	                left, upper, right, lower = 0, 0, W_hr, H_hr
   206	            cropped = hr_img.crop((left, upper, right, lower)).resize(
   207	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   208	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   209	        else:
   210	            # bbox expand / contract by 1 LR pixel (zoom in/out a touch) + kernel swap
   211	            ez = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * 0.5 * hr_per_lr_y   # expand/contract in HR px
   212	            box = (-ez, -ez * (W_hr / H_hr), W_hr + ez, H_hr + ez * (W_hr / H_hr)) \
   213	                if ez > 0 else (abs(ez), abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr),

   222	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)

   224	        variants.append(v)
   225	    return variants

   228	def make_tta_variants(lr_img, K, rng, pad=10, strong=False):
   229	    """ORDINARY TTA control: K views of ONE bicubic LR image via pad+RandomCrop (+ hflip).
   230	    NO lattice/phase semantics -- the standard cheap test-time augmentation.  variant 0 ==
   231	    the un-augmented LR so the single-LR baseline is shared with the lattice path.
   232	    strong=True (LM-S2 defense): ALSO add resize-jitter + brightness/contrast = a RICHER TTA,
   233	    so the lattice ensemble must beat a STRONG (not just crop+flip) ordinary baseline."""
   234	    from PIL import ImageEnhance
   235	    W, H = lr_img.size
   236	    out = [lr_img]                                  # 0: identity (== single LR)
   237	    for j in range(1, K):
   238	        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W + 2 * pad, H + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   239	        canvas.paste(lr_img, (pad, pad))
   240	        cx = rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1)
   241	        cy = rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1)
   242	        crop = canvas.crop((cx, cy, cx + W, cy + H))
   243	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   244	            crop = crop.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
   245	        if strong:
   246	            if rng.rand() < 0.5:

   248	                crop = crop.resize((max(1, int(W * s)), max(1, int(H * s))), Image.BILINEAR).resize((W, H), Image.BILINEAR)

   250	                crop = ImageEnhance.Brightness(crop).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   251	            if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   252	                crop = ImageEnhance.Contrast(crop).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   253	        out.append(crop)
   254	    return out

   284	        cfg.merge_from_list(_overrides)  # leave PRETRAIN_* as in config; load_param(ckpt) overwrites all weights anyway
   285	        cfg.freeze()
   286	        os.environ.setdefault('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', '0')
   287	        # need num_classes/camera_num/view_num to build the head; read from Market meta.
   288	        ds = {'market1501': Market1501, 'msmt17': MSMT17}[cli.dataset](
   289	            root=os.path.join(_repo, cli.data_root), verbose=False)
   290	        model = make_model(cfg, num_class=ds.num_train_pids,
   291	                           camera_num=ds.num_train_cams, view_num=1,
   292	                           semantic_weight=cfg.MODEL.SEMANTIC_WEIGHT)
   293	        model.load_param(os.path.join(_repo, cli.ckpt))
   294	        self.model = model.cuda().eval()

   296	        print(f"[model] loaded {cli.ckpt}; POSE_TEST_FEAT=global; pose DISABLED at test "
   297	              f"(pose_dict=None -> plain backbone global feat). num_cls={ds.num_train_pids}",
   298	              flush=True)
   299	
   300	    def feats_from_pil(self, pil_list):
   301	        """Batched frozen features for a list of 384x128 PIL images. L2-normalized."""
   302	        torch = self.torch
   303	        feats = []
   304	        B = cli.batch
   305	        for s in range(0, len(pil_list), B):
   306	            chunk = pil_list[s:s + B]
   307	            arr = np.stack([pil_to_tensor_np(im) for im in chunk], 0)
   308	            t = torch.from_numpy(arr).cuda(non_blocking=True)
   309	            cam = torch.zeros(t.shape[0], dtype=torch.long, device=t.device)
   310	            view = torch.zeros(t.shape[0], dtype=torch.long, device=t.device)
   311	            with torch.no_grad():
   312	                out = self.model(t, cam_label=cam, view_label=view, pose_dict=None)
   313	            feat = out[0] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out
   314	            assert torch.is_tensor(feat) and feat.dim() == 2, \
   315	                f"expected single global vector, got {type(feat)} {getattr(feat,'shape',None)}"
   316	            feat = torch.nn.functional.normalize(feat, p=2, dim=1)
   317	            feats.append(feat.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32))
   318	        return np.concatenate(feats, 0)
   319	
   320	
   321	# =========================================================================== #
   322	# eval helpers (Market protocol: drop same pid&cam junk)
   323	# =========================================================================== #
   324	def eval_map(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam, max_rank=10):
   325	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   326	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   327	    all_AP, all_cmc, nv = [], [], 0
   328	    for i in range(num_q):
   329	        order = idx[i]
   330	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   331	        m = (g_pid[order][keep] == q_pid[i]).astype(np.int32)
   332	        if not m.any():
   333	            continue
   334	        nv += 1
   335	        cmc = m.cumsum(); cmc[cmc > 1] = 1
   336	        all_cmc.append(cmc[:max_rank])
   337	        tmp = m.cumsum(); prec = tmp / (np.arange(len(m)) + 1.0)
   338	        all_AP.append((prec * m).sum() / m.sum())
   339	    all_cmc = np.asarray(all_cmc).mean(0)
   340	    return dict(mAP=float(np.mean(all_AP)) * 100, r1=float(all_cmc[0]) * 100,
   341	                r5=float(all_cmc[4]) * 100, r10=float(all_cmc[9]) * 100, nq=nv)
   342	
   343	
   344	def per_query_ap(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam):
   345	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   346	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   347	    aps = np.full(num_q, -1.0)
   348	    for i in range(num_q):
   349	        order = idx[i]
   350	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   351	        m = (g_pid[order][keep] == q_pid[i]).astype(np.int32)
   352	        if not m.any():
   353	            continue
   354	        prec = m.cumsum() / (np.arange(len(m)) + 1.0)
   355	        aps[i] = (prec * m).sum() / m.sum()
   356	    return aps
   357	
   358	
   359	def n_false_in_topk(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam, k=10):
   360	    """#wrong-identity gallery within the LR top-k (after junk removal). The TRIVIAL
   361	    failure proxy from Hubness §7.6 that the signal must survive."""
   362	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   363	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   364	    nf = np.zeros(num_q)
   365	    for i in range(num_q):
   366	        order = idx[i]
   367	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   368	        order_k = order[keep][:k]
   369	        nf[i] = int((g_pid[order_k] != q_pid[i]).sum())
   370	    return nf

   373	# --- stats (no scipy) ---
   374	def spearman(x, y):
   375	    x = np.asarray(x, float); y = np.asarray(y, float)
   376	    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y); x, y = x[ok], y[ok]
   377	    if len(x) < 3:
   378	        return float('nan'), 0
   379	    rx = np.argsort(np.argsort(x)).astype(float)
   380	    ry = np.argsort(np.argsort(y)).astype(float)
   381	    rx -= rx.mean(); ry -= ry.mean()
   382	    d = np.sqrt((rx**2).sum() * (ry**2).sum())
   383	    return (float((rx * ry).sum() / d) if d > 0 else float('nan')), len(x)
   384	
   385	
   386	def partial_spearman(x, y, Z):
   387	    """partial Spearman of (x,y) controlling covariate(s) Z (rank-residual correlation)."""
   388	    x = np.asarray(x, float); y = np.asarray(y, float); Z = np.asarray(Z, float)
   389	    if Z.ndim == 1:
   390	        Z = Z[:, None]
   391	    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y) & np.isfinite(Z).all(1)
   392	    x, y, Z = x[ok], y[ok], Z[ok]
   393	    if len(x) < 5:
   394	        return float('nan'), 0
   395	    rk = lambda v: np.argsort(np.argsort(v)).astype(float)
   396	    rx, ry = rk(x), rk(y)
   397	    Zr = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x))] + [rk(Z[:, j]) for j in range(Z.shape[1])])
   398	    res = lambda r: r - Zr @ np.linalg.lstsq(Zr, r, rcond=None)[0]
   399	    ex, ey = res(rx), res(ry)
   400	    d = np.sqrt((ex**2).sum() * (ey**2).sum())
   401	    return (float((ex * ey).sum() / d) if d > 0 else float('nan')), len(x)
   402

   456	
   457	        # ============ build feats for every variant ==================

   482	        def mean_pairwise_dist(F):       # F: [Nq,K,D] L2-normed

   523	              f"(1.0=identical sets)")

    20	- **L_id** = CE(cls, y_rep) + batch_hard_triplet(gf, y_rep)：per-variant ReID。triplet = margin_ranking_loss(d_an, d_ap, y=1) = relu(d_ap−d_an+margin)；d_ap=最难正(max same-id，自身 dist=0 不会赢 max)，d_an=最难负(min diff-id，正样本 +1e9 排除)。✓
    21	- **L_marg** = −log[mean_l softmax(cls^l)[y]] + triplet(mean_l gf)：边缘似然 + 均值特征 triplet。`p_mean.gather(1,y)` 取正确类概率。✓
    22	- **L_cons** = mean(1−cos(z^l, sg(z_mu))) + β·KL(p^l‖sg(p_mu))：cos 项拉每 variant 到均值(z_mu detach)；KL 已修为 **forward 方向** `p_bm·(logp_l − log_pmu)`（p_mu detach）匹配 design。✓
    23	- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
    24	
    25	## d. reshape 一致性（image-major）
    26	- `x=xb.view(B*M,…)`，xb[B,M] → x[i*M+m]=img i var m。`y_rep=y.repeat_interleave(M)` → y_rep[i*M+m]=y[i]。`cls.view(B,M,−1)/gf.view(B,M,D)` 还原 [i,m]=img i var m。三者一致 ✓。

    29	- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
    30	- PK sampler（P=16×Kins=4=BS64），M=2 variants/img → forward 128。DataLoader num_workers 并行 PIL 生成（避免 CPU 瓶颈）。
    31	- AMP：autocast 仅包 forward，损失 `.float()` 在 fp32（log/KL 防 fp16 下溢）。GradScaler 标准 scale/step/update。✓
    32	- 优化器 SGD nesterov + cosine + warmup，fine-tune lr=3.5e-3（低于从头 0.008，保护已学特征）。**BS=64 不改** ✓，M 是方法固有增广非 BS。

    36	- 对照 = frozen 同模型同 eval。eval **复用 kill-switch** `--ckpt <微调>`，不重写 eval 逻辑 → apples-to-apples。
    37	- cam=zeros：SIE 配置无，kill-switch eval 用 zeros 已得 sanity 94.43（=ref 94.4）→ benign，训练用 zeros 与 eval 一致无 train/test mismatch。
    38	- 风险1：训练版若只 ≈ frozen ensemble → ensemble trick，诚实判死。
    39	- 风险2：M=2 forward 128 显存（AMP 缓解，24G 应够，smoke 验）。
    40	- 风险3：fine-tune 可能掉 HR mAP（预期，专攻 LR；报 LR 增益为主，HR 作 trade-off 记录）。
    41	
    42	## 结论

     7	- test-time decision-marginalization（对 K=9 lattice 变体边缘化检索决策）已成立（6/10），但纯 test-time。用户要训练端互补机制凑成完整方法。

     9	- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
    10	- → 训练端价值必须**改特征本身（backbone）**。codex（train2_backbone）收敛到 LSRC，7.5/10。
    11	
    12	## 核心假设
    13	
    14	一句话：**训 backbone 让 K 个 lattice 变体形成"可边缘化的证据集"**——让负样本不产生假高 lattice 相似（marginalization 的数学瓶颈），让正样本有多路可匹配证据——比 frozen 重投影有空间，因为 backbone 能改变 aliasing/bbox-shift 敏感的特征本身。
    15	
    16	## 技术方案
    17	
    18	- **改动文件**：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py`，新增 `--loss_mode lsrc` + `--lam_lsrc/--lam_negtail/--lsrc_tau/--lsrc_tau_c/--lsrc_margin/--lam_coverage/--cov_m`。
    19	- **数据流**：B 张图各生成 M 个 lattice 变体 → backbone → `gf_bm [B,M,D]` → L2 norm → bag-to-bag `sim4 = einsum('ikd,jld->ijkl')` [B,B,M×M] cos → `S = tau_l·logsumexp(sim4/tau_l)` [B,B] set score。
    20	- **loss**：`L_id (CE + per-slot batch-hard triplet) + lam_lsrc·(L_setsupcon + lam_negtail·L_negtail + lam_coverage·L_cov)`
    21	  - `L_setsupcon`：S 做 batch-softmax supervised contrastive（对齐 test-time logsumexp 边缘化），对角 -1e9 + pos 对角 0 排除 self。
    22	  - `L_negtail`：`softplus((max_neg_lattice_pair_cos - margin)/0.1)`，压低负样本对的最大 lattice-pair 相似度（核心：marg 最怕某错 lattice 假高分）。
    23	  - `L_cov`（codex step2，默认关）：top-M 正样本 lattice-pair，正样本不靠单一固定 lattice 赢。
    24	- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。
    25	
    26	## 预期结果
    27	
    28	- 假设成立：lattice mAP > no-LM-loss 79.90 **+0.3~0.5**，且 single_mean 不掉 >0.8（单变体判别力保住）。
    29	- 失败最可能原因：(a) set-supcon 退化成普通 instance 判别，和 L_id 冗余（→ +0）；(b) neg-tail 压过头连正样本 lattice 也压（→ single 掉）；(c) 又一次"backbone 已最优、训练端无空间"。
    30	- **训练观测（进行中）**：4090 lam0.5 ep23 acc 0.999 / 3090 lam1.0 ep13 acc 0.995 → single 判别力完全没塌（codex 最担心的 kill 信号未触发）。真判据仍是 eval。
    31	
    32	## 对照组
    33	
    34	- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
    35	- **消融变量**：只开 LSRC（lam_marg=0, lam_cons=0），单变量隔离 LSRC 贡献。
    36	- **后续消融档**（已备 code，未跑）：set-supcon only → +neg-tail → +coverage，证每项必要。
    37	
    38	## 与已死路线的本质区别（codex 核验中）
    39	
    40	- 非 **consistency**（exp359 -1.73）：不拉同图变体到均值，允许 residual 存在。
    41	- 非 **L_marg**（frozen 无 headroom）：在**检索决策层**（q-g 相似度，denominator 有真负样本）边缘化，非 train-ID 分类头 posterior。
    42	- 非 **Hard-Lattice ERM**（76.894 死）：把 K 变体当检索证据集，非独立硬样本逐个 ERM。

     1	# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
     2	
     3	> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
     4	> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
     5	
     6	## 动机
     7	
     8	低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
     9	
    10	### 零训练 kill-switch 证据（GO）
    11	frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
    12	
    13	| h | rank-1 flip% | single LR | lat-MaxSim | **LATgain** | **LAT−TTA** |
    14	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    15	| 16 | 74.9% | 42.65 | 46.87 | **+4.23** | **+3.04** |
    16	| 24 | 31.3% | 69.31 | 72.98 | **+3.67** | **+2.68** |
    17	| 32 | 9.7% | 81.93 | 83.98 | +2.05 | +1.44 |
    18	| 48 | 1.2% | 90.44 | 91.02 | +0.58 | +0.41 |
    19	
    20	两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
    21	
    22	### 诚实 caveat（写法要求）
    23	phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
    24	
    25	## 核心假设
    26	
    27	训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
    28	
    29	## 技术方案
    30	
    31	### 数据流
    32	1. 正常 ReID baseline（Market，exp260b 同配置）。
    33	2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
    34	3. h 混合训练 h ∈ {16,24,32}，severe-biased（但不只训 h=16）。
    35	
    36	### LM-ReID loss
    37	```
    38	z^l = norm(fθ(T_l(x)));  p^l = softmax(W z^l);  z^μ = norm(mean_l z^l);  p^μ = mean_l p^l
    39	L_id   = mean_l [ CE(p^l, y) + Triplet(z^l, y) ]
    40	L_marg = -log[ mean_l p^l[y] ] + Triplet(z^μ, y)                 # marginal likelihood（主贡献）
    41	L_cons = mean_l (1 - cos(z^l, sg(z^μ))) + β·mean_l KL(p^l || sg(p^μ))  # consistency to mean
    42	L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
    43	L = L_id + λ_m·L_marg + λ_c·L_cons + λ_a·L_adv
    44	```
    45	默认 λ_m=1.0, λ_c=0.2, β=0.5, λ_a=0.02–0.05（warmup 后开）。**L_adv 弱辅助非主贡献**（太强会擦身份边缘细节，必须 ablation）。
    46	
    47	### 推理 K-marginalization
    48	```
    49	s(q, g) = τ·log[ 1/K Σ_l exp( cos(f(T_l(q)), f(g)) / τ ) ]
    50	```
    51	τ→0 接近 lat-MaxSim（主推，因 lat-MaxSim 46.9 > mean），τ 大接近 mean（消融）。
    52	
    53	## 预期结果
    54	
    55	**过线（决定 method vs trick）**：
    56	- h=16：训练版 > frozen ensemble **+0.8~2.0 mAP**；> single +5~7；> TTA +2~3.5。
    57	- h=24：稳定收益。
    58	- h=32：允许 marginal 不负。
    59	
    60	失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
    61	
    62	## 对照组
    63	
    64	- single LR（canonical bicubic，固定一个）。
    65	- 普通 K-TTA（同 K，random crop/flip/color/resize）。
    66	- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
    67	- （成稿）k-reciprocal / SR-based / VPFA。
    68	
    69	消融：marg only / marg+cons / marg+cons+adv；τ sweep；K=1/3/5/9 曲线；phase-only vs +bbox+kernel。
    70	
    71	## 协议 / benchmark
    72	
    73	- 合成：Market/MSMT，gallery HR，query LR h=16/24/32，canonical LR single baseline，K=9（3×3 phase 主，bbox/kernel ablation，不无限扩 K）。所有 TTA 对照 **K-matched**。
    74	- 标准 CR-ReID（成稿补）：MLR-Market / MLR-CUHK03 / CAVIAR（PS-HRNet 用过）。
    75	- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
    76	
    77	## 撞车边界（novelty，codex 5 路联网）
    78	
    79	- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
    80	- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
    81	- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
    82	- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
    83	- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
    84	
    85	## 风险与定位
    86	
    87	operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
    88	
    89	## 审查 / 训练协议
    90	
    91	1. 本 design.md（已写）。
    92	2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
    93	3. Claude 广审（Opus 子代理）→ `claude_review.md`；Codex 审（`codex --search exec`）→ `codex_review.md`。**两层通过才训练**。
    94	4. smoke（几 iter 确认各 loss 分量下降无泄漏）。
    95	5. 训练（lab-3090，Market，h 混合，BS=64 不改，TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64，PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup）。
    96	6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。

     8	## Findings（codex --search exec, xhigh, 156k tokens）
     9	
    10	- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
    11	- **High**：train/test marginalization 不对齐。训练 `sim4` 是双边 M×M LR-lattice bag-to-bag；test 是 query-LR-K变体 × gallery-HR-单图。对称训练给正样本 gallery-side oracle、给负样本 test 不存在的 gallery-side worst-pair 约束。建议非对称 `LR-query set → gallery single`，或至少加该对照。
    12	- **Medium-1**：self-pair/对角 mask 主体正确（pos.fill_diagonal_0 + logits 对角 -1e9 + neg 排同 id）。但若 PKSampler 某 id 图不足重复采同图，非对角"同图副本"会被当正样本（低概率，非严格自配对排除）。
    13	- **Medium-2**：LSRC 机制上确与 consistency（非拉均值）/ L_marg（非分类头 posterior）有本质区别，但默认混旧项导致无法隔离证明区别。
    14	- **Low-1**：coverage 项只最大化正样本 top-M cos，没让 top-M"赢过负样本"，更像相似度奖励非完整 ranking coverage；且 `cov_m=0` 时 `topk(...,0)` NaN，需校验。
    15	- **Low-2**：logsumexp 没减 log(M*M)，严格说非 logmeanexp，但 batch 内 M 固定、进 softmax 常数抵消，非 bug。
    16	
    17	## Novelty
    18	没见"LR-ReID 把 sampling lattice 明确当 hidden variable 做 lattice decision marginalization"的直接先例。set contrastive/logsumexp bag score 本身不新（SupCon/MIL-NCE/set-ReID），novelty 只能落在 **sampling-lattice hidden variable + retrieval decision marginalization** 问题定义。不能声称发现 aliasing 本身（anti-aliasing 强先例）。
    19	
    20	## 处理（主 agent）
    21	
    22	1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
    23	2. **High** — 已加 `--lsrc_asym`（query M 变体 set × gallery slot-0 单图，对齐 test）。**策略**：对称版作便宜 go/no-go（acc 0.999 健康，~50min 跑完 eval）；对称 eval 涨 → **重跑 codex 审 asym diff → approve → 跑 asym 作主结果**；对称 eval 平 → 训练端这条基本凉，转 BLC / codex 找更多。
    24	3. **Low** — 已加 `assert cov_m>=1`；logsumexp 常数无害（确认）。
    25	4. **Medium** — mask 正确（确认）；隔离问题随 Critical force 解决。

     1	# 实验 exp359-BLC: Bbox-Lattice Canonicalizer（训练端 input-level 备选）
     2	
     3	> **状态**：备选 design（2026-06-26 预写）。仅当 LSRC（对称 + 非对称）都 go/no-go 失败时启动。预写以备无缝接 + 体现"实验前先写 design"纪律。
     4	
     5	## 动机
     6	
     7	- LSRC 走 backbone-loss 路线。codex train2_input 收敛到 **BLC（input-level，8/10→market 受限 6.5）**作互补/备选。
     8	- **最对症的证据**：LM-S4 因子消融显示 **bbox 检测框不确定性主导（+2.84）**，远超 phase/kernel。→ 直接 canonicalize bbox 的 refiner 比改 resize kernel 更打中主因。
     9	- 改输入（像素分布）不是 frozen-feature tweak，backbone 参与重学。
    10	
    11	## 核心假设
    12	
    13	训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
    14	
    15	## 技术方案
    16	
    17	- **数据流**：margin-expanded / padded crop → tiny localization net 预测 bounded `(dx, dy, ds)` → `grid_sample` 得 canonical crop → backbone → ReID。
    18	- **loss**：`L = CE + Triplet on f(grid_sample(x_z, θ̂)) + λ_geo·SmoothL1(θ̂, -δ_z) + λ_reg·||θ̂||²`
    19	  - `δ_z` 来自自生成的 bbox/phase lattice → 几何监督干净（压偏移参数，非身份 embedding）。
    20	  - 第一版只做 translation，不 affine/TPS（防裁掉身体边缘）。
    21	  - K-spread 只 monitor，不进 loss。
    22	- **⚠️ market 约束（codex 警告）**：market 图是已裁好的人框，无原图上下文 → 要先 **pad crops 人工制造 bbox 不确定性**，否则 refiner 没有可校正的 support 偏移。这是 BLC 在 market 上先天降到 6.5 的原因。
    23	
    24	## 预期结果
    25	
    26	- 假设成立：offset MAE `<0.35` LR px，bbox-axis feature spread 降 ≥20%（identity margin 不降），K=1 mAP `+0.8` 或 K=9 在 lattice-marg 上再 `+0.3~0.5`。
    27	- 失败最可能原因：(a) STN 学偏 / 裁掉身体边缘 / 过拟合检测框（→ 加 offset 范围 + identity loss + grid reg）；(b) market pad-crop 制造的不确定性不真实 → spread 降但 mAP 不涨（直接杀）。
    28	
    29	## 对照组
    30	
    31	- baseline：no-LM-loss（lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9）。
    32	- 强对照：固定 margin crop（不学 refiner）→ 证 learned canonicalization 必要。
    33	- 消融变量：只加 canonicalizer（冻 backbone 先 probe → 活则 unfreeze）。
    34	
    35	## kill-switch（冻 backbone 先 probe）
    36	
    37	冻 no-LM-loss backbone 只训 canonicalizer，h=12/16 bbox-only lattice：
    38	- offset MAE <0.35 LR px；
    39	- K=1 mAP +0.8 或 K=9 +0.3~0.5；
    40	- h=32/HR sanity 掉 <0.3；
    41	- θ̂ 不大量贴边（saturation <10%）；
    42	- **只降 spread 不涨 mAP → 直接杀**（别陷入"指标好看但无用"）。
    43	
    44	## 与已死路线区别
    45	压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。

     9	- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
    10	- **LUD（Lattice Uncertainty Distillation，lens2）= 同族**：训头预测 lattice 风险 risk_k（stopgrad teacher 的 spread + margin），测试 per-variant 加权。
    11	- **关键洞察（lens2）**：query 级 scalar confidence **不能改 gallery 排序**，必须 per-variant 权重 pi_k 才涨 mAP。
    12	- **不塌缩**：主 embedding 完全不动（stopgrad），只训加权头。
    13	- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
    14	- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
    15

    17	- 训小模块**估计 LR crop 格点偏移 (dx,dy) 并 grid_sample 重采样到 canonical**（类 STN，但监督几何参数非身份特征），残差留 test-time marginalization。

    20	- **不塌缩**：压的是已知几何扰动参数、不是身份特征；3 保险（HR gallery bypass / 硬边界 / 冻 backbone 先 probe）。
    21	- **kill-switch**：冻 backbone 只训 canonicalizer 预测注入 offset；injected shift MAE<0.35 LR px + K-spread 降≥20% + K=1 mAP +1.0 OR K=9 再+0.3/0.5 + HR sanity 掉<0.2 → 活。看 θ 别 saturate 到边界（伪信号）。

    23	
    24	## codex 明确不建议（现在）
    25	- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）

    27	
    28	## 决策

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""LS-MRT probe -- train-time mechanism (Lattice-Set Marginal Retrieval Training), frozen backbone.
     3	
     4	Train a small linear re-projection P with a SET-RETRIEVAL SupCon loss that is ISOMORPHIC to the
     5	test-time decision marginalization:  S(q,g) = logmeanexp_k sim(P z_{q,k}, P z_g).  Marginalize on
     6	the RETRIEVAL decision layer (q-g similarity, real negatives in denominator) -- NOT on a train-ID
     7	classifier head (that was L_marg, which collapsed).  Frozen backbone + cached feats => cheap probe.
     8	
     9	PASS if h=16 set-score-with-P  >=  uniform-lattice-marg + 0.3 mAP  AND  K-variant mean cosine does
    10	NOT rise (no collapse).  Train/test ids DISJOINT (no leakage)."""
    11	import sys, os, numpy as np, argparse
    12	from collections import defaultdict
    13	
    14	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    15	ap.add_argument('--ckpt', default='log/market1501/exp359_abl_noLMloss/transformer_40.pth')
    16	ap.add_argument('--config', default='configs/market/pose_psg_lgpa_gcn_base.yml')
    17	ap.add_argument('--h', type=int, default=16)
    18	ap.add_argument('--K', type=int, default=9)
    19	ap.add_argument('--epochs', type=int, default=30)
    20	ap.add_argument('--lr', type=float, default=3e-4)
    21	ap.add_argument('--tau_l', type=float, default=0.1)     # lattice marginalization temp
    22	ap.add_argument('--tau_c', type=float, default=0.1)     # contrastive temp
    23	ap.add_argument('--P', type=int, default=16)            # ids per batch
    24	ap.add_argument('--Kins', type=int, default=4)          # instances per id
    25	ap.add_argument('--train_cap', type=int, default=0)
    26	ap.add_argument('--lambda_id', type=float, default=0.1, help='identity reg ||P-I||^2 to keep P near identity (prevent overfit; smoke showed full linear P overfits)')
    27	ap.add_argument('--cache_gallery', default='/tmp/g_lpa.npz')
    28	cli = ap.parse_args()
    29	sys.argv = ['ks', '--ckpt', cli.ckpt, '--config', cli.config, '--data_root', 'data',
    30	            '--K', str(cli.K), '--reuse_gallery', '--cache_gallery', cli.cache_gallery]
    31	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    32	import cvpb_lattice_killswitch as ks
    33	import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
    34	from datasets.bases import read_image
    35	
    36	RNG = np.random.RandomState(42); H, K = cli.h, cli.K
    37	ext = ks.FrozenExtractor(); REPO = ks._repo
    38	DEV = 'cuda'
    39	
    40	
    41	def items(s):
    42	    return ks.list_split(os.path.join(REPO, 'data', 'market1501', s))
    43	
    44	
    45	def variant_feats(its, cap=0):
    46	    if cap:
    47	        its = its[:cap]
    48	    pids = np.array([it[1] for it in its]); cams = np.array([it[2] for it in its])
    49	    flat = []
    50	    for it in its:
    51	        hr = ks._to_target_aspect(read_image(it[0]))
    52	        flat.extend(ks.make_lattice_variants(hr, H, K, RNG))
    53	    return ext.feats_from_pil(flat).reshape(len(its), K, -1).astype(np.float32), pids, cams
    54	
    55	
    56	def setscore(zq, zg, tau_l):
    57	    """logmeanexp_k sim(zq_{i,k}, zg_j) -> [Nq,Ng].  zq [Nq,K,D] L2, zg [Ng,D] L2."""
    58	    sim = np.einsum('ikd,jd->ijk', zq, zg)                      # [Nq,Ng,K] cos
    59	    return tau_l * (np.log(np.exp(sim / tau_l).mean(2) + 1e-12))  # logmeanexp over K
    60	
    61	
    62	# ---- 1. TRAIN: cache variant feats, fit P with set-retrieval SupCon ----
    63	print(f"[LS-MRT] extract TRAIN variant feats (h={H}, K={K}) ...", flush=True)
    64	ft, ytr, _ = variant_feats(items('bounding_box_train'), cap=cli.train_cap)
    65	N, _, D = ft.shape
    66	ft_t = torch.tensor(ft, device=DEV); yt = torch.tensor(ytr, device=DEV)
    67	id2idx = defaultdict(list)
    68	for i, y in enumerate(ytr):
    69	    id2idx[int(y)].append(i)
    70	ids = [y for y in id2idx if len(id2idx[y]) >= 2]
    71	P = torch.nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(DEV)
    72	P.weight.data.copy_(torch.eye(D, device=DEV))               # init = identity
    73	opt = torch.optim.Adam(P.parameters(), lr=cli.lr)
    74	iters = max(1, N // (cli.P * cli.Kins))
    75	for ep in range(cli.epochs):
    76	    last = 0.0
    77	    for _ in range(iters):
    78	        bids = RNG.choice(ids, min(cli.P, len(ids)), replace=False)
    79	        bidx = []
    80	        for y in bids:
    81	            pool = id2idx[int(y)]
    82	            bidx.extend(RNG.choice(pool, cli.Kins, replace=len(pool) < cli.Kins))
    83	        bidx = np.array(bidx)
    84	        zb = F.normalize(P(ft_t[bidx]), dim=-1)                # [b,K,D]
    85	        zg = zb[:, 0]                                          # [b,D] canonical-0 as in-batch gallery
    86	        sim = torch.einsum('ikd,jd->ijk', zb, zg) / cli.tau_l  # [b,b,K]
    87	        S = cli.tau_l * torch.logsumexp(sim - float(np.log(K)), dim=2)   # [b,b] logmeanexp_k
    88	        yb = yt[bidx]
    89	        pos = (yb[:, None] == yb[None, :]).float(); pos.fill_diagonal_(0)
    90	        logits = S / cli.tau_c; logits.fill_diagonal_(-1e9)
    91	        logp = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=1)
    92	        loss = (-(pos * logp).sum(1) / pos.sum(1).clamp_min(1)).mean()
    93	        loss = loss + cli.lambda_id * ((P.weight - torch.eye(D, device=DEV)) ** 2).sum()
    94	        opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step(); last = loss.item()
    95	print(f"[LS-MRT] P fit {cli.epochs}ep, final loss={last:.4f}", flush=True)
    96	
    97	# ---- 2. TEST: set-score with P vs uniform (P=I) ----
    98	print("[LS-MRT] extract QUERY variant feats ...", flush=True)
    99	fq, q_pid, q_cam = variant_feats(items('query'))
   100	gf = np.load(cli.cache_gallery, allow_pickle=True)['gf']
   101	gits = items('bounding_box_test')
   102	g_pid = np.array([it[1] for it in gits]); g_cam = np.array([it[2] for it in gits])
   103	with torch.no_grad():
   104	    zq = F.normalize(P(torch.tensor(fq, device=DEV)), dim=-1).cpu().numpy()      # [Nq,K,D]
   105	    zg = F.normalize(P(torch.tensor(gf, device=DEV)), dim=-1).cpu().numpy()      # [Ng,D]
   106	uq = fq / (np.linalg.norm(fq, axis=2, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)                    # uniform: no P
   107	ug = gf / (np.linalg.norm(gf, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
   108	r_P = ks.eval_map(-setscore(zq, zg, cli.tau_l), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   109	r_U = ks.eval_map(-setscore(uq, ug, cli.tau_l), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   110	# collapse check: mean pairwise cosine among the K variants (test queries), with vs without P
   111	cos_P = float(np.mean([(zq[i] @ zq[i].T)[np.triu_indices(K, 1)].mean() for i in range(len(q_pid))]))
   112	cos_U = float(np.mean([(uq[i] @ uq[i].T)[np.triu_indices(K, 1)].mean() for i in range(len(q_pid))]))
   113	delta = r_P['mAP'] - r_U['mAP']
   114	print(f"\n[LS-MRT RESULT h={H}]  uniform-setmarg mAP={r_U['mAP']:.3f}  P-setmarg mAP={r_P['mAP']:.3f}  "
   115	      f"(P-uniform={delta:+.3f})")
   116	print(f"[LS-MRT DIAG] K-variant mean cos: uniform={cos_U:.4f}  withP={cos_P:.4f}  "
   117	      f"(rise={cos_P-cos_U:+.4f}; rise>0 => collapse risk)")
   118	print(f"[LS-MRT VERDICT] {'PASS (set-retrieval training helps)' if (delta >= 0.3 and cos_P - cos_U <= 0.02) else 'FAIL'}"
   119	      f"  -- need P-uniform>=+0.3 AND no cosine collapse")

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3010:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1858:reassess/r_3.md:4147:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12143:../codex_review_raw.txt:4433:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3012:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1860:reassess/r_3.md:4151:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12459:../codex_review_raw.txt:4965:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
