experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:8:## 机制 A：学怎么加权边缘化（LPA / LUD）— codex 最高 7.5/10
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:9:- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:14:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:16:## 机制 B：学怎么对齐检测框（LC-STN / BLC）— 7/10（lens1）/ 6.5/10（lens3）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:17:- 训小模块**估计 LR crop 格点偏移 (dx,dy) 并 grid_sample 重采样到 canonical**（类 STN，但监督几何参数非身份特征），残差留 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:21:- **kill-switch**：冻 backbone 只训 canonicalizer 预测注入 offset；injected shift MAE<0.35 LR px + K-spread 降≥20% + K=1 mAP +1.0 OR K=9 再+0.3/0.5 + HR sanity 掉<0.2 → 活。看 θ 别 saturate 到边界（伪信号）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:25:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:31:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:1:# 实验 exp359-BLC: Bbox-Lattice Canonicalizer（训练端 input-level 备选）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:7:- LSRC 走 backbone-loss 路线。codex train2_input 收敛到 **BLC（input-level，8/10→market 受限 6.5）**作互补/备选。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:8:- **最对症的证据**：LM-S4 因子消融显示 **bbox 检测框不确定性主导（+2.84）**，远超 phase/kernel。→ 直接 canonicalize bbox 的 refiner 比改 resize kernel 更打中主因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:13:训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:17:- **数据流**：margin-expanded / padded crop → tiny localization net 预测 bounded `(dx, dy, ds)` → `grid_sample` 得 canonical crop → backbone → ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:22:- **⚠️ market 约束（codex 警告）**：market 图是已裁好的人框，无原图上下文 → 要先 **pad crops 人工制造 bbox 不确定性**，否则 refiner 没有可校正的 support 偏移。这是 BLC 在 market 上先天降到 6.5 的原因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:27:- 失败最可能原因：(a) STN 学偏 / 裁掉身体边缘 / 过拟合检测框（→ 加 offset 范围 + identity loss + grid reg）；(b) market pad-crop 制造的不确定性不真实 → spread 降但 mAP 不涨（直接杀）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:32:- 强对照：固定 margin crop（不学 refiner）→ 证 learned canonicalization 必要。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:33:- 消融变量：只加 canonicalizer（冻 backbone 先 probe → 活则 unfreeze）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:37:冻 no-LM-loss backbone 只训 canonicalizer，h=12/16 bbox-only lattice：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:45:压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:20:1. **frozen-feature 重投影/重加权**（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075）— no-LM-loss 特征对边缘化已最优、无 headroom。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:3. **robust ERM**（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）— worst-case 也救不了。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **LS-MRT 死**：冻 backbone probe，smoke 时 P(D×D linear ~1M params)过拟合暴跌 −8.694；修复（identity-reg + 降 lr + 全量 116k samples）后 **+0.028 clean FAIL**（K-cosine 不升，但 P 不帮忙）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:43:- **LPA 死**：query-side 加权 +0.075，预测最佳变体 acc 12.4%≈chance。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:50:| BLC/LC-STN++ | 8/10→6.5 | bbox crop refiner 改输入（最贴 bbox 主导发现） | market 只裁好框→6.5 | 备选 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:53:## （旧）5 候选 frozen-feature pipeline（LS-MRT 已死，其余大概率同死）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:55:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:59:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60:| LCRS（互补 residual） | 7/10 | `z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + α·P_k(g_k))`，shared identity core + lattice-specific residual subspace + decorr(只在分类正确后)。"准确后分工"非硬推开。test K=9 边缘化拿更富 union | 冻 backbone 训 P_shared/P_k/cls；活=K-error correlation 降+K=9 gain ≥+0.5，individual variant mAP 不掉>0.8 | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:61:| LRFD（disentangle） | 7/10 | `z_l=P_id, r_l=P_lat`(lattice nuisance sink, 必须能预测 lattice), per-variant CE+triplet, 推理丢 r_l 用 z_l 边缘化 | 冻 backbone 训 heads；活=with-lattice-code >+0.2 over without + r_l lattice-pred acc>60% | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:62:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:63:| DeepSets Marginalizer（LPA 修正） | 6.5/10 | 不预测 query 最佳变体(LPA 死因)，改 pairwise: 每个(q,g)的 K 个 cos 经 DeepSets φ/ρ 合成校准分, α 初 0 限幅, embedding 冻 | cached features 小 scorer；活=+0.4 over uniform, 且 ordinary-TTA scorer 追不平(否则只是 generic learned TTA) | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:67:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:155:- **soft decision marginalization（logsumexp，LM-ReID 公式 s=τlog[1/KΣexp(cos/τ)]）在 severe LR（h12/16）最优**；mild LR（h≥20）hard-max 略超。三种聚合都 >> single；decision-level（max/logsumexp）≥ embedding-mean（h≥16）。差距虽小（±0.3）但完整 controlled ablation，logsumexp 是理论 motivated 的 sweet spot。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:149:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/codex_review.md:8:- **Medium（主风险）**: `DETACH=False` 让**固定 canonical 的 assign/part 梯度首次回传 backbone**（`pose_backbone_model.py:637` 用 `featmaps[-1]` 不 detach）。canonical 是 image-independent 布局，可能把 backbone 推向固定空间先验 → 遮挡/裁剪数据上的主要 destabilize/underfit 风险。历史 exp320 的 `DETACH=False` 曾灾难性（但 regime 不同，是警告证据非 blocker）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:163:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/design.md:37:**un-detach 全线下跌。M2 应验**：固定 canonical 的 assign-loss（image-independent）回传 backbone，把 backbone 往固定空间先验硬拽，破坏判别性（global 塌 51.7、part 塌 56.1）。**反向确认 detach 必须**（历史 detach +4.4）。用户假说"part 主导 backbone 更强"证伪——un-detach 不是让 part 更强，而是让整个 backbone 被固定先验腐蚀。NO-GO，不再追 un-detach 变体。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:166:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:51:### M2. un-detach 把「固定 canonical」assign 梯度引入 backbone —— 内容无关的强空间先验
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:167:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:53:- 关键：FIXED_BANDS 的 GT 是**对所有图相同的固定竖直 band 布局**（与图像内容/真实姿态无关）。于是该项在 w=0.5 + 全量 backbone 梯度下，逼 backbone 产出「CLIP 跨注意力匹配固定 canonical 分块」的空间特征——在遮挡数据上（真实部位常缺失/位移），可能逼 backbone 幻想出与实际遮挡内容矛盾的 canonical 结构，**有损判别性**。这是本变体最大的科学风险，design.md 仅泛泛写「un-detach 扰动/退化」，未点名这条「固定先验正则化 backbone」的具体路径。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:168:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:54:- 稳定性不受影响：exp340 审查已验证 canonical GT 不触发 NaN（峰值 1.0、无全零通道、bg `clamp(min=0)`、KL `clamp(min=-30)`+`isfinite` 双守卫），这些守卫在 detach 上游，un-detach 下依旧生效——**非 crash 风险**。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:808:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:7402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:14:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:833:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:854:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:11312:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1195:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1446:experiments/exp360_intrudeeriments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:7:- LSRC 走 backbone-loss 路线。codex train2_input 收敛到 **BLC（input-level，8/10→market 受限 6.5）**作互补/备选。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1447:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4215:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:13:训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1448:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:22:- **⚠️ market 约束（codex 警告）**：market 图是已裁好的人框，无原图上下文 → 要先 **pad crops 人工制造 bbox 不确定性**，否则 refiner 没有可校正的 support 偏移。这是 BLC 在 market 上先天降到 6.5 的原因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1449:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4217:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:27:- 失败最可能原因：(a) STN 学偏 / 裁掉身体边缘 / 过拟合检测框（→ 加 offset 范围 + identity loss + grid reg）；(b) market pad-crop 制造的不确定性不真实 → spread 降但 mAP 不涨（直接杀）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1450:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4218:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:45:压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1457:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4225:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:36:| LM-ReID ordinary-TTA | 69.09 | −0.87 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1470:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4238:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:155:- **soft decision marginalization（logsumexp，LM-ReID 公式 s=τlog[1/KΣexp(cos/τ)]）在 severe LR（h12/16）最优**；mild LR（h≥20）hard-max 略超。三种聚合都 >> single；decision-level（max/logsumexp）≥ embedding-mean（h≥16）。差距虽小（±0.3）但完整 controlled ablation，logsumexp 是理论 motivated 的 sweet spot。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1482:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4250:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:17:- 训小模块**估计 LR crop 格点偏移 (dx,dy) 并 grid_sample 重采样到 canonical**（类 STN，但监督几何参数非身份特征），残差留 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1483:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4251:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1491:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4259:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:48:| BLC/LC-STN++ | 8/10→6.5 | bbox crop refiner 改输入（最贴 bbox 主导发现） | market 只裁好框→6.5 | 备选 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1492:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4260:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2258:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5285:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2317:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5708:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2423:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:7162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:4179:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4335:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3856:- **后果**: design 自我辩护的"global prototype 覆盖 hard tail，不同于 batch CV-triplet"是**通用 memory-bank-vs-batch 论证**(MoCo/SpCL/Cluster-Contrast 以来的标准动机)，**不构成机制 novelty**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4343:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3916:- **模块1 OVP-Mem(Opposite-View Prototype Memory)**: 每 train pid 维护 aerial / ground 两个 EMA 原型。样本除 CE+triplet 外, aerial image 拉近同 pid 的 **ground** 原型(InfoNCE: sim(z, P[y, opp_view])/τ 分类到 y)。≠死掉的 CV-triplet(那是 batch 内跨视角正对稀缺假设, 已证 88% batch 有; 这里是**全局原型级跨视角监督, 覆盖 hard tail**)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:4195:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4351:experiments/exp340_swin_lgpa_fixedbands/design.md:29:- 关键诚实对照(reviewer 必问,训练后补):固定文本 vs random 文本 prototype(同 canonical 先验)——证明涨点来自"固定 + 定位"而非 CLIP 词义本身;但**本实验目标是"固定语义(固定文本)standalone 涨点"这一事实**,random 对照属于归因分析。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:4196:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:13:- **模块1 OVP-Mem(Opposite-View Prototype Memory)**: 每 train pid 维护 aerial / ground 两个 EMA 原型。样本除 CE+triplet 外, aerial image 拉近同 pid 的 **ground** 原型(InfoNCE: sim(z, P[y, opp_view])/τ 分类到 y)。≠死掉的 CV-triplet(那是 batch 内跨视角正对稀缺假设, 已证 88% batch 有; 这里是**全局原型级跨视角监督, 覆盖 hard tail**)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:4201:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4357:experiments/exp340_swin_lgpa_fixedbands/claude_review.md:87:- design.md:29 自己点出 reviewer 必问的"固定文本 vs random 文本 prototype（同 canonical 先验）"归因对照。这是本实验**成功后**证明增益来自"固定文本语义"而非"任何固定 query + 固定先验"的关键。目前未建对照实验号。建议 exp340 一旦 part>global，立刻补一个 random-text-prototype 对照（同 canonical），否则结论不可归因到"固定 CLIP 语义"。属后续排期，非本次代码问题。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:5328:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw2.txt:2786:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3916:- **模块1 OVP-Mem(Opposite-View Prototype Memory)**: 每 train pid 维护 aerial / ground 两个 EMA 原型。样本除 CE+triplet 外, aerial image 拉近同 pid 的 **ground** 原型(InfoNCE: sim(z, P[y, opp_view])/τ 分类到 y)。≠死掉的 CV-triplet(那是 batch 内跨视角正对稀缺假设, 已证 88% batch 有; 这里是**全局原型级跨视角监督, 覆盖 hard tail**)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:5527:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw2.txt:2985:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4351:experiments/exp340_swin_lgpa_fixedbands/design.md:29:- 关键诚实对照(reviewer 必问,训练后补):固定文本 vs random 文本 prototype(同 canonical 先验)——证明涨点来自"固定 + 定位"而非 CLIP 词义本身;但**本实验目标是"固定语义(固定文本)standalone 涨点"这一事实**,random 对照属于归因分析。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:6466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9416:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8329:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:808:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:7402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:14:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8352:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8353:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:833:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8354:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:834:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1236:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8369:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:857:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1261:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8385:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:873:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8413:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1447:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4215:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:13:训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8414:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1448:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:22:- **⚠️ market 约束（codex 警告）**：market 图是已裁好的人框，无原图上下文 → 要先 **pad crops 人工制造 bbox 不确定性**，否则 refiner 没有可校正的 support 偏移。这是 BLC 在 market 上先天降到 6.5 的原因。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8415:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1449:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4217:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:27:- 失败最可能原因：(a) STN 学偏 / 裁掉身体边缘 / 过拟合检测框（→ 加 offset 范围 + identity loss + grid reg）；(b) market pad-crop 制造的不确定性不真实 → spread 降但 mAP 不涨（直接杀）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8416:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1450:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4218:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:45:压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8423:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1457:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4225:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:36:| LM-ReID ordinary-TTA | 69.09 | −0.87 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8434:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8436:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1470:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4238:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:155:- **soft decision marginalization（logsumexp，LM-ReID 公式 s=τlog[1/KΣexp(cos/τ)]）在 severe LR（h12/16）最优**；mild LR（h≥20）hard-max 略超。三种聚合都 >> single；decision-level（max/logsumexp）≥ embedding-mean（h≥16）。差距虽小（±0.3）但完整 controlled ablation，logsumexp 是理论 motivated 的 sweet spot。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8448:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1482:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4250:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:17:- 训小模块**估计 LR crop 格点偏移 (dx,dy) 并 grid_sample 重采样到 canonical**（类 STN，但监督几何参数非身份特征），残差留 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8449:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1483:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4251:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8453:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8457:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1491:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4259:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:48:| BLC/LC-STN++ | 8/10→6.5 | bbox crop refiner 改输入（最贴 bbox 主导发现） | market 只裁好框→6.5 | 备选 |

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8459:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:973:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10780:   800	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""LPA head probe -- train-time mechanism A kill-switch.
     3	
     4	Frozen no-LM-loss backbone. Train a tiny per-variant RELIABILITY head on the TRAIN ids
     5	(predict each lattice variant's margin to its true id), then at TEST weight the K query
     6	variants by softmax(head) and marginalize.  Train/test ids are DISJOINT (no leakage).
     7	
     8	PASS  if  weighted-mAP - uniform-mAP >= +0.4  AND  head-argmax-variant matches the
     9	per-query best-margin (oracle) variant >= 35% (chance = 1/K = 11%).  Else LPA learned head
    10	is DEAD even though the oracle headroom is large -> the 'best variant' is not predictable.
    11	Reuses cvpb_lattice_killswitch helpers via a sys.argv shim (its argparse is module-level).
    12	"""
    13	import sys, os, numpy as np, argparse, time
    14	
    15	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    16	ap.add_argument('--ckpt', default='log/market1501/exp359_abl_noLMloss/transformer_40.pth')
    17	ap.add_argument('--config', default='configs/market/pose_psg_lgpa_gcn_base.yml')
    18	ap.add_argument('--h', type=int, default=16)
    19	ap.add_argument('--K', type=int, default=9)
    20	ap.add_argument('--epochs', type=int, default=40)
    21	ap.add_argument('--lr', type=float, default=1e-3)
    22	ap.add_argument('--tau', type=float, default=0.5)
    23	ap.add_argument('--train_cap', type=int, default=0)        # 0 = all train imgs
    24	ap.add_argument('--cache_gallery', default='/tmp/g_lpa_head.npz')
    25	lpa = ap.parse_args()
    26	
    27	# the kill-switch parses argv at import time -> feed it the args its FrozenExtractor needs.
    28	sys.argv = ['ks', '--ckpt', lpa.ckpt, '--config', lpa.config, '--data_root', 'data',
    29	            '--K', str(lpa.K), '--reuse_gallery', '--cache_gallery', lpa.cache_gallery]
    30	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    31	import cvpb_lattice_killswitch as ks
    32	import torch
    33	from datasets.bases import read_image
    34	
    35	RNG = np.random.RandomState(42)
    36	H, K = lpa.h, lpa.K
    37	ext = ks.FrozenExtractor()
    38	REPO = ks._repo
    39	
    40	
    41	def items(split):
    42	    return ks.list_split(os.path.join(REPO, 'data', 'market1501', split))
    43	
    44	
    45	def variant_feats(its, cap=0):
    46	    """[N,K,D] frozen L2-normed features of K lattice variants (variant 0 = canonical LR)."""
    47	    if cap:
    48	        its = its[:cap]
    49	    pids = np.array([it[1] for it in its]); cams = np.array([it[2] for it in its])
    50	    flat = []
    51	    for it in its:
    52	        hr = ks._to_target_aspect(read_image(it[0]))
    53	        flat.extend(ks.make_lattice_variants(hr, H, K, RNG))     # K PILs
    54	    f = ext.feats_from_pil(flat).reshape(len(its), K, -1)        # [N,K,D]
    55	    return f.astype(np.float32), pids, cams
    56	
    57	
    58	def per_variant_margin(f, y):
    59	    """margin[n,k] = sim(f_k, true_center) - max_wrong sim(f_k, center).  centers = per-id
    60	    mean of CANONICAL (variant 0) feat.  Returns margin [N,K] and best-variant [N]."""
    61	    uy = np.unique(y)
    62	    cen = np.stack([f[y == c, 0].mean(0) for c in uy]).astype(np.float32)
    63	    cen /= (np.linalg.norm(cen, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
    64	    yi = np.array([{c: i for i, c in enumerate(uy)}[v] for v in y])
    65	    N = len(y)
    66	    sim = f @ cen.T                                              # [N,K,C]
    67	    true_s = sim[np.arange(N)[:, None], np.arange(K)[None, :], yi[:, None]]   # [N,K]
    68	    wrong = sim.copy(); wrong[np.arange(N), :, yi] = -1e9
    69	    margin = true_s - wrong.max(2)                              # [N,K]
    70	    return margin, margin.argmax(1)
    71	
    72	
    73	# ---- 1. TRAIN: extract variant feats + per-variant margin labels ----
    74	t0 = time.time()
    75	print(f"[LPA] extract TRAIN variant feats (h={H}, K={K}) ...", flush=True)
    76	ft, ytr, _ = variant_feats(items('bounding_box_train'), cap=lpa.train_cap)
    77	N, _, D = ft.shape
    78	margin_tr, best_tr = per_variant_margin(ft, ytr)

    80	
    81	# ---- 2. train the reliability head H(f)->scalar (predict normalized margin) ----
    82	dev = 'cuda'

    84	Mt = torch.tensor(margin_tr.reshape(N * K), device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)

    87	                           torch.nn.Linear(256, 1)).to(dev)
    88	opt = torch.optim.Adam(head.parameters(), lr=lpa.lr)
    89	for ep in range(lpa.epochs):

    91	    last = 0.0
    92	    for s in range(0, N * K, 4096):
    93	        idx = perm[s:s + 4096]
    94	        loss = torch.nn.functional.smooth_l1_loss(head(Xt[idx]).squeeze(1), Mt[idx])
    95	        opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step(); last = loss.item()
    96	print(f"[LPA] head trained {lpa.epochs}ep, final loss={last:.4f}", flush=True)
    97	
    98	# ---- 3. TEST: weighted vs uniform marginalization ----
    99	print("[LPA] extract QUERY variant feats ...", flush=True)
   100	fq, q_pid, q_cam = variant_feats(items('query'))
   101	if os.path.exists(lpa.cache_gallery):
   102	    gf = np.load(lpa.cache_gallery, allow_pickle=True)['gf']
   103	else:
   104	    gits = items('bounding_box_test')
   105	    gf = ext.feats_from_pil([ks._to_target_aspect(read_image(it[0])) for it in gits])
   106	    np.savez(lpa.cache_gallery, gf=gf)
   107	gits = items('bounding_box_test')
   108	g_pid = np.array([it[1] for it in gits]); g_cam = np.array([it[2] for it in gits])
   109	
   110	Xq = torch.tensor(fq.reshape(-1, D), device=dev)
   111	with torch.no_grad():
   112	    a = head(Xq).reshape(len(q_pid), K).cpu().numpy()           # [Nq,K] reliability logits
   113	w = np.exp(a / lpa.tau); w /= w.sum(1, keepdims=True)           # [Nq,K] weights
   114	sim_q = fq @ gf.T                                              # [Nq,K,Ng]
   115	r_uni = ks.eval_map(1 - sim_q.mean(1), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   116	r_w = ks.eval_map(1 - (w[:, :, None] * sim_q).sum(1), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   117	
   118	# diagnostic: does head's argmax match the per-query ORACLE best variant on TEST?
   119	margin_te, best_te = per_variant_margin(fq, q_pid)
   120	acc = float((a.argmax(1) == best_te).mean())
   121	delta = r_w['mAP'] - r_uni['mAP']
   122	print(f"\n[LPA RESULT h={H}]  uniform mAP={r_uni['mAP']:.3f}  weighted mAP={r_w['mAP']:.3f}  "

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12112:1. 触发观察：作者指出两个旧方法盲点。全局匹配损失偏向 hard negative，却忽略“正样本没有排到前面”的 unmatched positive；局部注意力方法只给最终融合结果，无法检查局部词和图像块到底有没有对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12113:2. 重定义动作：他们把问题从“挖 hard negative”改成“修正 unmatched positive”，又把 fine-grained alignment 从隐式注意力改成“显式可检查的全模式对齐”。关键词是 `full-mode`、`explicit fine-grained alignment`、`unmatched positive pairs`、`verification capability`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12114:3. 机制怎么长出来：`A-SDM` 很自然，若真实正样本相似度低于 batch 中最高相似样本，就增大该正样本的拉近权重。`EFA` 也顺着“可检查”长出来，用词 token 和图像 patch 的稀疏相似矩阵显式聚合，再用 hard coding 和排序损失约束 joint embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12116:5. reviewer 为什么买账：它卖的是视角加轻量机制。创新性不在“做局部对齐”本身，而在把已有的 hard negative 叙事反过来，强调 missed positive，并把隐式局部交互改造成可观察的显式过程。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12119:1. 触发观察：和 ACM 版一致，核心仍是 SDM 关注 hard negative、忽略 unmatched positive，以及隐式局部对齐不可验证。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12146:这批论文共同套路很清楚：先找一个旧叙事里的盲区，比如 hard negative 之外的 unmatched positive、强弱正样本差异、视觉瓶颈、视角解耦误伤；再把它命名成一个更具体的新问题；最后设计一个几乎能从这个新问题直接推出的损失或分支。真正值得学的是：好创新不是“模块看起来新”，而是观察、重定义、机制、消融四件事能互相咬住。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12159:1. 触发观察：作者指出两个旧方法盲点。全局匹配损失偏向 hard negative，却忽略“正样本没有排到前面”的 unmatched positive；局部注意力方法只给最终融合结果，无法检查局部词和图像块到底有没有对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12160:2. 重定义动作：他们把问题从“挖 hard negative”改成“修正 unmatched positive”，又把 fine-grained alignment 从隐式注意力改成“显式可检查的全模式对齐”。关键词是 `full-mode`、`explicit fine-grained alignment`、`unmatched positive pairs`、`verification capability`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12161:3. 机制怎么长出来：`A-SDM` 很自然，若真实正样本相似度低于 batch 中最高相似样本，就增大该正样本的拉近权重。`EFA` 也顺着“可检查”长出来，用词 token 和图像 patch 的稀疏相似矩阵显式聚合，再用 hard coding 和排序损失约束 joint embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12163:5. reviewer 为什么买账：它卖的是视角加轻量机制。创新性不在“做局部对齐”本身，而在把已有的 hard negative 叙事反过来，强调 missed positive，并把隐式局部交互改造成可观察的显式过程。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12166:1. 触发观察：和 ACM 版一致，核心仍是 SDM 关注 hard negative、忽略 unmatched positive，以及隐式局部对齐不可验证。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12193:这批论文共同套路很清楚：先找一个旧叙事里的盲区，比如 hard negative 之外的 unmatched positive、强弱正样本差异、视觉瓶颈、视角解耦误伤；再把它命名成一个更具体的新问题；最后设计一个几乎能从这个新问题直接推出的损失或分支。真正值得学的是：好创新不是“模块看起来新”，而是观察、重定义、机制、消融四件事能互相咬住。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:569:**候选三+拓宽先例核查(codex, candidate3_and_broaden-codex.md)**: 候选三(阶段顺序敏感稀疏旧域桥选择) 4/10,被 AKT/DASA/DKAR/DKP/PKA/LSTKC 从"动态迁移+旧知识过滤"两侧挤,只有当便宜先导证明域距离能预测遗忘/迁移(Spearman≥0.4、近远旧域遗忘差>1mAP)且随机相似度/最远桥/全旧域均匀对照吃掉增益才值得做。拓宽最不坏两条: task-free/无边界终身(按相机时间 shard 漂移触发 micro-domain,4.5/10,协议风险高,最接近 CIPR/CVS) > 候选三收窄版(4/10)。整体判断: 当前数据(缺 Duke/CUHK-SYSU/CUHK03)+算力下终身方法稿 3-4/10,codex 诚实建议若前提都不成立则别硬做、把 exp029 基建当协议分析素材退回更稳形态。**策略: 先用 exp029 一条序列同时验候选二(陈旧阶梯)和候选三(域距离→遗忘)两个前提的经验证据,有强信号再投;两个前提都经验证伪才把"是否离开终身方向"作为有证据的大方向问题抛用户。**

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3866:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:1:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3889:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:5:**范围**: `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 全文 + `design.md` + 模型接口源码验证 + 与 frozen baseline 的对照隔离
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3917:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:65:### LM-ReID loss

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

The key requirement passes: OVLI projection params are added via `list(model.parameters()) + list(ovli.parameters())`, and the optimizer assert checks `ovli.proj.parameters()` are present: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:559).
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4467:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5053:- **Medium:** OVLI loss can silently have reduced effective signal because `RandomIdentitySampler` samples `K` images per PID but does not force opposite-view composition: [cargo_dataset.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/afd_reid/cargo_dataset.py:226). The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4488:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5782:./reassess/r_3.md:3108:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3322:./validate/v_3.md:15165:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4490:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1911:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:62:2. fine-tune 阶段从 HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4491:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1912:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:63:3. 每张图每 iter 采样 `M=2-4` 个 lattice variants，周期性或 eval 用完整 `K=9`。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4492:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1915:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:93:5. lattice variants 固定 K=9，主实验用 3x3 phase；bbox jitter/kernel variants 做 ablation，不要无限扩 K。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4505:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2195:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4263:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4507:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2300:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4377:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。
