experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4544:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4606:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/remedy_rethink.md:87:你的零训练预检已经把关键矛盾打出来了：Market 是 strong-distractor / extreme-negative regime，OD 是 weak-positive regime。对 OD 而言，extreme-negative margin ≈ trivial 1x-top1-margin，说明这个 loss 没有独立信号，继续训大概率只是把普通 hard mining / AP surrogate 换个名字。文献上 large-gallery 确实是 ReID 真实问题，且大 gallery 会因 appearance ambiguity 掉性能([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.03282))；但 occluded ReID 的主问题常被归到 missing information、misalignment、noise 等正样本证据不足([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.14452))，这支持你的 OD 诊断。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_13.md:7719:1. **触发观察**：ReID 跨数据集泛化差。PK sampler 全局随机，小 batch 内样本关系弱，难以提供有效 hard samples。已有 graph sampler 又慢，数据规模大时不稳定。作者还注意到，采样质量依赖 backbone 特征，而 backbone 又依赖采样到的训练样本。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_13.md:7721:3. **机制怎么长出来**：CGS 每个 epoch 用 Spherical-LSH 先把相近类别放进 bucket，再用 feature-map adaptive matching 找邻近类别，构造相关 hard batch。GSANet 保持高分辨率流，GRSR 用稀疏全局相关像素重构特征，提升特征质量。特征更好会让下一轮 CGS 更好，CGS 更好又提供更有价值样本。这个“互相增强”的逻辑成立，但模块数量较多，绑定不如 GAReID 干净。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13235:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义自然推出的。既然图像侧身份结构比文本侧稳定，就把图库图像聚类成 prototype；既然单张图像匹配容易被 hard positive 或 hard negative 干扰，就把 Query-Gallery 相似度和 Query-Prototype 相似度融合；既然聚类粒度难固定，就加多阶段 PDE 和 ACE 自动估计 prototype 数。这个机制和问题绑定得很紧，核心不是“聚类新”，而是“推理时用图像身份原型校准跨模态实例分数”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13316:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义自然推出的。既然图像侧身份结构比文本侧稳定，就把图库图像聚类成 prototype；既然单张图像匹配容易被 hard positive 或 hard negative 干扰，就把 Query-Gallery 相似度和 Query-Prototype 相似度融合；既然聚类粒度难固定，就加多阶段 PDE 和 ACE 自动估计 prototype 数。这个机制和问题绑定得很紧，核心不是“聚类新”，而是“推理时用图像身份原型校准跨模态实例分数”。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **LS-MRT 死**：冻 backbone probe，smoke 时 P(D×D linear ~1M params)过拟合暴跌 −8.694；修复（identity-reg + 降 lr + 全量 116k samples）后 **+0.028 clean FAIL**（K-cosine 不升，但 P 不帮忙）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:43:- **LPA 死**：query-side 加权 +0.075，预测最佳变体 acc 12.4%≈chance。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:827:./reviews/deep_7.md:7049:4. 证据闭环：Table 1 很强。单标签里 F、C、I 各有表现，两两组合普遍强于单标签，HPL 三标签又强于两标签；加 PLC 从 80.3/92.5 提到 82.5/92.9，加 CCL 比普通 CL 更好，最终 Ours 达到 87.2 mAP、95.0 Rank-1。Table 2 还证明 DBSCAN 做 fine、K-means 做 coarse 最优，Table 3 讨论 hard/soft 标签形式。这些消融直接证明“异质标签互补”这个重定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:950:./reviews/deep_13.md:7721:3. **机制怎么长出来**：CGS 每个 epoch 用 Spherical-LSH 先把相近类别放进 bucket，再用 feature-map adaptive matching 找邻近类别，构造相关 hard batch。GSANet 保持高分辨率流，GRSR 用稀疏全局相关像素重构特征，提升特征质量。特征更好会让下一轮 CGS 更好，CGS 更好又提供更有价值样本。这个“互相增强”的逻辑成立，但模块数量较多，绑定不如 GAReID 干净。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:3239:./reviews/deep_21.md:7687:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:3240:./reviews/deep_21.md:7691:4. **证据闭环**：关键消融是正样本选择策略对比：corresponding proxy、all proxies、hardest positive proxy，以及是否使用 CCHNM。FNPM 部分又验证了排除同相机 proxy 和 anti-noise ranking 的作用。可视化包括 t-SNE、Top-10 检索和 Grad-CAM，用来证明不是只涨点，而是类内更紧、类间更开、注意力更落在人身上。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4405:./novelty_hubness.md:101:| (c) hard-negative mining / anti-hub margin / proxy metric learning | **部分撞车，杀伤最大** | ReID hard mining/HAP2S/MS loss 主要按 anchor-local difficulty/相似度加权，不是全局误吸附 in-degree。**但 HAL 和 NeighborRetr 已经非常接近“训练端 hubness-aware loss + memory/global stats”**，只是任务是图文/跨模态检索，不是 person ReID。 | HAL 用 memory bank 和 kNN query 统计 hub，并在训练 loss 中加权；NeighborRetr 明确 bad/good hubs、centrality、memory bank、训练端缓解 hubness。链接：[HAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097), [NeighborRetr](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526), [HAP2S ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11206), [MS Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06627) | 9 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4408:./novelty_hubness.md:111:- **必须做的对照**：baseline triplet/CE、batch-hard/HAP2S 或 MS-style local hard negative、k-reciprocal 仅作为 post-hoc reference、HAL/NeighborRetr 思路的简化移植强对照。这样才能证明不是普通 hard negative，也不是 test-time re-ranking。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4445:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:325:3. **机制怎么长出来**：CGS 每个 epoch 用 Spherical-LSH 先把相近类别放进 bucket，再用 feature-map adaptive matching 找邻近类别，构造相关 hard batch。GSANet 保持高分辨率流，GRSR 用稀疏全局相关像素重构特征，提升特征质量。特征更好会让下一轮 CGS 更好，CGS 更好又提供更有价值样本。这个“互相增强”的逻辑成立，但模块数量较多，绑定不如 GAReID 干净。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4463:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:883:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4464:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:887:4. **证据闭环**：关键消融是正样本选择策略对比：corresponding proxy、all proxies、hardest positive proxy，以及是否使用 CCHNM。FNPM 部分又验证了排除同相机 proxy 和 anti-noise ranking 的作用。可视化包括 t-SNE、Top-10 检索和 Grad-CAM，用来证明不是只涨点，而是类内更紧、类间更开、注意力更落在人身上。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4494:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1576:2. 重定义动作：它把 ReID 从“所有查询都用同一个特征管线”改写成“检索应该根据查询难度动态分配计算资源”。关键词是 coarse-to-fine retrieval、query difficulty、early exit、easy query、hard query、adaptive resource allocation。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4495:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1580:4. 证据闭环：最关键的是三类证据连起来了。第一，global 和 global+part 在不同难度数据集上的收益差异证明观察成立。第二，early-exit 阈值的表格展示了 mAP、rank1 和 FLOPs 的权衡，证明它真在做资源分配。第三，easy/hard 查询可视化和 Top-10 检索结果说明简单样本用全局足够，困难样本确实从部件阶段受益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4500:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1772:4. 证据闭环：Table 1 很强。单标签里 F、C、I 各有表现，两两组合普遍强于单标签，HPL 三标签又强于两标签；加 PLC 从 80.3/92.5 提到 82.5/92.9，加 CCL 比普通 CL 更好，最终 Ours 达到 87.2 mAP、95.0 Rank-1。Table 2 还证明 DBSCAN 做 fine、K-means 做 coarse 最优，Table 3 讨论 hard/soft 标签形式。这些消融直接证明“异质标签互补”这个重定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5573:./reassess/r_2.md:1925:reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5940:./reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:506:**候选三+拓宽先例核查(codex, candidate3_and_broaden-codex.md)**: 候选三(阶段顺序敏感稀疏旧域桥选择) 4/10,被 AKT/DASA/DKAR/DKP/PKA/LSTKC 从"动态迁移+旧知识过滤"两侧挤,只有当便宜先导证明域距离能预测遗忘/迁移(Spearman≥0.4、近远旧域遗忘差>1mAP)且随机相似度/最远桥/全旧域均匀对照吃掉增益才值得做。拓宽最不坏两条: task-free/无边界终身(按相机时间 shard 漂移触发 micro-domain,4.5/10,协议风险高,最接近 CIPR/CVS) > 候选三收窄版(4/10)。整体判断: 当前数据(缺 Duke/CUHK-SYSU/CUHK03)+算力下终身方法稿 3-4/10,codex 诚实建议若前提都不成立则别硬做、把 exp029 基建当协议分析素材退回更稳形态。**策略: 先用 exp029 一条序列同时验候选二(陈旧阶梯)和候选三(域距离→遗忘)两个前提的经验证据,有强信号再投;两个前提都经验证伪才把"是否离开终身方向"作为有证据的大方向问题抛用户。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_21.md:7687:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_21.md:7689:3. **机制怎么长出来**：HCPM 假设当前伪标签基本可信，从同簇里找和 query 最不相似的相机 proxy 当 hardest positive，再从这个 hardest camera 里找 hard negatives，控制背景和视角因素。FNPM 则承认伪标签有噪声，先排除同相机 proxy，再按相似度排序挖潜在假负样本，并用同 proxy 多 query 排名求和做抗噪。PKGC 是额外的特征增强，用多尺度全局上下文让网络看身份相关区域。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_21.md:7691:4. **证据闭环**：关键消融是正样本选择策略对比：corresponding proxy、all proxies、hardest positive proxy，以及是否使用 CCHNM。FNPM 部分又验证了排除同相机 proxy 和 anti-noise ranking 的作用。可视化包括 t-SNE、Top-10 检索和 Grad-CAM，用来证明不是只涨点，而是类内更紧、类间更开、注意力更落在人身上。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_27.md:448:**候选三+拓宽先例核查(codex, candidate3_and_broaden-codex.md)**: 候选三(阶段顺序敏感稀疏旧域桥选择) 4/10,被 AKT/DASA/DKAR/DKP/PKA/LSTKC 从"动态迁移+旧知识过滤"两侧挤,只有当便宜先导证明域距离能预测遗忘/迁移(Spearman≥0.4、近远旧域遗忘差>1mAP)且随机相似度/最远桥/全旧域均匀对照吃掉增益才值得做。拓宽最不坏两条: task-free/无边界终身(按相机时间 shard 漂移触发 micro-domain,4.5/10,协议风险高,最接近 CIPR/CVS) > 候选三收窄版(4/10)。整体判断: 当前数据(缺 Duke/CUHK-SYSU/CUHK03)+算力下终身方法稿 3-4/10,codex 诚实建议若前提都不成立则别硬做、把 exp029 基建当协议分析素材退回更稳形态。**策略: 先用 exp029 一条序列同时验候选二(陈旧阶梯)和候选三(域距离→遗忘)两个前提的经验证据,有强信号再投;两个前提都经验证伪才把"是否离开终身方向"作为有证据的大方向问题抛用户。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:6376:1. 触发观察：无监督 ReID 的伪标签错误主要集中在聚类边界。聚类中心对比学习稳定但太粗，不处理实例级边界 hard sample；小批次 hard mining 又只能看局部样本，和全局 memory bank 不匹配。同时，作者认为普通残差连接缺少对特征演化过程的建模。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:6378:2. 重定义动作：他们把“伪标签噪声”重定义成“最近邻类别边界样本没有被精细约束”。关键词是 nearest neighbor sample constraint、cluster boundary、hard samples、inter-class balance、pseudo-label quality、ODE guided feature reconstruction。这个重定义比“改进聚类”更具体，因为它指出了错误发生的位置。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:6380:3. 机制怎么长出来：NNSC 保留聚类中心 memory 维持稳定，同时在实例 memory 中为每个 query 找最远正样本和最近负样本，专门拉开最近邻类别边界。CB loss 用凹函数和 Jensen 不等式解释，当分类概率接近均匀时说明样本处于混淆区，最小化它就是把 hard sample 推离边界。ODE-FR 用三阶隐式 Adams 公式构造残差模块，插到 ResNet 第三层增强表示。NNSC 和 CB 与重定义绑定很紧，ODE-FR 更像第二条“表示能力不足”的补强线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:6382:4. 证据闭环：最关键的是 CB 前后的 t-SNE 边界样本可视化、NNSC/CB/ODE-FR 的逐项消融、NNSC 和传统 contrastive loss 的对比、CB 和其他 loss 的对比、ODE-FR 插入位置和替代模块对比、正负样本距离分布、Top-8 检索可视化。这个闭环能支撑“边界 hard sample 被更好地区分”，但 ODE 理论本身的证据相对弱一些。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:6384:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇主要卖机制，但机制有一个明确失败点托住。novelty 不是“又挖 hard sample”，而是“中心稳定约束加全 memory 最近邻实例修正”。ODE-FR 提供额外新鲜感，不过真正承重的是边界样本重定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:8:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:43:- vs hard-negative mining: H_neg 是全局误吸附(对很多身份), 非 anchor-local difficulty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train2_backbone.txt:78:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train2_backbone.txt:92:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train2_backbone.txt:124:可先用当前 K=9 marginalization 的 posterior 当 teacher：哪个 lattice 对真 ID / hard positive 最有利，就让 STN 学近似 canonical crop。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:310:- **实验硬门槛**: 必须 beat ① random/loss-self-paced ② feature-distance hard/moderate positive mining ③ **2D-part-visibility / VPM-QPM-style overlap**。③最关键——若 2D 关节可见性解释得一样好, GOPL=老visibility换名, 死。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:325:4. **hard-positive tail**: cosine 距离最大的 top-k% same-ID pair(最难正样本)里, 低 cov 占比是否显著高(证现 loss 在强拉不该早拉的边)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:334:**通过标准:** (核心1-4成立) + (D1置换破) + (D2 SMPL>bbox/cam) + (D3 SMPL beyond feature-dist) + **(D4 cov3d>cov2d 明显)**。D4 不过 = GOPL 没独特性, 降级。全过 = GOPL 隐藏变量真实且 SMPL 几何独特, 写训练版(geometry-ordered positive graph + 课程权重, beat random/self-paced/feature-hard/2D-vis 四对照)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:1054:| (a) hard-positive mining / sample re-weighting / positive reliability ReID | 局部撞车 | [CDML](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.07545) 明确说 intra-class positive pair 要谨慎选，提出 moderate positive mining；[AITL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.07597) 直接讨论 “Distance Variance among Different Positives”，用属性距离处理同 ID positives 差异；[DSPL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.05711) 用 self-paced 权重压低早期低置信样本。 | 这些是按 feature loss、attribute、样本难度做 positive 选择/加权，不是按 **SMPL mesh 共同可见表面 IoU** 定义正边可靠性，也没有 geometry-positive graph。不能声称“首次发现正样本不等价”，但可声称“首次用人体表面共同可观测性解释并组织 positive relation”。 | 8/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:1059:| (f) graph-sampler / relation ReID | 存活 | [SGGNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.09975) 建 probe-gallery relation graph；[GCT](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.00242) 用 graph matching 做 correspondence transfer；[PVPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230) 也用 graph matching；[CLIP-DFGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11255) 用 graph sampler 做 hard sample mining。 | graph / sampler / relation 都不新。GOPL 要强调 graph 的边权来自 **SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap**，且图服务于 same-ID positive learning order，而不是检索时关系推理。 | 7/10 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:24:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2685:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:27:① +0.54 真弱到放弃训练端 lattice 故事? 还是 severe h=16 的 +0.54(高 h 处 ordinary≈lattice)算有意义信号?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2702:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2705:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:89:如果后续 test-time lattice 对 ordinary TTA 的优势在多 seed/多数据集上消失，再弃。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2928:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2929:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2940:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2941:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2975:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2976:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2977:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2978:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2979:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2980:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2981:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2982:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2984:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2985:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2986:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2987:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2988:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2989:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2990:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2991:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2992:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2993:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2994:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2995:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3001:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3002:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3003:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3004:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3005:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3006:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3007:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3903:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3025:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3026:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3027:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3028:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3029:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3030:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3928:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:121:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3113:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4052:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3114:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4054:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3115:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4055:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3116:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4059:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3117:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4062:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3118:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4071:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3119:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4074:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3120:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4078:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3121:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4084:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21526:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21529:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2805:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1645:reassess/r_3.md:3621:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3520:区别：它和 AOANet 的区别是不用 2D 自适应分块讲遮挡，而是用 SMPL 表面可见性定义哪些证据可比较。它和 `Beyond geometry` 的区别是避开完整 UVTexture 和重排序，重点做低清航拍到地面里的可观测性约束，目标是训练出单 embedding 或表面 token embedding。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21538:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1766:reassess/r_3.md:3895:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3386:我会优先押第 1 个和第 2 个。它们的问题层面更清楚，也最能把团队的 aerial-ground 和 SMPL 基建变成别人不容易复刻的机制。第 3 个有潜力，但依赖视频或稳定 SMPL 质量。第 4 个成本最低，适合作为辅助机制，不适合单独当 B 类主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21540:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21541:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21542:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21546:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1845:reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21575:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3189:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4242:reassess/r_2.md:1264:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21583:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4321:reassess/r_2.md:1602:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21585:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4332:reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21586:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4339:reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21587:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4340:reassess/r_2.md:1656:reassess/r_3.md:3665:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:687:target individuals among multiple non-overlapping camera viewpoints.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21588:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3332:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4385:reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21599:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3387:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5022:reassess/r_3.md:2759:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6450:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报最终涨点，而是分别证明 DMM 和 CDCN 的角色。消融显示 DMM 提升抗遗忘但会牺牲适应性，CDCN 提升适应性并改善记忆，二者组合互相补偿。另一个关键证据是 DMM 只放在重放阶段最好，放在适应阶段会污染相机认知节点。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21614:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3539:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5174:reassess/r_3.md:3470:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:270:用户指令（原话要点）："不要把自己限定在遮挡这个领域，大胆创新，大胆做所有可能让我们稳发 B 类的实验，三台 GPU 全用，不依赖 codex（额度尽，06-11 13:01 恢复），别用 Workflow（会话额度也耗尽过一次），你自己做全部决定，我去睡觉。" 方向部署见决策 #42：锚点先行的双战场，主纲领"强人本主干 + 训练期新信息源/训练组织，测试单 embedding 冻结"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3551:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5186:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21636:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21647:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3823:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6250:/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments | rg '("'^|/)(results|decisions|innovation_brainstorm|story|design|monitor)'"\\.md"'$'"'" in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21648:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21649:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21691:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21694:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21706:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21708:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21715:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21716:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21717:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21722:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21723:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21733:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21734:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21735:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21736:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21737:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21738:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21739:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

The key requirement passes: OVLI projection params are added via `list(model.parameters()) + list(ovli.parameters())`, and the optimizer assert checks `ovli.proj.parameters()` are present: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:559).

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22009:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4505:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2195:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4263:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22011:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4507:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2300:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4377:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22048:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4544:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22049:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22109:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:378:> We reveal a **physically directed information asymmetry** in aerial-ground person ReID, and show that symmetric alignment / late-interaction is the wrong matching assumption: the low-altitude aerial observation is an under-determined projection whose identity evidence must be matched by **directional containment**, not symmetric similarity.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:394:- **实验硬门槛**: 必须 beat ① random/loss-self-paced ② feature-distance hard/moderate positive mining ③ **2D-part-visibility / VPM-QPM-style overlap**。③最关键——若 2D 关节可见性解释得一样好, GOPL=老visibility换名, 死。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:409:4. **hard-positive tail**: cosine 距离最大的 top-k% same-ID pair(最难正样本)里, 低 cov 占比是否显著高(证现 loss 在强拉不该早拉的边)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:418:**通过标准:** (核心1-4成立) + (D1置换破) + (D2 SMPL>bbox/cam) + (D3 SMPL beyond feature-dist) + **(D4 cov3d>cov2d 明显)**。D4 不过 = GOPL 没独特性, 降级。全过 = GOPL 隐藏变量真实且 SMPL 几何独特, 写训练版(geometry-ordered positive graph + 课程权重, beat random/self-paced/feature-hard/2D-vis 四对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:433:> 大家以为强 ReID 失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"（pairwise 相似度病），其实是 **少数 gallery 样本变成很多 query 的吸附点**——错误是 **many-to-one 的图库拓扑病**。ReID 不是独立 query-gallery pair matching，而是 **directed kNN graph retrieval**；隐藏变量不是 hard-negative distance，而是 gallery 的 **负向 in-degree / hub mass**（≠hard negative：hard 是对一个 anchor 近；hub 是对**很多不同身份**都近，是全局误吸附点）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:613:3. **frozen-feature 隐藏变量反复被成熟 test-time 工具碾压**：k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking/hard-negative 覆盖了 retrieval/topology-side 的明显隐藏变量。新 accuracy 隐藏变量极难逃脱。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:973:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:975:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:76:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.
