experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8868:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:11:- **实验硬门槛**: 必须 beat ① random/loss-self-paced ② feature-distance hard/moderate positive mining ③ **2D-part-visibility / VPM-QPM-style overlap**。③最关键——若 2D 关节可见性解释得一样好, GOPL=老visibility换名, 死。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8879:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:35:**通过标准:** (核心1-4成立) + (D1置换破) + (D2 SMPL>bbox/cam) + (D3 SMPL beyond feature-dist) + **(D4 cov3d>cov2d 明显)**。D4 不过 = GOPL 没独特性, 降级。全过 = GOPL 隐藏变量真实且 SMPL 几何独特, 写训练版(geometry-ordered positive graph + 课程权重, beat random/self-paced/feature-hard/2D-vis 四对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8887:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8892:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10211:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:205:**候选三+拓宽先例核查(codex, candidate3_and_broaden-codex.md)**: 候选三(阶段顺序敏感稀疏旧域桥选择) 4/10,被 AKT/DASA/DKAR/DKP/PKA/LSTKC 从"动态迁移+旧知识过滤"两侧挤,只有当便宜先导证明域距离能预测遗忘/迁移(Spearman≥0.4、近远旧域遗忘差>1mAP)且随机相似度/最远桥/全旧域均匀对照吃掉增益才值得做。拓宽最不坏两条: task-free/无边界终身(按相机时间 shard 漂移触发 micro-domain,4.5/10,协议风险高,最接近 CIPR/CVS) > 候选三收窄版(4/10)。整体判断: 当前数据(缺 Duke/CUHK-SYSU/CUHK03)+算力下终身方法稿 3-4/10,codex 诚实建议若前提都不成立则别硬做、把 exp029 基建当协议分析素材退回更稳形态。**策略: 先用 exp029 一条序列同时验候选二(陈旧阶梯)和候选三(域距离→遗忘)两个前提的经验证据,有强信号再投;两个前提都经验证伪才把"是否离开终身方向"作为有证据的大方向问题抛用户。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10632:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5573:./reassess/r_2.md:1925:reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10954:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1226:./reviews/deep_21.md:7687:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10956:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1238:./reviews/deep_21.md:7768:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10999:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2874:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:883:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11019:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3017:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1516:3. 机制怎么长出来：两阶段训练是从重定义自然推出来的。第一阶段只做 camera proxy 级别的模态内对比，用 CDL 在每个相机域内找局部 hard negatives，先把单模态结构稳住。DCMU 更新 memory 时偏向 hard samples，让簇中心不被 easy samples 拖走。第二阶段再用 PCM 通过匈牙利匹配建立可见光和红外之间的 class/proxy 双层对应。GCR 测试时再把 camera 信息放进图重排序，属于对“camera 信息全流程使用”的延伸。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11088:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4102:../litreview/reviews/lit_5.md:3602:廉价否决实验：冻结 SOLIDER，在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上提特征范数、SMPL 可见面积、pose 置信度，看它们是否显著解释 hard query 错误。如果相关性不强，或只训练一个可见性条件 margin 头没有提升 hard aerial split，就砍掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11092:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4108:../litreview/reviews/lit_5.md:3612:廉价否决实验：不用训练，先把同身份跨视角 pair 的 Swin token 相似度按 SMPL 可见部位重算，和全局相似度比 hard positive 排名。如果可见部位分数不能明显提升 hard positive 排名，这条不值得做。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11095:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4118:../litreview/reviews/lit_5.md:3667:廉价否决实验：冻结 SOLIDER，在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上提特征范数、SMPL 可见面积、pose 置信度，看它们是否显著解释 hard query 错误。如果相关性不强，或只训练一个可见性条件 margin 头没有提升 hard aerial split，就砍掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4124:../litreview/reviews/lit_5.md:3677:廉价否决实验：不用训练，先把同身份跨视角 pair 的 Swin token 相似度按 SMPL 可见部位重算，和全局相似度比 hard positive 排名。如果可见部位分数不能明显提升 hard positive 排名，这条不值得做。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:259:4. **证据闭环**：它的证据链较完整。组件 ablation 显示 SSTI 对 appearance confusion 有贡献，CMF 对 frame-level feature 贡献更大；fusion strategy 对比证明不是随便 concat 3D 就行；SSTI 和 GRU/self-attention、空间/时间单流等变体对比证明“空间和时间 shape 交互”必要；t-SNE、Grad-CAM、hard occlusion feature map 展示模型确实更关注目标区域。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11616:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:391:1. 触发观察：作者抓住无监督 ReID memory contrastive learning 的三个内部矛盾。第一，camera variation 会让同相机不同身份比跨相机同身份更近，Jaccard 聚类偏向错误邻居。第二，已有方法用 mean feature 当 cluster proxy，默认簇是球形，但 ReID 特征常是非球形流形，均值可能落在低密度空区。第三，one-hot hard pseudo label 对噪声不稳，会放大错误监督。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12947:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12950:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

The code findings so far align with it: no hard shape/device bug, but there are two method-risk issues around AMP semantics and cold-start/temperature dynamics, plus novelty overlap.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17700:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19337:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19340:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15094:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4765:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:440:现成 exp255 特征 probe。purity@20 clean(0.714)→heavy(0.89) **反升 +0.067**(遮挡不破坏邻域); rho(damage,occlusion)=+0.072≈0; damage 与 triplet-hardness rho=+0.08、jaccard 0.095(≈随机)=噪声。诊断拆出真因: 遮挡图属大 ID(图数 40.6→101.5)→kNN purity 机械偏高=ID-size confound, 非结构优势; 近重复紧致度持平排除抱团。**KILL: TopoFR 赖以工作的"遮挡破坏拓扑"现象在 SOTA backbone 下不存在(被压平)。**

    10	def shuffle_unit(features, shift, group, begin=1):
    11	
    12	    batchsize = features.size(0)
    13	    dim = features.size(-1)
    14	    # Shift Operation
    15	    feature_random = torch.cat([features[:, begin-1+shift:], features[:, begin:begin-1+shift]], dim=1)
    16	    x = feature_random
    17	    # Patch Shuffle Operation
    18	    try:
    19	        x = x.view(batchsize, group, -1, dim)
    20	    except:
    21	        x = torch.cat([x, x[:, -2:-1, :]], dim=1)
    22	        x = x.view(batchsize, group, -1, dim)
    23	
    24	    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    25	    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, dim)
    26	
    27	    return x

这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。
exec
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"loss_mode[ =]hard|--loss_mode hard|gamma_hard|tau_hard|Hard-Lattice|Hard-ordinary|hard ordinary|ordinary-aug|--aug_mode ordinary|lam_marg 0|lam_cons 0|noLMloss|no-LM-loss|cons-only|exp359_abl|exp359_hard|hard_lattice|hardlat|bqd5skbum|b46h62df9|76\\.894|76\\.90|77\\.44\" experiments/exp359_lm_reid experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/*.md experiments/decisions.md -S" in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6595:`M=3 no-LM-loss +3.82` 现在**还不能宣称 lattice-specific**。它可能只是：

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:24:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2702:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3394:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3395:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:82:**★命门对照（4090 跑中 `b46h62df9`）= M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM**（同 3 views/h/步数，variants 换普通 random crop/flip/color，非 lattice）：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3400:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:92:| no-LM-loss（M=3 lattice） | **77.44** | 79.90 | +2.576 | 88.92 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3401:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:94:- lattice-aug 仅 **+0.54** over ordinary-aug（阈值 −1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific）；高 h 更平（h=24 84.00≈84.28，h=32 86.48≈86.44）→ **M=3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广"，lattice 训练不特殊**，salvage 主路 (a) 弱。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3402:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:95:- **★不对称（干净）**：test-time lattice-marg 四配置全 beat TTA（M=1 +3.727 / ordinary-aug +1.624 / lattice no-LM +2.576 / full +3.006）→ **lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable，在 training 不特殊**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3403:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3404:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:100:no-LM-loss ckpt，h=12/16/20/24/32，single vs lattice-marg vs 普通TTA（MaxSim）：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3408:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3409:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:114:- LM-S2-strong（强 TTA 防御）还在跑；**LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM**（3090，bqd5skbum，loss_mode=hard 已实现+smoke 过）epoch 0，待 Hard-ordinary 对照（需 Hard-Lat ≥+0.8 over Hard-ord 才算训练端活）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:117:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5184:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5192:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5194:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5195:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3061:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:24:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3082:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3086:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:41:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3092:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:51:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3098:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:9:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3104:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:24:- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3105:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:28:- 假设成立：lattice mAP > no-LM-loss 79.90 **+0.3~0.5**，且 single_mean 不掉 >0.8（单变体判别力保住）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3137:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3142:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3145:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4620:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4628:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4639:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4649:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4668:- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4680:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4686:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4699:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4714:- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4718:- 假设成立：lattice mAP > no-LM-loss 79.90 **+0.3~0.5**，且 single_mean 不掉 >0.8（单变体判别力保住）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4724:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4732:- 非 **Hard-Lattice ERM**（76.894 死）：把 K 变体当检索证据集，非独立硬样本逐个 ERM。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4758:1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3107:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:34:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6265:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3137:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3142:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6267:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3145:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3159:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6328:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train_lens3_import.txt:57:- 再训小模型 10 epoch：h16 lattice-marg 比 no-LM-loss baseline 多 `+0.6 mAP`，HR sanity 掉幅 <0.3

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6332:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3386:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6333:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6334:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3394:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6340:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3408:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:1137:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5218:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5219:- **M=3 lattice-aug no-LM(每iter 3 个 sampling-lattice variants: sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel)**: **77.44**, lattice 79.90, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +2.576
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5275:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5285:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3939:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:13:- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:25:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:31:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:37:1. **embedding invariance hurts**: full LM 75.71 < no-LM 77.44，HR sanity 86.09 < 88.92，L_marg 主害。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:39:3. **backbone set/robust training damages base**: LSRC HR 88.92→85.84 / lattice 79.90→77.98，Hard-Lattice 76.9 < 77.44，train acc 1.0 但 test 掉。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:43:- **K-sweep**（compute-accuracy）: K=1→3→5→9 = 77.44→78.73→79.61→79.90，**K=5 达 87% 收益≈K=9** → "防 compute" K=5 sweet spot。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6515:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8048:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3233:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8050:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9954:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9959:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9962:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9965:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6515:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:11578:- M=3 no-LM-loss(每iter 3个lattice variants[sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel]增强, 但关掉 L_marg+L_cons): single **77.44**, lattice 79.90, SANITY HR 88.92

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12540:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:6124:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13195:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2771:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1930:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:20:1. **frozen-feature 重投影/重加权**（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075）— no-LM-loss 特征对边缘化已最优、无 headroom。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:3. **robust ERM**（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）— worst-case 也救不了。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:55:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6396:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6397:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6448:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6458:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6459:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6474:2. ordinary-aug 模型也吃 lattice marginalization；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6475:3. lattice-aug 训练只比 ordinary-aug 多 `+0.54`；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6494:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6507:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6515:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6517:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10128:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10129:- **M=3 lattice-aug no-LM(每iter 3 个 sampling-lattice variants: sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel)**: **77.44**, lattice 79.90, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +2.576
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10133:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10134:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10138:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10185:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10193:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10195:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10196:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10290:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10570:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10578:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10580:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10581:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10647:- **Critical**: `loss_mode == 'lsrc'` 只是在 `L_id` 里追加 LSRC，最终总 loss 仍默认包含 `lam_marg=1.0` 和 `lam_cons=0.2`。也就是说不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 时，实验仍混入已证伪的 `L_marg/L_cons`。这会直接污染 LSRC 结论。见 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:473)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10665:简短结论：**先不要 approve 正式训练。** 至少先强制 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，并补一个非对称 `query-lattice-set × gallery-HR-single` 版本；否则 LSRC 很可能被旧 harmful loss 和 M×M train/test mismatch 一起带偏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10672:- **Critical**: `loss_mode == 'lsrc'` 只是在 `L_id` 里追加 LSRC，最终总 loss 仍默认包含 `lam_marg=1.0` 和 `lam_cons=0.2`。也就是说不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 时，实验仍混入已证伪的 `L_marg/L_cons`。这会直接污染 LSRC 结论。见 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:473)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3233:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
