experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3300:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3304:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3305:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:113:- **LM-S4 因子分解（h=16，single 77.44）**：phase +1.758 / **bbox +2.842（最大）** / zoom +1.702 / all +2.557 → **bbox 轴（±1 LR-pixel 检测框偏移）主导**，9 bbox > 3+3+3 混合。codex 预测 phase 不对，但 bbox 故事更直观（severe LR 检测框 ±1 LR 像素 = 几个 HR 像素 = 真实 crop 不确定性）。三轴全 beat TTA。→ nuisance 主要是 **LR 检测框/crop 不确定性**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3309:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3321:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4514:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4596:- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4608:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4614:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4640:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4645:1. **embedding invariance hurts**: full LM 75.71 < no-LM 77.44，HR sanity 86.09 < 88.92，L_marg 主害。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4647:3. **backbone set/robust training damages base**: LSRC HR 88.92→85.84 / lattice 79.90→77.98，Hard-Lattice 76.9 < 77.44，train acc 1.0 但 test 掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4651:- **K-sweep**（compute-accuracy K=1/3/5/9，已跑）: K=1→3→5→9 = 77.44→78.73→79.61→79.90，**K=5 达 87% 收益≈K=9**，边际递减 → "防 compute"论点 K=5 是 sweet spot。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:5045:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6120:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6128:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6130:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6131:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6187:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6189:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6190:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6205:2. ordinary-aug 模型也吃 lattice marginalization；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6206:3. lattice-aug 训练只比 ordinary-aug 多 `+0.54`；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6225:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14:用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4227:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2251:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5218:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2252:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5219:- **M=3 lattice-aug no-LM(每iter 3 个 sampling-lattice variants: sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel)**: **77.44**, lattice 79.90, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +2.576
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2258:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5275:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5285:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8352:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8427:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8429:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8431:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14622:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14669:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14670:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2258:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14990:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8361:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8385:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:873:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15021:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15161:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10502:   522	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15189:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15207:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10859:   879	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16604:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **BLC 被现有 LM-S4 数据证伪**（不用跑）：BLC = canonicalize bbox（固定 canonical）+ marginalize 残差。但 bbox 是主因子（marg bbox +2.84），canonicalize 它 = 放弃这大收益，只剩 phase/zoom marg ≈ **+1.7 < marginalize-all +2.557**；且 market 测试用标注框（已 canonical），BLC 让 K=9 marg 退化成 single 77.44 < 79.90。**canonicalize 主因子 < marginalize 它 → BLC 死。**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16612:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16630:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17114:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:18:- M=3 no-LM-loss(每iter 3个lattice variants[sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel]增强, 但关掉 L_marg+L_cons): single **77.44**, lattice 79.90, SANITY HR 88.92
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17125:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17126:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17129:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6595:`M=3 no-LM-loss +3.82` 现在**还不能宣称 lattice-specific**。它可能只是：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17130:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2583:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6633:1. **Hard-Lattice ERM / CVaR**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17138:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2615:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17140:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2680:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:19:- **M=3 lattice-aug no-LM(每iter 3 个 sampling-lattice variants: sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel)**: **77.44**, lattice 79.90, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +2.576
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17143:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17144:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:24:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17146:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17147:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17148:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17149:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2702:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

./experiments/decisions.md:693:- 🔴 红队（方案 A: PCRA）核心论点: PCRA 是唯一操作在未被探索维度（loss 距离度量）上的方案。26 个实验证明所有 forward path 改动都干扰 PSG，但 PCRA 不修改 forward path 也不添加 aux loss——它只改变 hard mining 中的距离计算。这是论文方法的"第三层"贡献（特征层 PSG + 架构层 PDS + 度量层 PCRA）。实现仅~20 行代码，0 新参数。风险极低：最差退化为 PSG baseline。Occluded-Duke 中 pose 相似的 negative 才是真正的 hard case（两个只露上半身的不同人），标准 triplet loss 对此毫无感知。PVR 的弱点在于 exp020 (PRA) 已证明辅助 loss 方向中性/负面(-0.5%)，且需要 part feature 提取（与 exp008 的失败模式重叠）。SPD 调参无论文价值。信心: 8/10

./experiments/exp175/claude_review.md:118:The `out` variable in `_run_stage_with_psg` return is the PRE-downsample output (same as the original Swin stage). The norm layer uses `num_features[i]` which matches the pre-downsample dimension. **Correct.**
./experiments/exp175/claude_review.md:126:The constructor parameterizes `feat_channels`. For stages [0,1,2,3] with channels [96,192,384,768], each PSG instance gets its own `feat_channels`. The encoder final layer is `Conv2d(hidden_dim, feat_channels, 1x1)`. The gate is then reshaped to `(B, H*W, C)` where C=feat_channels. This matches the input x shape `(B, H*W, C)`.
./experiments/exp175/claude_review.md:162:Applied at every PSG instance. Scene heatmaps are raw logits from ViTPose. Sigmoid is applied after interpolation, which is the correct order (interpolating logits is more stable than interpolating probabilities). **Correct.**

./experiments/exp175/claude_review.md:201:**Comparison**: exp173 (PAPE + PSG@[2,3]) ran on the same GPU. PSG@[0,1,2,3] replaces PAPE (which adds Conv2d(17->96, kxk) at (96,32) resolution, then adds to all tokens). The Stage 0/1 PSG operations are comparable in memory to PAPE. Should fit within similar memory budget.

./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:24:**M1. "Collapsed to hard replace" may be a mischaracterization.**
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:25:- `scrc_g ≈ 0.999` means the gate is saturated, but whether this equals "hard replace" depends on the SCRC formulation:
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:27:  - If `out = (1-gate) * orig + gate * bank`: gate=1.0 means true hard replace.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:28:- The monitor claims equivalence with hard replace without citing the formulation. This distinction matters: if SCRC is additive-residual, then gate=1.0 means "always add full completion" which is functionally different from SCFR's hard replace, and the conclusion that "SCRC ≈ SCFR therefore SCRC adds nothing" doesn't follow.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:31:- The design says "ep20 前后与 exp126 基本重合" and "epoch 30+ 后在 late-stage 验证上比 online teacher 更稳" but doesn't quantify what "more stable" means or define an early-stop threshold.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:34:**M3. The "SCFR/SCKD series" comparison pool is inconsistent.**
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:51:- Starting exp128 is **reasonable in principle** but has a critical prerequisite: exp126's results must be verified as positive before building on it. If exp126 itself was neutral or negative, exp128 is wasted GPU time.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:59:3. **Opportunity cost**: If the "exact sparse routing" line (exp125/126) is itself only marginally positive, layering freeze30 on top may not produce a publishable delta.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:65:1. **Before committing to exp128's full run**: Retrieve and document exp126's ep100/ep120 results. If exp126 didn't outperform exp116, reconsider whether the exact-topk direction is worth further investment.
./experiments/exp128/claude_review.md:66:2. **Clarify the SCRC gate formulation**: Read the actual code. If it's additive-residual, the "collapsed to hard replace" conclusion is wrong, and exp127's negative interpretation may need revision.

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1760:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:70:ReID 里 test-time/post-processing 不是不能发：k-reciprocal re-ranking 是无监督后处理并进了 CVPR 2017；FlipReID 明确讨论 ReID TTA 和训练-推理 gap；BNTA 也是 ReID test-time adaptation。通用视觉里，shift/aliasing/sub-pixel sensitivity 有 ICML/CVPR 先例。但我快速查了 “anti-aliasing / sampling lattice / subpixel / cross-resolution + person ReID”，没看到直接把 sampling lattice 当 LR-ReID hidden variable 的成熟先例。这个空位可用，但要讲窄、讲硬。来源：k-reciprocal ReID re-ranking、FlipReID、BNTA、anti-aliased CNN、fractional shift alias-free CNN、CR-ReID resolution-adaptive prior。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1764:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2743:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2744:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2745:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5572:./reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2776:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5695:./reassess/r_2.md:5832:reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. ./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2787:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5736:./reassess/r_2.md:6551:4. oracle cascade：只对 top p% unstable query 用 full feature，其余用 cheap feature。若 40-60% FLOPs 下 mAP 接近 full，方向活。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2840:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5816:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2841:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5817:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2842:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5818:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2843:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5819:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:2865:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5843:./reassess/r_3.md:4815:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:51:**收敛点(e30 matched)双确认**：λ=0 vs λ=1 同 rank16/seed/script 跑到 e30 oracle 仍**完全一致**——Jaccard 0.2646 vs 0.2627、oracle +0.85 vs +0.80、fusion best ALL 75.74 vs 75.73（λ=1 甚至略低）。**早期(e10)+收敛(e30) 双证据：解相关在任何训练阶段对互补性零效果。** 加上 decorr-floor 证据（λ=2 双倍权重只把 0.041 降 ~1% → ~0.041 是 ID-constrained floor，共享判别方向是 ID load-bearing 的、删不掉）。→ **张力对显式干预(e10/e30、λ∈{0,1,2}、λ=10 进行中)全程鲁棒，是 fundamental 的，不是可调超参。**

AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:5379:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**
