experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17177:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2838:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:18136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:973:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19877:这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19881:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:18:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19883:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19885:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19888:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19900:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19901:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:116:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19902:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:130:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:293:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19909:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19910:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19924:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19928:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2615:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19929:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2679:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:18:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19931:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19933:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19934:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19936:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2702:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19937:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19940:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2715:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:121:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20018:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5184:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20021:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5195:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20042:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20045:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20046:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20205:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20330:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6320:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20454:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:2927:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:58:ap.add_argument('--loss_mode', default='std', choices=['std', 'hard', 'lsrc'], help='hard=Hard-Lattice ERM (dead); lsrc=Lattice-Set Retrieval Contrastive (bag-to-bag set-supcon + neg-tail suppression, shapes backbone for decision marginalization)')
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20455:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20456:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3946:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20457:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20458:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3955:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3971:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20482:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5275:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20496:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20655:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20658:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20661:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20671:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20696:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20697:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20718:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20727:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20728:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:1179:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "LM-ReID|low-resolution|lattice|marginal|sampling|bbox|LSRC|LPA|LS-MRT|Hard-Lattice|BLC|adapter|LoRA|OA-SD|PLBOA" experiments -S' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20731:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20740:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20741:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6448:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20841:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7654:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20861:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10133:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20863:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10138:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20864:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10185:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20866:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10195:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20867:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10196:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10580:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20881:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10581:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20884:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10616:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20892:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20908:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20910:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20931:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4514:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:5045:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20944:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6073:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20945:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6120:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6130:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20948:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:6131:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20964:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20976:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21045:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8283:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14:用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21049:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21054:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21059:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8361:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21121:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21131:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10840:   860	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21211:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21215:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21217:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14610:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21226:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14622:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21237:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21280:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14982:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21281:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21282:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14984:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21291:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21322:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15189:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15202:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10840:   860	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15204:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21348:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15370:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13937:    17	**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21364:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21461:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17143:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:23:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21463:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17146:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21464:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17147:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21466:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17149:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2702:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:85:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21467:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21470:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17157:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2715:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:121:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21480:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17171:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21485:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19877:这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21567:./experiments/decisions.md:4708:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
