experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21977:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1764:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60:| LCRS（互补 residual） | 7/10 | `z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + α·P_k(g_k))`，shared identity core + lattice-specific residual subspace + decorr(只在分类正确后)。"准确后分工"非硬推开。test K=9 边缘化拿更富 union | 冻 backbone 训 P_shared/P_k/cls；活=K-error correlation 降+K=9 gain ≥+0.5，individual variant mAP 不掉>0.8 | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:61:| LRFD（disentangle） | 7/10 | `z_l=P_id, r_l=P_lat`(lattice nuisance sink, 必须能预测 lattice), per-variant CE+triplet, 推理丢 r_l 用 z_l 边缘化 | 冻 backbone 训 heads；活=with-lattice-code >+0.2 over without + r_l lattice-pred acc>60% | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:62:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:63:| DeepSets Marginalizer（LPA 修正） | 6.5/10 | 不预测 query 最佳变体(LPA 死因)，改 pairwise: 每个(q,g)的 K 个 cos 经 DeepSets φ/ρ 合成校准分, α 初 0 限幅, embedding 冻 | cached features 小 scorer；活=+0.4 over uniform, 且 ordinary-TTA scorer 追不平(否则只是 generic learned TTA) | 排队 |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:67:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6847:| 2 | **TPA: Teacher-Preserved Zero-Init Adapter** | 在最后 1 个 Swin block 插零初始化 adapter/LoRA，只训 adapter；loss 用普通 CE/triplet + pairwise/rank distill 保住 no-LM 排序 | 不是 full fine-tune；不让 set-loss 重塑判别边界；adapter residual 被 norm/rank distill 约束 | ep10 K9 不涨 >0.4 或 HR 88.92 掉到 <88.5，杀；adapter norm 爆或 train acc 很快 1.0 但 val 掉，杀 | **5.5/10** |

This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3038:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:17:① **method 是什么**? 候选: multi-query/tracklet 证据融合(evidence-aware, 用 lowtail-pos 决定何时/如何融) / retrieval reliability calibration(预测 fragile-query 给可靠性分, 不做恢复) / evidence-conditioned retrieval / 别的。关键约束: 利用'证据 union 有真 headroom'但—— (a)T3 是 oracle(需第 2 张同 ID 图), 真实部署'从哪来第 2 份证据'? multi-query/tracklet 设定可拿(注意: 这**不是** exp109 的 gallery-side completion identity-conditioned 墙, 是 query-side 多帧), 但 multi-query/set-based ReID 是已知设定, novelty 必须在'evidence-aware'机制不在'用多帧'本身; (b)不撞 occlusion/completion 死区; (c)T2 显示'静态失败预测'被 #false 吃掉, 别把 method 建在静态失败预测上, 要建在 tax-residual/fragility 或 evidence-gain 上。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:37:1. **embedding invariance hurts**: full LM 75.71 < no-LM 77.44，HR sanity 86.09 < 88.92，L_marg 主害。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6459:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3082:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3098:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:9:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3104:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:24:- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3142:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4878:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:10:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6208:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2771:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1930:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6211:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2774:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1933:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6282:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4439:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6298:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4628:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6299:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4668:- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6300:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4699:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6400:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5192:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:855:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1258:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:11581:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1285:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:17:先跑 **LATS frozen-token probe**，别上来改训练主干。它是唯一同时满足三点的机制：不伤 no-LM backbone、有空间信息、不是 final-feature 重投影。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4227:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:727:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1120:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7059:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8404:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1256:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1743:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:21:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1285:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:17:先跑 **LATS frozen-token probe**，别上来改训练主干。它是唯一同时满足三点的机制：不伤 no-LM backbone、有空间信息、不是 final-feature 重投影。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8425:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4227:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:61:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8427:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8429:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8431:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8434:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8453:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8464:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14408:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14625:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:873:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14626:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:878:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1282:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13652:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14627:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14650:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1285:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:17:先跑 **LATS frozen-token probe**，别上来改训练主干。它是唯一同时满足三点的机制：不伤 no-LM backbone、有空间信息、不是 final-feature 重投影。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5317:1. **LM-S1 多 seed 复核训练端命门**：只跑 `h=16 ordinary M3` vs `lattice no-LM M3`，3 seeds。若均值差 `< +0.8` 或 CI 跨 0，训练端 lattice story 关门。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8134:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:10:- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8136:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:22:1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15009:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1285:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:17:先跑 **LATS frozen-token probe**，别上来改训练主干。它是唯一同时满足三点的机制：不伤 no-LM backbone、有空间信息、不是 final-feature 重投影。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8434:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15020:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8453:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15196:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10821:   841	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16604:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:20:1. **frozen-feature 重投影/重加权**（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075）— no-LM-loss 特征对边缘化已最优、无 headroom。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16612:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17114:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:18:- M=3 no-LM-loss(每iter 3个lattice variants[sub-pixel phase/bbox/kernel]增强, 但关掉 L_marg+L_cons): single **77.44**, lattice 79.90, SANITY HR 88.92
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17115:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:19:- M=3 full LM-ReID(M=3 + L_marg[marginal-likelihood -log mean_l softmax] + L_cons[consistency 拉variants特征到均值]): single **75.71**, lattice 78.04, SANITY HR 86.09
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:21:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17125:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17126:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17129:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6595:`M=3 no-LM-loss +3.82` 现在**还不能宣称 lattice-specific**。它可能只是：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17144:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:24:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17148:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2703:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19877:这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19887:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:86:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19900:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kil�有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20455:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20458:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3955:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20476:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20483:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20485:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20496:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20535:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20644:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20645:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:13:- **kill-switch**：冻 no-LM-loss ckpt + 训 qφ 1-3 epoch；weighted 比 uniform 多 ≥+0.4 mAP(h12/16) + 格点预测 acc ≥35% + LATTICE−TTA 不降 → 活，否则杀。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20648:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20649:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:37:1. **embedding invariance hurts**: full LM 75.71 < no-LM 77.44，HR sanity 86.09 < 88.92，L_marg 主害。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20656:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6515:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20659:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8048:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3233:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20660:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8050:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20661:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20662:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
