experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20664:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8069:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3295:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20665:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20666:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20667:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8084:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20668:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10193:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20692:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20696:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20697:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20718:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20721:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20723:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20727:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20862:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10134:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20865:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10193:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20867:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10196:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20882:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10596:2. ordinary-aug 模型也吃 lattice marginalization；
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20883:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10597:3. lattice-aug 训练只比 ordinary-aug 多 `+0.54`；
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20884:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10616:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20885:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10647:- **Critical**: `loss_mode == 'lsrc'` 只是在 `L_id` 里追加 LSRC，最终总 loss 仍默认包含 `lam_marg=1.0` 和 `lam_cons=0.2`。也就是说不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 时，实验仍混入已证伪的 `L_marg/L_cons`。这会直接污染 LSRC 结论。见 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:473)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10665:简短结论：**先不要 approve 正式训练。** 至少先强制 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，并补一个非对称 `query-lattice-set × gallery-HR-single` 版本；否则 LSRC 很可能被旧 harmful loss 和 M×M train/test mismatch 一起带偏。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20887:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10672:- **Critical**: `loss_mode == 'lsrc'` 只是在 `L_id` 里追加 LSRC，最终总 loss 仍默认包含 `lam_marg=1.0` 和 `lam_cons=0.2`。也就是说不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 时，实验仍混入已证伪的 `L_marg/L_cons`。这会直接污染 LSRC 结论。见 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:473)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3233:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6409:- **method-vs-trick 终判仍靠 ablation（no-LM-loss）**：若 LM-ReID single > ablation single 则 consistency 训练有独立价值。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20890:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20892:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20897:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3297:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20898:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3299:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:95:- **★不对称（干净）**：test-time lattice-marg 四配置全 beat TTA（M=1 +3.727 / ordinary-aug +1.624 / lattice no-LM +2.576 / full +3.006）→ **lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable，在 training 不特殊**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20899:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3300:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20900:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3304:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3309:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20906:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20908:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20909:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20910:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20911:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20912:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3445:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:9:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20913:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3448:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:34:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20914:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3480:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:24:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20918:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4474:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6397:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20927:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:5045:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20970:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20971:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20981:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20990:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20991:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20992:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20993:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20994:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:20997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21001:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21004:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21006:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21049:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21053:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21054:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21055:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21056:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8352:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:832:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1234:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3319:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21064:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21066:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21073:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8427:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21074:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8429:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21075:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8431:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1465:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4233:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112:- **cons-only eval 结果（L_cons 诊断，2026-06-26）**：single **76.895**（h=16）vs no-LM-loss 77.44 / full 75.71 → **L_cons 单独只 −0.55，L_marg 才是大元凶（≈−1.18）**（codex 预测"L_cons 主杀"错）。**强化 asymmetry：训练时边缘化 L_marg 有害 / 测试时边缘化有益**——decision-level marginalization 故事更锐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21079:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21121:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21126:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10821:   841	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21133:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21187:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14408:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21211:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21221:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21228:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14624:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21229:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14625:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:873:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14627:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21237:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21238:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14690:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2251:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5218:- **M=3 ordinary-aug(每iter 3 个普通 random crop/flip/resize/color variants)**: **76.90**, +test-time lattice-marg 79.28, LATTICE-MINUS-TTA +1.624
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21239:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5223:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21240:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2256:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5224:★不对称: **test-time lattice marginalization 四配置全 beat 普通TTA(+1.6~3.7), 含 ordinary-aug 模型 +1.624** → lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable, 在 training 不特殊。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21242:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5283:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21244:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5286:它没有被完全削死，因为它不是 consistency，不强迫不同 lattice embedding 贴合；它优化最坏 lattice，逻辑上仍可能降低 single-image 风险。但训练端 lattice 不特殊、consistency 有害，说明赔率低。必须同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`，否则又会混入“更多/更难增广”的解释。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21247:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:2286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5321:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21270:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8134:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:10:- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21271:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8136:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:22:1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21281:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21291:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21294:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8385:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:873:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21296:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15001:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:879:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21297:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15002:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8392:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:880:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1284:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9954:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21299:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8434:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15204:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21335:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15205:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10853:   873	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13245:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3078:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21364:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21465:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17148:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21977:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1764:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

   130	def make_lattice_variants(hr_img, h, K, rng, rand_mode=False):
   131	    """K plausible PHASE/CROP/KERNEL variants of the SAME hr image at height h.
   132	    variant 0 = canonical deterministic bicubic LR (single-LR baseline)."""
   133	    W_hr, H_hr = hr_img.size
   134	    hr_per_lr_y = H_hr / float(h)
   135	    hr_per_lr_x = W_hr / float(max(1, round(h / 3.0)))
   136	    variants = [make_lr(hr_img, h, 'bicubic')]
   137	    axes = [0]                          # 0=canonical; non-canonical: 1=phase, 2=bbox, 3=zoom
   138	    kernels_cycle = ['bicubic', 'bilinear', 'lanczos', 'box', 'hamming']
   139	    for j in range(1, K):
   140	        # rand_mode (TRAINING): random axis+kernel per variant so even small M covers ALL
   141	        # lattice axes across epochs; eval (kill-switch) keeps deterministic round-robin j%3.
   142	        mode = int(rng.randint(0, 3)) if rand_mode else (j % 3)
   143	        kern = (kernels_cycle[int(rng.randint(0, len(kernels_cycle)))] if rand_mode
   144	                else kernels_cycle[j % len(kernels_cycle)])
   145	        if mode == 0:
   146	            dx = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_x
   147	            dy = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_y
   148	            shifted = hr_img.transform((W_hr, H_hr), Image.AFFINE, (1, 0, dx, 0, 1, dy),
   149	                                       resample=Image.BICUBIC)
   150	            v = make_lr(shifted, h, kern)
   151	        elif mode == 1:
   152	            sx = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_x))
   153	            sy = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_y))
   154	            left = max(0, sx); upper = max(0, sy)
   155	            right = W_hr + min(0, sx); lower = H_hr + min(0, sy)
   156	            if right - left < 4 or lower - upper < 4:
   157	                left, upper, right, lower = 0, 0, W_hr, H_hr
   158	            cropped = hr_img.crop((left, upper, right, lower)).resize((W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   159	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   160	        else:
   161	            ez = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * 0.5 * hr_per_lr_y
   162	            box = (-ez, -ez * (W_hr / H_hr), W_hr + ez, H_hr + ez * (W_hr / H_hr)) if ez > 0 \
   163	                else (abs(ez), abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr), W_hr - abs(ez), H_hr - abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr))
   164	            l, u, r, b = (int(round(v_)) for v_ in box)
   165	            pad = max(0, -l, -u, r - W_hr, b - H_hr) + 1
   166	            canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W_hr + 2 * pad, H_hr + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   167	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))
   168	            cropped = canvas.crop((l + pad, u + pad, r + pad, b + pad)).resize((W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   169	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   170	        variants.append(v)
   171	        axes.append(mode + 1)           # 1=phase, 2=bbox, 3=zoom
   172	    return variants, axes

   286	    m, n = x.size(0), y.size(0)

   293	def batch_hard_triplet(feat, labels, margin):
   294	    """standard batch-hard triplet (hardest pos / hardest neg) on euclidean feat."""
