experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:106:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:109:| (f) feature whitening / GW / IN 类 ReID | **中等撞车** | AMS 已用 IN + Group Whitening 做 DG ReID；SNR 明确说 IN 会丢 identity-relevant 信息再 restitution；CC-ReID 也有 feature decorrelation。OSAC 要避开“又一个 whitening ReID”叙事，强调 classifier-prototype over-collapse 与谱尾 unseen 证据。证据：[AMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10409)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[CC-ReID decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05536)、[RaMoE decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09156) | 9/10 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:9:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:12:- We define gallery negative in-degree `H_k(g)` and query hub mass `M(q)` and show `M(q)` is the dominant explanatory variable for residual AP error (ρ+0.60 on Occluded-Duke), beyond cheap difficulty proxies.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:26:**4.1 Hub mass explains residual AP error (Table 1).**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3293:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3537:experiments/MORNING_REPORT.md:97:**decorr loss 全程活跃却完全没动 Jaccard/fusion。** 原因（这就是洞察）：强迫全局**线性**解相关，对"模型给 query 排哪些 gallery"（part-MaxSim 排序）是**正交**的——检索由 part-MaxSim over 相同可见身体部位证据决定，两模型受**同一份可见证据**约束、犯**同样的错**（Swin 对 370/989=37% 重遮挡 query 对、DINO 只补 8 个=0.81%）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:3338:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3995:experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:49:**decorr loss 全程活跃(稳 0.041)却完全没移动 Jaccard/oracle/fusion。** 机制：强迫 global 线性解相关对"排哪些 gallery"(part-MaxSim 排序)是**正交**的——检索由 part-MaxSim over 相同可见身体部位证据决定，两模型受**同一份可见证据**约束犯**同样的错**(Swin-only-r1-hit 370/989=37%，DINO 补 8=0.81%)。global 线性相关只是排序"装饰"。→ **显式施压也打不破张力 = 张力鲁棒、fundamental**。这是张力洞察最强的对照证据(诊断论文核心实验)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6337:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6338:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6420:- **adaptive-K（per-query）≈ fixed K=5（uniform）at 56% compute**（h16 adaptive 79.66 ≈ K-sweep K=5 79.61）→ per-query volatility selection 没明显优势 over uniform K。和 LPA 死因一致（query-side 预测 lattice 受益度做不到）。compute 故事用 K-sweep（fixed K=5 87%）就够。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6425:从本地复盘看，LM-ReID 的状态和你概括一致：训练端已被反例封住，剩下的是 test-time decision marginalization；强 TTA、K-sweep、聚合、bbox 因子、Swin 泛化、σ-sweep 都比较完整，冲 7.0 的 detector 泛化腿失败。现在联网查“有没有真正没碰过的新问题定义”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_23.md:604:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3671:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13295:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3672:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13297:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3674:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13376:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5494:L = L_single + λ1 L_set_supcon + λ2 L_neg_tail + λ3 L_pos_coverage + λ4 L_residual_div
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5516:`L_residual_div`：只对 residual 做轻量去冗余：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5522:约束 residual 有最小能量、低相关，但权重要小。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5527:- 不同于 consistency：不要求 `h_i,1...h_i,K` 相同，反而允许 residual 存在。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5530:- 不同于 frozen LS-MRT / LPA：梯度回到 last block/backbone，改变 aliasing / bbox-shift 敏感特征本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5546:把 feature 分成 common identity part 和 lattice residual：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5556:L_res_id: same-ID same-lattice residual contrast
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5557:L_lat_pred: residual 预测 phase / bbox / kernel index
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5561:这个目标的直觉是：LR aliasing 里的相位、bbox 边缘、kernel 信息不是噪声，可能含有 ID 相关纹理残片。训练 residual 可复现，而不是被 invariance loss 抹掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5563:风险：如果 residual ID 信号太弱，会变成 lattice 分类玩具。kill-switch 要严。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6847:| 2 | **TPA: Teacher-Preserved Zero-Init Adapter** | 在最后 1 个 Swin block 插零初始化 adapter/LoRA，只训 adapter；loss 用普通 CE/triplet + pairwise/rank distill 保住 no-LM 排序 | 不是 full fine-tune；不让 set-loss 重塑判别边界；adapter residual 被 norm/rank distill 约束 | ep10 K9 不涨 >0.4 或 HR 88.92 掉到 <88.5，杀；adapter norm 爆或 train acc 很快 1.0 但 val 掉，杀 | **5.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6849:| 4 | **Structured residual diversity** | 只对 sidecar residual `r_k` 做低权重 decorrelation，不对完整 `z_k` 做正交；且只在 CE/triplet 正确样本上启用 | 避免把身份主特征推开；diversity 是“准确后的分工”，不是噪声制造 | individual variant mAP 掉 >0.8 或 residual energy 变大但 K9 不涨，杀 | **4.5/10** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_26.md:610:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3082:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3085:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:39:## （旧）5 候选 frozen-feature pipeline（LS-MRT 已死，其余大概率同死）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3086:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:41:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3087:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:45:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3088:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:46:| LCRS（互补 residual） | 7/10 | `z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + α·P_k(g_k))`，shared identity core + lattice-specific residual subspace + decorr(只在分类正确后)。"准确后分工"非硬推开。test K=9 边缘化拿更富 union | 冻 backbone 训 P_shared/P_k/cls；活=K-error correlation 降+K=9 gain ≥+0.5，individual variant mAP 不掉>0.8 | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3089:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:47:| LRFD（disentangle） | 7/10 | `z_l=P_id, r_l=P_lat`(lattice nuisance sink, 必须能预测 lattice), per-variant CE+triplet, 推理丢 r_l 用 z_l 边缘化 | 冻 backbone 训 heads；活=with-lattice-code >+0.2 over without + r_l lattice-pred acc>60% | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3090:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:48:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3091:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:49:| DeepSets Marginalizer（LPA 修正） | 6.5/10 | 不预测 query 最佳变体(LPA 死因)，改 pairwise: 每个(q,g)的 K 个 cos 经 DeepSets φ/ρ 合成校准分, α 初 0 限幅, embedding 冻 | cached features 小 scorer；活=+0.4 over uniform, 且 ordinary-TTA scorer 追不平(否则只是 generic learned TTA) | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3092:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:51:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3093:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:53:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3097:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:8:- **frozen-feature 类训练端机制全部证负**：LS-MRT（set-retrieval 重投影 linear P）+0.028、LPA（query-side 加权）+0.075，两个冻结特征 probe 都 ≈0。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3109:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:42:- 非 **Hard-Lattice ERM**（76.894 死）：把 K 变体当检索证据集，非独立硬样本逐个 ERM。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3154:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3160:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:114:- LM-S2-strong（强 TTA 防御）还在跑；**LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM**（3090，bqd5skbum，loss_mode=hard 已实现+smoke 过）epoch 0，待 Hard-ordinary 对照（需 Hard-Lat ≥+0.8 over Hard-ord 才算训练端活）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3162:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:117:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3168:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:130:- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3169:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3172:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:8:## 机制 A：学怎么加权边缘化（LPA / LUD）— codex 最高 7.5/10
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3173:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:9:- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3176:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:14:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3180:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:25:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3182:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:31:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4878:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:10:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:11:| 2 | **TPA: Teacher-Preserved Zero-Init Adapter** | 在最后 1 个 Swin block 插零初始化 adapter/LoRA，只训 adapter；loss 用普通 CE/triplet + pairwise/rank distill 保住 no-LM 排序 | 不是 full fine-tune；不让 set-loss 重塑判别边界；adapter residual 被 norm/rank distill 约束 | ep10 K9 不涨 >0.4 或 HR 88.92 掉到 <88.5，杀；adapter norm 爆或 train acc 很快 1.0 但 val 掉，杀 | **5.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:13:| 4 | **Structured residual diversity** | 只对 sidecar residual `r_k` 做低权重 decorrelation，不对完整 `z_k` 做正交；且只在 CE/triplet 正确样本上启用 | 避免把身份主特征推开；diversity 是“准确后的分工”，不是噪声制造 | individual variant mAP 掉 >0.8 或 residual energy 变大但 K9 不涨，杀 | **4.5/10** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5205:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2796:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:763:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5206:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2797:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5060:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:765:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6251:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2814:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6410:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6847:| 2 | **TPA: Teacher-Preserved Zero-Init Adapter** | 在最后 1 个 Swin block 插零初始化 adapter/LoRA，只训 adapter；loss 用普通 CE/triplet + pairwise/rank distill 保住 no-LM 排序 | 不是 full fine-tune；不让 set-loss 重塑判别边界；adapter residual 被 norm/rank distill 约束 | ep10 K9 不涨 >0.4 或 HR 88.92 掉到 <88.5，杀；adapter norm 爆或 train acc 很快 1.0 但 val 掉，杀 | **5.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6849:| 4 | **Structured residual diversity** | 只对 sidecar residual `r_k` 做低权重 decorrelation，不对完整 `z_k` 做正交；且只在 CE/triplet 正确样本上启用 | 避免把身份主特征推开；diversity 是“准确后的分工”，不是噪声制造 | individual variant mAP 掉 >0.8 或 residual energy 变大但 K9 不涨，杀 | **4.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6413:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6853:先跑 **LATS frozen-token probe**，别上来改训练主干。它是唯一同时满足三点的机制：不伤 no-LM backbone、有空间信息、不是 final-feature 重投影。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20666:experiments/exp004/monitor.md:52:**观察**: Loss 模式与 exp001 几乎相同。id_global 和 id_part 初始值一致（6.554/6.554），符合预期——PFM 零初始化使初始状态等价于 exp001。tri_global/tri_part 略高于 exp001，这是正常的初始波动。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20788:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20789:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:95:机制草案：用现有 Swin/SOLIDER 思路做“语义残差化”的 Vehicle ReID。先把 type/color/model 语义成分从 embedding 中估出来，再训练一个 residual-detail 分支，只在同车型/同色 hard negatives 上强化贴纸、轮毂、划痕、局部装饰、车窗边缘等实例证据；同时分 same-view / cross-view，因为 cross-view 下很多细节不可见，应该输出不确定性或候选集，而不是强行单点排序。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:128:机制草案：用现有 Swin/SOLIDER 思路做“语义残差化”的 Vehicle ReID。先把 type/color/model 语义成分从 embedding 中估出来，再训练一个 residual-detail 分支，只在同车型/同色 hard negatives 上强化贴纸、轮毂、划痕、局部装饰、车窗边缘等实例证据；同时分 same-view / cross-view，因为 cross-view 下很多细节不可见，应该输出不确定性或候选集，而不是强行单点排序。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:17:① **method 是什么**? 候选: multi-query/tracklet 证据融合(evidence-aware, 用 lowtail-pos 决定何时/如何融) / retrieval reliability calibration(预测 fragile-query 给可靠性分, 不做恢复) / evidence-conditioned retrieval / 别的。关键约束: 利用'证据 union 有真 headroom'但—— (a)T3 是 oracle(需第 2 张同 ID 图), 真实部署'从哪来第 2 份证据'? multi-query/tracklet 设定可拿(注意: 这**不是** exp109 的 gallery-side completion identity-conditioned 墙, 是 query-side 多帧), 但 multi-query/set-based ReID 是已知设定, novelty 必须在'evidence-aware'机制不在'用多帧'本身; (b)不撞 occlusion/completion 死区; (c)T2 显示'静态失败预测'被 #false 吃掉, 别把 method 建在静态失败预测上, 要建在 tax-residual/fragility 或 evidence-gain 上。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2796:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:763:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2797:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5060:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:765:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3904:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:16:## （旧）5 候选 frozen-feature pipeline（LS-MRT 已死，其余大概率同死）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3905:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:18:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3906:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3907:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:23:| LCRS（互补 residual） | 7/10 | `z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + α·P_k(g_k))`，shared identity core + lattice-specific residual subspace + decorr(只在分类正确后)。"准确后分工"非硬推开。test K=9 边缘化拿更富 union | 冻 backbone 训 P_shared/P_k/cls；活=K-error correlation 降+K=9 gain ≥+0.5，individual variant mAP 不掉>0.8 | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3908:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:24:| LRFD（disentangle） | 7/10 | `z_l=P_id, r_l=P_lat`(lattice nuisance sink, 必须能预测 lattice), per-variant CE+triplet, 推理丢 r_l 用 z_l 边缘化 | 冻 backbone 训 heads；活=with-lattice-code >+0.2 over without + r_l lattice-pred acc>60% | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3909:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:25:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3910:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:| DeepSets Marginalizer（LPA 修正） | 6.5/10 | 不预测 query 最佳变体(LPA 死因)，改 pairwise: 每个(q,g)的 K 个 cos 经 DeepSets φ/ρ 合成校准分, α 初 0 限幅, embedding 冻 | cached features 小 scorer；活=+0.4 over uniform, 且 ordinary-TTA scorer 追不平(否则只是 generic learned TTA) | 排队 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3911:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3912:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:4196:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5201:reassess/r_3.md:3596:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:437:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:14:ReID 方法稿探索。背景: 主线 LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点 test-time decision marginalization)已做到 6.5/10 成稿(中等偏强 B 类, 冲 7.0 失败因 detector 误差下 marginalization 衰减)。现评估唯一未验备胎 **d17 rank-leverage**: 观察=ReID 检索 top-k 排名被少数局部区域(stripe/patch)劫持, false positive 由局部区域支配(对抗鲁棒性视角)。诊断=对 query-gallery top-k 做局部遮挡/stripe/patch counterfactual, 算 rank-leverage concentration。**关键教训(本 session 多次踩坑): 任何 per-query 解释变量必须控制 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk(top-k 里错几个), 否则退化成错误计数(Hubness/evidence 都这样死过)。** 问: (a)d17 能否成 > 6.5 的 B 类方法稿(机制层新意+可干预 remedy 非纯诊断)? (b)cheap kill-switch 设计(带 #false-in-topk 控制+对抗 baseline 对照, 团队 market/occluded_duke 数据零训练首验)? (c)和 LM-ReID 6.5 比哪个更值得投? 还是 6.5 收尾投更务实? 诚实评估别硬凑, 信心 1-10。务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3621:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:3110:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/remedy_rethink.md:91:唯一可救方向是换成 **positive-support / evidence-sufficiency**，不是 distractor remedy：例如看同一 query 在 gallery growth 下有多少“可见证据兼容的正样本支撑质量”，用 lower-tail positive similarity、positive dispersion、visible-part overlap、query-pair uncertainty 去解释 tax residual。它的独立信号应是：两个 query 1x top1 margin 相近，但 positive support mass 不同，growth tax 显著不同。这个方向不应 hallucinate 被遮挡区域，只做“可见证据是否足够”的校准或局部匹配。若零训练 residual 也没有，立即杀。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3697:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4588:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:4648:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:51:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3699:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4629:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4120:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4121:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:12:- We define gallery negative in-degree `H_k(g)` and query hub mass `M(q)` and show `M(q)` is the dominant explanatory variable for residual AP error (ρ+0.60 on Occluded-Duke), beyond cheap difficulty proxies.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4122:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4236:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:131:- **强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**。论文 = test-time 6/10 核心 + 训练端系统反例。备选 BLC（input canonicalize，design_blc.md）market 受限未验。启 codex（train3_{fourthclass,paperstrategy}）。审查纪律见 codex_review_lsrc.md（审出 Critical+High 已修）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4255:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:**强结论**：no-LM-loss backbone 已是 LR-ReID 好特征，**test-time decision marginalization 是唯一有效杠杆**；训练端干预要么无用（frozen）要么有害（改 backbone）。备选 BLC（input canonicalize bbox crop, design 已写）market 只裁好框受限 6.5、未验。启 2 codex（train3_{fourthclass 找第四类机制, paperstrategy 评估反例论文策略}）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5398:ReID 方法稿探索。背景: 主线 LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点 test-time decision marginalization)已做到 6.5/10 成稿(中等偏强 B 类, 冲 7.0 失败因 detector 误差下 marginalization 衰减)。现评估唯一未验备胎 **d17 rank-leverage**: 观察=ReID 检索 top-k 排名被少数局部区域(stripe/patch)劫持, false positive 由局部区域支配(对抗鲁棒性视角)。诊断=对 query-gallery top-k 做局部遮挡/stripe/patch counterfactual, 算 rank-leverage concentration。**关键教训(本 session 多次踩坑): 任何 per-query 解释变量必须控制 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk(top-k 里错几个), 否则退化成错误计数(Hubness/evidence 都这样死过)。** 问: (a)d17 能否成 > 6.5 的 B 类方法稿(机制层新意+可干预 remedy 非纯诊断)? (b)cheap kill-switch 设计(带 #false-in-topk 控制+对抗 baseline 对照, 团队 market/occluded_duke 数据零训练首验)? (c)和 LM-ReID 6.5 比哪个更值得投? 还是 6.5 收尾投更务实? 诚实评估别硬凑, 信心 1-10。务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6069:`L_stable` 也不建议直接上。它可以做成非循环的训练 surrogate，但在 OD 上很可能退化成“把当前正样本推高、当前 top negative 推低”，本质接近 Smooth-AP / listwise metric loss 这类已有 ranking surrogate([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.12163?utm_source=openai))。除非你先证明 `L_stable` 对 tax 的解释在控制 1x margin 后还有显著 residual，否则别开训。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6071:唯一可救方向是换成 **positive-support / evidence-sufficiency**，不是 distractor remedy：例如看同一 query 在 gallery growth 下有多少“可见证据兼容的正样本支撑质量”，用 lower-tail positive similarity、positive dispersion、visible-part overlap、query-pair uncertainty 去解释 tax residual。它的独立信号应是：两个 query 1x top1 margin 相近，但 positive support mass 不同，growth tax 显著不同。这个方向不应 hallucinate 被遮挡区域，只做“可见证据是否足够”的校准或局部匹配。若零训练 residual 也没有，立即杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6087:最终动作：保留 Tax 为诊断贡献，停止 Tax-Aware Distractor Training 主线；只允许做一个零训练 positive-support residual 预检。预检不过，直接 d14。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6095:`L_stable` 也不建议直接上。它可以做成非循环的训练 surrogate，但在 OD 上很可能退化成“把当前正样本推高、当前 top negative 推低”，本质接近 Smooth-AP / listwise metric loss 这类已有 ranking surrogate([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.12163?utm_source=openai))。除非你先证明 `L_stable` 对 tax 的解释在控制 1x margin 后还有显著 residual，否则别开训。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6097:唯一可救方向是换成 **positive-support / evidence-sufficiency**，不是 distractor remedy：例如看同一 query 在 gallery growth 下有多少“可见证据兼容的正样本支撑质量”，用 lower-tail positive similarity、positive dispersion、visible-part overlap、query-pair uncertainty 去解释 tax residual。它的独立信号应是：两个 query 1x top1 margin 相近，但 positive support mass 不同，growth tax 显著不同。这个方向不应 hallucinate 被遮挡区域，只做“可见证据是否足够”的校准或局部匹配。若零训练 residual 也没有，立即杀。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6156:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6159:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6162:- We define gallery negative in-degree `H_k(g)` and query hub mass `M(q)` and show `M(q)` is the dominant explanatory variable for residual AP error (ρ+0.60 on Occluded-Duke), beyond cheap difficulty proxies.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6168:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6176:**4.1 Hub mass explains residual AP error (Table 1).**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6398:① **method 是什么**? 候选: multi-query/tracklet 证据融合(evidence-aware, 用 lowtail-pos 决定何时/如何融) / retrieval reliability calibration(预测 fragile-query 给可靠性分, 不做恢复) / evidence-conditioned retrieval / 别的。关键约束: 利用'证据 union 有真 headroom'但—— (a)T3 是 oracle(需第 2 张同 ID 图), 真实部署'从哪来第 2 份证据'? multi-query/tracklet 设定可拿(注意: 这**不是** exp109 的 gallery-side completion identity-conditioned 墙, 是 query-side 多帧), 但 multi-query/set-based ReID 是已知设定, novelty 必须在'evidence-aware'机制不在'用多帧'本身; (b)不撞 occlusion/completion 死区; (c)T2 显示'静态失败预测'被 #false 吃掉, 别把 method 建在静态失败预测上, 要建在 tax-residual/fragility 或 evidence-gain 上。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6563:- **★★ setpool 消融最终结论(2026-06-23): 可学习池化全失败, mean-pool 最优。** standalone: netvlad 14.66(ep20)/ attn 37.66(final)。residual(mean+零初始化残差, 从 52.37 字节级起步): attn ep30 21.30→ep50 33.49(final~37, ≈standalone); clean netvlad ep10 16.00。**诊断: 即使无损起步, gate 一开残差就拖垮 eval(训练 loss 降但 mAP 降=残差过拟合训练对/梯度经 layer4 扰动 global)。优化器为降训练 loss 开 gate, 但 eval 掉。** → **OVC-SetVLAD(codex 角度2 涨数字赌注)证伪: 4 种 fancy 池化 × standalone/residual 两版全 < mean-pool 52.37。简单 mean(centroid)是最优跨视角 token 聚合。** 这是干净有教育意义的 ablation(试了 fancy 反而验证 simple 最优)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12947:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:6096:reassess/r_3.md:11272:pivot/p_2.md:6850:reviews/deep_25.md:470:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19781:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:11:- vs VICReg/whitening/decorrelation/AMS group-whitening: 是通用泛化零件, **主贡献不能写"decorrelation loss"**, 必须写"open-set ReID 过坍缩诊断 + 训练期 spectral anti-collapse 保 unseen 证据"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19810:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:16:用联网**尽力查确切先例+撞车**, 逐类判它们是否已把'seen-ID 过坍缩定义成 open-set ReID 失败变量 + 训练期抗坍缩保 unseen 迁移': (a)Neural Collapse(Papyan 2020)用到 ReID / open-set / metric learning 没; (b)dimensional collapse / rank collapse in SSL/contrastive(Jing et al, Hua et al); (c)VICReg/Barlow Twins/whitening/decorrelation 泛化零件; (d)ProNet / prototype-projection / classifier-reuse ReID; (e)generalizable/open-set/DG ReID 里有没有'过坍缩伤 unseen 迁移'诊断; (f)feature whitening / group whitening ReID(AMS / SNR / IN 类); (g)spectral/rank regularization metric learning; (h)open-set recognition 里的 feature collapse。撞了说撞哪+杀伤; 没撞说切口。务实中文, verdict(撞车/存活)+证据链接+信心1-10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19816:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:106:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19819:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:109:| (f) feature whitening / GW / IN 类 ReID | **中等撞车** | AMS 已用 IN + Group Whitening 做 DG ReID；SNR 明确说 IN 会丢 identity-relevant 信息再 restitution；CC-ReID 也有 feature decorrelation。OSAC 要避开“又一个 whitening ReID”叙事，强调 classifier-prototype over-collapse 与谱尾 unseen 证据。证据：[AMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10409)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[CC-ReID decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05536)、[RaMoE decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09156) | 9/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19827:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:128:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13295:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13297:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13376:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3300:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3306:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:114:- LM-S2-strong（强 TTA 防御）还在跑；**LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM**（3090，bqd5skbum，loss_mode=hard 已实现+smoke 过）epoch 0，待 Hard-ordinary 对照（需 Hard-Lat ≥+0.8 over Hard-ord 才算训练端活）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3310:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:132:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:57:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3330:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3448:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:34:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
