experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4514:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4591:## 机制 A：学怎么加权边缘化（LPA / LUD）— codex 最高 7.5/10
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4592:- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4597:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4608:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4614:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4646:2. **frozen adaptation no headroom**: LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4647:3. **backbone set/robust training damages base**: LSRC HR 88.92→85.84 / lattice 79.90→77.98，Hard-Lattice 76.9 < 77.44，train acc 1.0 但 test 掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4661:- Uncertainty（PFE/DUL/UMTS）: 若用 A LPA，卖点是 supervised sampling-lattice posterior 非 generic data-quality。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:116:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:117:- 不同于 frozen LS-MRT / LPA：梯度回到 last block/backbone，改变 aliasing / bbox-shift 敏感特征本身。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1439:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13295:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13297:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1478:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13295:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1479:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13297:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2698:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:75:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2786:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train_lens3_import.txt:77:我会先做 **LPA**。它最符合“边缘化隐变量”设定，也最避开 invariance-collapse：训练学的是 **怎么加权 marginalization**，不是把 K 个 lattice 特征压成一个点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2787:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:763:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2788:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:765:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2828:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:58:1. **Hard-Lattice ERM / CVaR**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2838:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5132:★命门: **lattice-aug(77.44) vs ordinary-aug(76.90) = 只 +0.54**(我先前定阈值 -1.0+ 才算 lattice-specific)→ M3 训练端增益主要是"更多增广", lattice 训练端不特殊。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5137:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5184:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5194:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_diversity.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10138:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10185:你预设的门槛是 `>= +1.0` 才算 lattice-specific，现在 `77.44 - 76.90 = +0.54`，而且是 single seed；高分辨率 `h=24/32` 基本归零；consistency 还明确有害 `-1.73`。这组证据更像：`M=3` 多视图训练本身有效，lattice 作为训练增广只多给一点点 severe-LR 边缘收益。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10647:- **Critical**: `loss_mode == 'lsrc'` 只是在 `L_id` 里追加 LSRC，最终总 loss 仍默认包含 `lam_marg=1.0` 和 `lam_cons=0.2`。也就是说不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 时，实验仍混入已证伪的 `L_marg/L_cons`。这会直接污染 LSRC 结论。见 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:473)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10665:简短结论：**先不要 approve 正式训练。** 至少先强制 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，并补一个非对称 `query-lattice-set × gallery-HR-single` 版本；否则 LSRC 很可能被旧 harmful loss 和 M×M train/test mismatch 一起带偏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6420:- **adaptive-K（per-query）≈ fixed K=5（uniform）at 56% compute**（h16 adaptive 79.66 ≈ K-sweep K=5 79.61）→ per-query volatility selection 没明显优势 over uniform K。和 LPA 死因一致（query-side 预测 lattice 受益度做不到）。compute 故事用 K-sweep（fixed K=5 87%）就够。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8084:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12738:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:10:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train_more_import.txt:6:2. **Gallery-conditioned DeepSets Marginalizer**：信心 **6.5/10**，作为 LPA 失败后的补位，不再做 query-side 预测。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2796:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:763:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2797:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5060:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:765:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:3906:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4174:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4185:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4191:- 当前 GPU 被 Hard-Lattice(3090)/Hard-ordinary(4090) 占 → 先实现两个 kill-switch 代码，GPU 一空即 cheap probe（不直接堆训练）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4203:- **frozen-feature 类训练端机制全部证负**：LS-MRT（set-retrieval 重投影 linear P）+0.028、LPA（query-side 加权）+0.075，两个冻结特征 probe 都 ≈0。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4219:- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4229:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4237:- 非 **Hard-Lattice ERM**（76.894 死）：把 K 变体当检索证据集，非独立硬样本逐个 ERM。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:4272:- baseline：no-LM-loss（lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10821:   841	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14408:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14412:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:28:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14414:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14416:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14613:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:833:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14621:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:857:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1261:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14622:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14674:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14990:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8361:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:841:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15025:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8459:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15189:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27093:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15204:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27100:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21343:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15347:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13814:    10	- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27101:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21344:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15348:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13826:    22	1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27103:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21348:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15370:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13937:    17	**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27106:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21353:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27112:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21362:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16356:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:10:- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27113:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21363:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16357:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:22:1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27114:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21364:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16370:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27116:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21370:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16452:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:24:- **关键超参**：lam_lsrc 0.5(4090)/1.0(3090) hedge，lsrc_tau 0.1，lsrc_margin 0.4，lr 1e-3，40 epoch，`--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`（隔离 LSRC）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27118:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:34:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27124:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21391:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16604:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27125:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21392:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:20:1. **frozen-feature 重投影/重加权**（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075）— no-LM-loss 特征对边缘化已最优、无 headroom。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27127:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21396:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16612:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27128:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21397:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:44:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27140:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21412:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16640:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:96:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27180:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21485:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19877:这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27560:关键训练脚本里我已经确认到两个重要点：LSRC 会强制清零旧的 `L_marg/L_cons`，但 Hard-Lattice 不会；这会直接影响 Hard-Lattice 那个负结果的可信等级。接下来我再对照结果文档和排队/未跑机制记录。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27684:   130	- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27686:   132	- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27708:    10	- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27720:    22	1. **Critical** — 已核：正在跑的对称双跑**本就传了** `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，log `L=id`（marg/cons 只诊断打印不进总 loss）证实**当前实验干净，不 kill**。另**已修代码默认值坑**：`loss_mode==lsrc` 自动 force lam_marg/cons=0（防以后忘传）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27747:    17	**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27761:    31	- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27764:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:59:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28773:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28890:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2615:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2626:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_2.txt:69:3. **机制怎么长出来**：既然不同 Transformer 层看不同内容，就用 MLDC 给 12 层动态加权，并用层间相关惩罚减少冗余。既然全局层融合会丢局部，就用 LPAM 选第 3、6、9、12 层做金字塔式局部融合。既然 gait 和结构细节可能体现在频域，就把 FFT 放进 self-attention 里做频域相关。训练上只用 ID loss、triplet loss 和自适应 loss 权重。机制和“多层多尺度”绑定较紧，和“FFT 捕捉步态结构”的绑定稍弱，需要更多专门证据。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28892:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2627:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_2.txt:71:4. **证据闭环**：Table 7 证明 MLDC、LPAM、两者组合和 FFT 逐级带来增益，而且在多个换衣数据集上都有趋势。层选择实验说明 3、6、9、12 覆盖低中高层最优；自适应 loss 权重优于手调固定权重；t-SNE 和检索可视化显示同身份聚得更紧。VC-Clothes-W&R 上也有 SOTA 结果，但作者自己承认雨风场景下降幅度不一定比别人小，所以“天气鲁棒”不是最强闭环，“RGB-only 多层多尺度换衣识别”才是主闭环。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28895:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2686:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:28:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28907:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29304:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29305:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29309:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29310:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29344:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29345:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8059:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29347:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:26:**fourthclass codex**：第四类候选 LATS（frozen-token sidecar 6.5）/ BLC（input）/ LVAS（data sampler 5）/ residual-diversity（4.5）。**paperstrategy codex**：明确"别再碰 backbone training loss"，论文 test-time + 反例 **5.5→6.5（补跨数据集/强TTA/MLR）→7.5（仅当 BLC 过线）**；核心论点 *"Learning to be invariant is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29348:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29349:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8084:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29406:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12738:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train3_fourthclass.txt:10:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29415:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train_more_import.txt:6:2. **Gallery-conditioned DeepSets Marginalizer**：信心 **6.5/10**，作为 LPA 失败后的补位，不再做 query-side 预测。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29417:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
