experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34542:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14982:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:800:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34543:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14983:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8327:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:801:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34544:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14984:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:802:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34552:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8372:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:860:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34559:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34564:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32907:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9994:    14	用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34572:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15188:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10780:   800	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34573:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15189:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10781:   801	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34576:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27091:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15202:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10840:   860	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34583:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32929:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21341:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15296:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:12702:监控文档里的关键事实是：`-1.73` 来自 full LM-ReID 相对 `M=3 no-LM-loss`，而 `76.9<77.44` 对应的是 ordinary/Hard-Lattice 训练端对照，不是单纯“没涨”。我现在核对训练脚本和 eval 脚本的 lattice 生成、输入归一化、模型加载是否同口径。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34584:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32930:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27100:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21343:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15347:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13814:    10	- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34586:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32932:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27103:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21348:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15370:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13937:    17	**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34587:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32934:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27106:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21353:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34596:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32948:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27143:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21418:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16646:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:117:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34597:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32950:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27158:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21454:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34598:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32951:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27161:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21458:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17138:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2615:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34599:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32954:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27170:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21470:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17157:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2715:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:121:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34600:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32955:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27175:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21477:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2737:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:180:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34601:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32956:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27179:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21484:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17177:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2838:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34602:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32957:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27180:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21485:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:19877:这里发现一个需要认真标注的风险点：`loss_mode='lsrc'` 会强制关掉 `lam_marg/lam_cons`，但 `loss_mode='hard'` 不会自动关。如果当时跑 Hard-Lattice 时命令没显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，那 76.9 就可能混进了已证负的 consistency/marg loss，不能当纯 Hard-Lattice。现在我查文档里有没有保留启动命令或日志证据。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34603:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32958:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27182:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21977:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1764:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34629:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32984:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27250:    58	ap.add_argument('--loss_mode', default='std', choices=['std', 'hard', 'lsrc'], help='hard=Hard-Lattice ERM (dead); lsrc=Lattice-Set Retrieval Contrastive (bag-to-bag set-supcon + neg-tail suppression, shapes backbone for decision marginalization)')

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34631:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32986:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27560:关键训练脚本里我已经确认到两个重要点：LSRC 会强制清零旧的 `L_marg/L_cons`，但 Hard-Lattice 不会；这会直接影响 Hard-Lattice 那个负结果的可信等级。接下来我再对照结果文档和排队/未跑机制记录。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34632:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32988:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27650:    96	- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34633:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32989:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27668:   114	- LM-S2-strong（强 TTA 防御）还在跑；**LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM**（3090，bqd5skbum，loss_mode=hard 已实现+smoke 过）epoch 0，待 Hard-ordinary 对照（需 Hard-Lat ≥+0.8 over Hard-ord 才算训练端活）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34634:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32990:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27671:   117	training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34635:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32991:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27684:   130	- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34636:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32993:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27708:    10	- **Critical**：代码默认 `lam_marg=1.0 / lam_cons=0.2`，`loss_mode==lsrc` 只追加 LSRC，不显式传 `--lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0` 就混入已证伪的 L_marg/L_cons，污染 LSRC 结论。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34638:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32995:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27747:    17	**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34639:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27752:    22	3. **robust ERM**（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）— worst-case 也救不了。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34640:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27764:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34641:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33005:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27785:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34642:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33008:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27795:    65	**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34651:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33029:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28248:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:130:- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34652:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33032:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34653:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33034:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28322:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:22:3. **robust ERM**（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）— worst-case 也救不了。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34654:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33037:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34655:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33042:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:55:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34662:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33088:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28773:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34705:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33263:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28957:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5768:其它 lens 先不主推：TTT/TENT 太容易变 query-only 自我确认；DRO/Hard-Lattice 已接近将死路线；Neural Process 完整版偏重且容易退化成 feature/HR 回归。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34706:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33265:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28963:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5843:- **DRO/Hard-Lattice**：信心 4/10。基本就是更强 Hard-Lattice ERM，与你已判“将死”的方向重合。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.05809))
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34707:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33268:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28966:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5855:其它 lens 先不主推：TTT/TENT 太容易变 query-only 自我确认；DRO/Hard-Lattice 已接近将死路线；Neural Process 完整版偏重且容易退化成 feature/HR 回归。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34708:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33270:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5930:- **DRO/Hard-Lattice**：信心 4/10。基本就是更强 Hard-Lattice ERM，与你已判“将死”的方向重合。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.05809))
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34709:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33274:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29304:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34710:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33275:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29305:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34711:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34712:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33277:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29309:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34713:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33278:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29310:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34714:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33279:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29344:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34723:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33289:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29360:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9959:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34724:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33290:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34732:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33299:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34733:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33301:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29417:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34736:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33304:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34742:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33311:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13670:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34749:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30056:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34750:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30070:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_diversity.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34751:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33335:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30079:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_diversity.md:67:- 不做 Hard-Lattice ERM：没有选一个 hard variant 当主监督，所有 variant 都必须单独有身份判别力。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34753:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33337:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30167:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6633:1. **Hard-Lattice ERM / CVaR**
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34754:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33338:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34756:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33340:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30170:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34757:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33341:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30213:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6302:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34758:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33342:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30214:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6320:- LM-S2-strong（强 TTA 防御）还在跑；**LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM**（3090，bqd5skbum，loss_mode=hard 已实现+smoke 过）epoch 0，待 Hard-ordinary 对照（需 Hard-Lat ≥+0.8 over Hard-ord 才算训练端活）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34759:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33343:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30215:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6323:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34760:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33344:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30216:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6336:- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34761:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33347:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30342:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34762:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33348:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30346:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:1179:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "LM-ReID|low-resolution|lattice|marginal|sampling|bbox|LSRC|LPA|LS-MRT|Hard-Lattice|BLC|adapter|LoRA|OA-SD|PLBOA" experiments -S' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34763:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33400:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34768:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33406:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30446:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34773:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30452:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34774:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33412:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6624:- 不做 Hard-Lattice ERM：没有选一个 hard variant 当主监督，所有 variant 都必须单独有身份判别力。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34775:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33413:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6698:- 不做 Hard-Lattice ERM：没有选一个 hard variant 当主监督，所有 variant 都必须单独有身份判别力。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34776:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33420:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30523:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34777:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33421:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30525:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1083:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "LM-ReID|BLC|LS-MRT|LPA|LSRC|Hard-Lattice|LATS|marginal|low|低分辨率|格点|lattice" experiments -S' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34778:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33436:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34779:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33437:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34803:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33492:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30619:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4639:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34807:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33503:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30635:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4732:- 非 **Hard-Lattice ERM**（76.894 死）：把 K 变体当检索证据集，非独立硬样本逐个 ERM。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34808:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33504:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30636:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4767:从备选清单看，之前认为可能的第四类已经被你这条消息里的新证据覆盖：LPA/LS-MRT 是 frozen 重加权，LSRC 是改 backbone loss，Hard-Lattice 是 robust ERM，BLC 是 input canonicalize。剩下候选基本会退化进这些桶。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34809:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33506:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30639:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34810:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33510:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30646:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4895:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34813:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33513:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30649:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4905:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34814:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33514:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30650:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34817:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33521:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5269:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34824:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33528:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30665:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6228:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2791:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1951:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:117:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34825:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33533:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30670:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6250:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2813:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:18:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34826:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30681:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6304:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4767:从备选清单看，之前认为可能的第四类已经被你这条消息里的新证据覆盖：LPA/LS-MRT 是 frozen 重加权，LSRC 是改 backbone loss，Hard-Lattice 是 robust ERM，BLC 是 input canonicalize。剩下候选基本会退化进这些桶。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34827:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33540:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30682:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6320:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34834:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33550:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34836:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33561:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30711:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6514:   - Hard-Lattice ERM 76.9 < 77.44
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34837:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33562:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30713:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34839:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33568:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30723:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6876:所以我不会再建议什么“便宜训练端新机制”。最多还能做的不是正向机制，而是**论文里的反例补强**：比如把 “ordinary M3 / lattice M3 / no-LM / full-LM / LSRC / Hard-Lattice / BLC 逻辑”整理成 controlled alternatives。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34845:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33579:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34858:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33633:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30906:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34884:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31003:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3946:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34885:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34886:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31005:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34887:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31006:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3955:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34888:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31009:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3971:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34889:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31011:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34935:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33812:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4767:从备选清单看，之前认为可能的第四类已经被你这条消息里的新证据覆盖：LPA/LS-MRT 是 frozen 重加权，LSRC 是改 backbone loss，Hard-Lattice 是 robust ERM，BLC 是 input canonicalize。剩下候选基本会退化进这些桶。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34936:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33814:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34937:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33818:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4895:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
