experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34939:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33820:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4901:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34940:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33821:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4905:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34941:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34942:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33823:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4993:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:916:/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"LM-ReID|low[- ]resolution|低分辨率|lattice|marginal|marginalization|sampling-lattice|LSRC|LS-MRT|LPA|Hard-Lattice|bbox|BLC|no-LM\" experiments . --glob '"'!outputs/**'"' --glob '"'!logs/**'"'" in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34943:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5016:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34944:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33835:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5269:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34958:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33867:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34959:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33868:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34961:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33870:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34962:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33871:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34964:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33883:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6514:   - Hard-Lattice ERM 76.9 < 77.44
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34965:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33884:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34966:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6871:   Hard-Lattice `76.9 < 77.44`，说明“训练时照顾最坏格点”不如普通 no-LM 判别训练。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34967:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33890:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6876:所以我不会再建议什么“便宜训练端新机制”。最多还能做的不是正向机制，而是**论文里的反例补强**：比如把 “ordinary M3 / lattice M3 / no-LM / full-LM / LSRC / Hard-Lattice / BLC 逻辑”整理成 controlled alternatives。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34973:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33948:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34974:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33950:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34975:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33951:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34976:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33952:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34977:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33955:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34978:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33957:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6458:`(c) Hard-Lattice ERM`：**可以做，但降级为最后训练端救援实验。信心 5/10。**  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34979:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33958:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6494:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34981:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33961:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6553:5. **LM-S5 Hard-Lattice ERM 一枪**：同时跑 `Hard ordinary-aug ERM`。若 Hard-Lattice 不能比 Hard-ordinary 或 ordinary M3 单测多 `>= +0.8~1.0 mAP`，训练端路线彻底停。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34982:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33962:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34985:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:1159:- 剩：(b) 纯 test-time（robust 但 codex 4.5/10）/ (c) Hard-Lattice ERM（被命门削弱）/ (d) pivot。**post-命门 codex（53466，bulrvjdg2）定夺**：含"test-time 特殊 / training 不特殊"不对称能否成更干净卖点。cons-only（3090）仍跑（诊断 L_cons vs L_marg，现次要）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34987:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33974:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:1180:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34988:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33976:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:4730:- **raw Hard-Lattice ERM / CVaR**：太像更狠的 lattice-aug，容易继续压判别性。最多做 cheap ablation。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35000:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33993:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35002:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35139:  4708	- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35729:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:6826:脚本里能看到多个历史修补痕迹：LSRC 默认污染被强制清零、随机 lattice 每 epoch 刷新、triplet 改成 per-slot、GRL 标签改成真实 axis。这说明“当时负结果”不能天然等于代码无误，必须区分“修补后跑的结果”和“修补前的旧日志”。我继续查对应 monitor/review/log 记录来对齐这一点。

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID) — TRAINING  (exp359, Market, fine-tune exp260b).
     3	
     4	HYPOTHESIS: a lattice-marginalized embedding (trained to be INVARIANT to the sampling
     5	lattice — sub-pixel phase / +/-1 LR-pixel bbox / antialias kernel) BEATS the zero-training
     6	frozen K-phase ensemble (the kill-switch's +4.23 mAP @ h=16). If the trained model clears
     7	frozen-ensemble +0.8~2.0 @ h=16 -> it is a METHOD; if it only ~= the frozen ensemble ->
     8	it is an ensemble trick (honest fail, report as such).
     9	
    10	Design: experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md  (method-design codex, CCF-B 7/10).
    11	Loss:   L = L_id + lam_marg*L_marg + lam_cons*L_cons + lam_adv*L_adv.
    12	        L_id   = mean_l [ CE(cls^l, y) + Triplet(gf^l, y) ]            (per-variant ReID)
    13	        L_marg = -log[ mean_l softmax(cls^l)[y] ] + Triplet(mean_l gf^l, y)  (marginal lik.)
    14	        L_cons = mean_l (1-cos(z^l, sg(z_mu))) + beta*mean_l KL(p^l || sg(p_mu))  (lattice inv.)
    15	        L_adv  = GRL: a discriminator that predicts the lattice-variant index from z is
    16	                 reversed, so z carries NO predictable lattice label (weak, warmup-gated).
    17

     2	
     3	**Verdict**: approve

    10	- **Medium-3** [GRL]: λ 双重缩放 → 梯度 λ²。**修**: `GradReverse.apply(z, adv_lamb)` + loss 加 L_adv 权重 1.0（single-lambda DANN）。

codex
**总判**
不能继续用“8 个训练端机制已穷尽”这个强表述。更诚实的结论是：

`L_marg/L_cons`、no-LM 对照、ordinary-vs-lattice aug、LSRC 对称/非对称、LS-MRT/LPA/LATS 这些负结果大体可信；但 **Hard-Lattice 不够干净，BLC 没训练，LCRS 没训练**。所以用户质疑是成立的，尤其是 LCRS 不能被“当时负结果”覆盖。

**(a) 代码正确性**
当前 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:40) 不是明显错跑：

- lattice 合成当前是合理的：M 默认 3，非 canonical variant 每 epoch 随机 axis/kernel，覆盖 phase/bbox/zoom/kernel；dataset 里 `set_epoch()` 会刷新随机变体。见 [variants](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:130) 和 [set_epoch](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:226)。
- 早期关键 bug 已修：M=2 只训部分 axis、每 epoch 变体冻结、flat `B*M` triplet 把同图不同糊法当正样本、GRL λ²。审查记录在 [codex_review.md](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review.md:7)。
- loss 主体实现对：CE 对所有 variants，triplet 改成 per-slot，`L_marg` 是 posterior mean + mean-feature triplet，`L_cons` 是拉到 stop-grad mean embedding/prediction。见 [loss block](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:414)。
- train/test 特征口径基本一致：训练和 eval 都 `pose_dict=None`、global feat、BN neck after、L2 norm；pose/LGPA/GCN 分支不会进。见 [model load](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:321) 和 [forward skip](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/pose_backbone_model.py:705)。
- 但配置是 **Swin-Base**，不是 AGENTS 主线里的 Swin-Tiny：`swin_base_patch4_window7_224`。见 [config](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/configs/market/pose_psg_lgpa_gcn_base.yml:11)。所以结论只在 exp359 这个 Swin-Base/exp260b 口径内成立，不能自动外推到 Swin-Tiny 主线。

`-1.73` 我判是真负，不是明显代码 bug。no-LM `77.44` > full LM `75.71`，HR sanity `88.92` > `86.09`，记录在 [monitor](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:67)。但措辞要改：这不是纯 “embedding invariance” 单项负，而是 `L_marg + L_cons` 合体负；cons-only 是 `76.895`，只比 no-LM 低 `0.55`，主害更像 `L_marg`。见 [cons-only](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:112)。

Hard-Lattice 我不敢判干净。代码里 `loss_mode == 'hard'` 只额外 harden CE，不 harden triplet；更关键是 `hard` 没有像 LSRC 那样强制 `lam_marg=0/lam_cons=0`。默认仍是 `1.0/0.2`，若启动命令没显式清零，就会混入已证负的 full LM loss。见 [args/defaults](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [hard loss](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:421)。我没找到能证明当时 Hard-Lattice 命令清零了这两个项的日志。因此 `76.9 < 77.44` 只能算“可疑负/需重跑”，不能当铁证。

**(b) 用户想法是否真验过**
用户说的两件事要拆开：

- “训练时合成多糊法综合判断”：**部分验过**。`L_marg` 是分类 posterior/mean feature 版综合判断，跑了且负；LSRC 是更接近 retrieval decision 的 set/logsumexp 版，也跑了，对称 `79.90 -> 77.98`，非对称 `79.90 -> 79.57`，仍负但温和。见 [LSRC asym](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17)。
- “多糊法特征尽可能相同”：**验过**。这就是 `L_cons`/invariance；但单独只小负，`-1.73` 主要不是它一个项。
- LCRS：**没有训练过**。文档明确写的是排队：`z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + alpha P_k(g_k))`、residual decorrelation、冻结 backbone 训 heads，状态是“排队”。见 [pipeline](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60)。
- BLC / sampling-lattice canonicalization：**没有训练过**。只有 design 和“bbox 主因子不适合 canonicalize”的数据推断。见 [design_blc](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:1)。
- LS-MRT/LPA/LATS：确实跑过，但在其它 probe 脚本，不在 `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 主训练脚本里。它们能证明一批 frozen adaptation 无 headroom，不能证明 LCRS 已死。

**(c) 综合判定**
“训练端穷尽”这个结论不可信，至少不该按 [decisions.md](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4708) 那样写成 8 机制全实测封死。

更准确的版本：

- 可信负：full LM `L_marg+L_cons`、cons-only 弱负、ordinary-vs-lattice 训练增广只 +0.54、LSRC 对称/非对称负、LS-MRT/LPA/LATS frozen probe 负。
- 不够可信：Hard-Lattice，需要确认/重跑清零 `lam_marg/lam_cons` 的干净版本。
- 没跑过：BLC/LC-STN input canonicalization、LCRS residual complementary subspaces、LRFD/DeepSets 等排队项。

如果只重做一个，我建议先做 **LCRS cheap probe**，因为它正好对应用户说的“不要把多糊法压成一样，而是让多糊法互补”。如果还要补证据链，再重跑一个干净 Hard-Lattice：显式 `--loss_mode hard --lam_marg 0 --lam_cons 0`，并配 Hard-ordinary 对照。
